name: Blade Ward
description: Until the end of your next turn you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from weapon attacks.

name: Blade Ward
description: For up to 1 minute (Concentration), every attack roll made against you takes a 1d4 penalty.

name: Booming Blade
components: S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)
description: You channel thunderous energy into a melee weapon and strike a creature. If the target then moves away before your next turn, it takes extra thunder damage.

name: Control Flames
description: You magically manipulate an existing nonmagical flame within range, expanding, extinguishing, or shaping it, or producing simple shapes and colors of fire.

name: Create Bonfire
description: You conjure a magical bonfire in a 5-foot cube. Creatures that enter or start their turn in the fire take fire damage, and it can ignite flammables.

name: Friends
description: For 1 minute you have advantage on Charisma checks against one non-hostile creature. When it ends, the creature knows you used magic on it and turns hostile.

name: Friends
description: One creature within 10 feet makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed by you for 1 minute. Non-Humanoids, creatures you're fighting, and repeat targets within 24 hours auto-succeed; it ends if the target is hurt or you attack or force a save, and the target then knows it was charmed.

name: Frostbite
description: You cause numbing frost to form on a creature you can see. It must succeed on a Constitution save or take cold damage and have disadvantage on its next weapon attack roll.

name: Green-Flame Blade
components: S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)
description: You brandish a melee weapon and strike a creature, dealing normal damage plus fire. Green fire then leaps to a second nearby creature, dealing fire damage based on your level.

name: Gust
description: You create a brief blast of wind that can push a creature, move a light object, or extinguish unprotected flames.

name: Infestation
description: You cause a cloud of mites, fleas, or other parasites to swarm a creature. It takes poison damage and must move in a random direction on a failed save.

name: Lightning Lure
description: You create a lash of lightning that pulls a creature toward you and deals lightning damage if it fails a Strength save.

name: Magic Stone
description: You touch up to three pebbles and imbue them with magic. You or a companion can make a ranged spell attack with them, dealing bludgeoning damage.

name: Mind Sliver
description: You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into a creature's mind. On a failed Intelligence save it takes psychic damage and subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw.

name: Mold Earth
description: You manipulate dirt or stone in a 5-foot cube, moving it, shaping it, or creating difficult terrain, or excavating a small amount.

name: Primal Savagery
description: Your teeth or nails sharpen with primal power. You make a melee spell attack that deals acid damage.

name: Shape Water
description: You reshape or animate a 5-foot cube of water, freeze it, change its color or opacity, or create simple shapes that last a short time.

name: Thorn Whip
components: V, S, M (the stem of a thorny plant)
description: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns and make a melee spell attack. On a hit the target takes piercing damage and is pulled closer if it is Large or smaller.

name: Thunderclap
description: You create a burst of thunderous sound that can be heard from afar. Each creature in a 5-foot radius must succeed on a Constitution save or take thunder damage.

name: Toll the Dead
description: You point at a creature and a bell tolls. It takes necrotic damage; more if it is already missing hit points.

name: Word of Radiance
description: You utter a divine word and each creature of your choice within 5 feet must succeed on a Constitution save or take radiant damage.

name: Absorb Elements
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage
description: When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you capture some of the energy. You gain resistance to that damage type until your next turn and can add it to a melee attack.

name: Armor of Agathys
components: V, S, M (a shard of blue glass)
description: A protective magical frost covers you, granting temporary hit points. While those points remain, any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes cold damage.

name: Arms of Hadar
description: Tendrils of dark energy erupt from you and batter creatures within 10 feet. Each must succeed on a Strength save or take necrotic damage and can't take reactions until its next turn.

name: Beast Bond
components: V, S, M (a bit of fur wrapped in a cloth)
description: You forge a telepathic link with a willing beast. While linked you can communicate with it and it has advantage on attack rolls against creatures within 5 feet of you that you can see.

name: Catapult
description: An unattended object of 1 to 5 pounds flies up to 90 feet in a line. A creature in its path makes a Dexterity save; on a failure the object hits it, and the object and whatever it hits each take 3d8 bludgeoning damage. Higher slots raise the weight limit and damage.

name: Cause Fear
description: You awaken the sense of mortality in a creature. It must succeed on a Wisdom save or become frightened of you; it can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Ceremony
components: V, S, M (25 gp worth of powdered silver, which the spell consumes)
description: You perform a special religious ceremony that can provide various benefits such as atonement, blessing a marriage, or dedicating a creature to a god, depending on the rite chosen.

name: Chromatic Orb
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 50 gp)
description: Make a ranged spell attack with a 4-inch orb of acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder (your choice): 3d8 damage of that type on a hit, +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Compelled Duel
description: One creature makes a Wisdom save or, for up to 1 minute, has disadvantage attacking anyone but you and must pass a Wisdom save to move more than 30 feet from you. Ends if you attack or target another hostile, an ally harms it, or you end a turn more than 30 feet away.

name: Compelled Duel
description: One creature makes a Wisdom save or, for up to 1 minute, has Disadvantage attacking anyone but you and can't willingly move more than 30 feet from you. Ends if you attack or cast on another enemy, an ally damages it, or you end a turn more than 30 feet away.

name: Dissonant Whispers
description: You whisper a discordant melody that only one creature can hear. On a failed Wisdom save it takes psychic damage and must use its reaction to move away from you.

name: Earth Tremor
description: You cause a tremor in the ground within range. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Dexterity save or take bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone; the ground becomes difficult terrain.

name: Ensnaring Strike
description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before the spell ends, thorny vines wrap around it. It takes piercing damage and is restrained on a failed Strength save.

name: Hail of Thorns
description: Your next ranged weapon hit before the spell ends (Concentration) bursts into thorns: the target and creatures within 5 feet make a Dexterity save for 1d10 piercing, half on a success (+1d10 per slot level, max 6d10).

name: Hail of Thorns
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Ranged weapon
description: Bonus Action right after a Ranged weapon hit: the target and creatures within 5 feet make a Dexterity save for 1d10 Piercing, half on a success (+1d10 per slot level above 1).

name: Hunter's Mark
description: You mark a creature as your quarry. Until the spell ends you deal extra damage to it with weapon attacks and have advantage on checks to track it. You can move the mark if the target drops to 0 hit points.

name: Ice Knife
components: S, M (a drop of water or a piece of ice)
description: You create a shard of ice and fling it at a creature. On a hit it takes piercing damage, then the shard explodes dealing cold damage to the target and nearby creatures on a failed Dexterity save.

name: Ray of Sickness
description: A ray of sickening greenish energy streaks toward a creature. On a hit it takes poison damage and must succeed on a Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of your next turn.

name: Searing Smite
description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends deals an extra 1d6 fire and sets the target alight. At the start of each of its turns it makes a Constitution save: 1d6 fire on a failure, the spell ends on a success. An action to douse the flames also ends it.

name: Silvery Barbs
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself succeeds on an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw
description: You magically distract a creature that succeeds on an attack, check, or save, forcing it to reroll and take the lower result. You can then give advantage to another creature's next roll.

name: Snare
components: S, M (25 feet of rope, which the spell consumes)
description: You create a magical trap using a rope. When a creature steps on the trapped area it must succeed on a Dexterity save or be magically hoisted into the air and restrained.

name: Spellfire Flare
description: You unleash a blast of brilliant spellfire that ignores cover. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes radiant damage. Higher-level slots create additional blasts.

name: Tasha's Caustic Brew
components: V, S, M (a bit of rotten food)
description: A stream of acid gushes from you in a line. Each creature in the line must succeed on a Dexterity save or take acid damage at the start of each of its turns until it uses an action to scrape or wash the acid off.

name: Thunderous Smite
description: Your first melee weapon hit before the spell ends (Concentration) booms audibly to 300 feet and deals an extra 2d6 thunder; a creature makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

name: Thunderous Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Bonus Action right after a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit: an extra 2d6 Thunder, audible to 300 feet, and a creature makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet and knocked Prone (+1d6 per slot level above 1).

name: Wardaway
components: V, S, M (a miniature clay hand)
description: One creature makes a Constitution save (Constructs and Undead auto-succeed): 2d4 Force, half its Speed until your next turn, and only an action or a Bonus Action on its next turn on a failure; half damage only on a success. +2d4 per slot level above 1.

name: Witch Bolt
components: V, S, M (a twig struck by lightning)
description: Ranged spell attack: 1d12 lightning on a hit, and each turn you can spend your action to deal 1d12 lightning automatically. Ends if you use your action for anything else, or the target leaves range or gains total cover.

name: Witch Bolt
components: V, S, M (a twig struck by lightning)
description: Ranged spell attack: 2d12 Lightning on a hit. On later turns, a Bonus Action deals 1d12 Lightning automatically, even if the first attack missed. Ends if the target leaves range or gains Total Cover.

name: Wrathful Smite
description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends deals an extra 1d6 psychic, and a creature makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you. It can use an action on a Wisdom check against your DC to end the spell.

name: Wrathful Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Bonus Action right after a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit: an extra 1d6 Necrotic, and the target makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns (+1d6 per slot level above 1).

name: Zephyr Strike
description: You move like the wind. Until the spell ends your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, you gain a bonus to speed, and once before it ends you can make one weapon attack with advantage that deals extra force damage.

name: Aganazzar's Scorcher
components: V, S, M (a red dragon's scale)
description: A line of roaring flame 30 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must succeed on a Dexterity save or take fire damage.

name: Arcane Vigor
description: You tap into your life force to heal yourself. Roll one or two Hit Dice (your choice) and regain hit points equal to the total plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Battle Familiar
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 25+ GP)
description: Summons a combat familiar (Celestial, Fey, or Fiend) in Brute, Flyer, or Stalker form that rolls its own Initiative. AC, HP, attack count, and Force damage scale with the slot level. If you already have a Find Familiar familiar, it takes the battle form and gains Temporary Hit Points instead.

name: Beast Sense
description: Touch a willing beast; for the duration you can use your action to see and hear through it (with its special senses), but you are blinded and deafened to your own surroundings until you switch back.

name: Beast Sense
description: Touch a willing Beast; for the duration you perceive through its senses, including any special senses, as well as your own.

name: Cloud of Daggers
components: V, S, M (a sliver of glass)
description: A 5-foot cube of spinning daggers: a creature takes 4d4 slashing when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there (+2d4 per slot level above 2nd).

name: Cloud of Daggers
components: V, S, M (a sliver of glass)
description: A 5-foot Cube of spinning daggers deals 4d4 Slashing to creatures in it, entering it, ending a turn in it, or that it moves onto (once per turn). On later turns a Magic action teleports the Cube up to 30 feet (+2d4 per slot level above 2).

name: Cordon of Arrows
description: You plant four pieces of nonmagical ammunition in the ground. When a creature other than you comes within 30 feet of them, one flies up and attacks it. The ammunition is destroyed after attacking.

name: Crown of Madness
description: You force a humanoid to succumb to madness. On a failed Wisdom save a twisted crown appears on its head and it is charmed by you. You can force it to attack a creature of your choice on its turn.

name: Death Armor
components: V, S, M (an onyx worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: An inky aura surrounds a creature you touch: it has Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and once per turn a creature within 5 feet that hits it with a melee attack takes 2d4 Necrotic. Consumes a 50 GP onyx.

name: Deryan's Helpful Homunculi
components: V, S, M (powdered gemstones worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes, and one set of Artisan’s Tools with which you have proficiency)
description: Intangible spirit helpers, proficient in Arcana and with the artisan's tools used in the casting, act as one crafting assistant and halve crafting time for the duration. Consumes 100 GP of powdered gemstones.

name: Disruptive Tune
description: 20-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet. Each creature makes a Constitution save; on a failure it loses Concentration and has Disadvantage on Concentration saves while your spell lasts.

name: Dragon's Breath
description: Touch a willing creature and pick acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. Until the spell ends it can use an action to exhale a 15-foot cone: Dexterity save, 3d6 of that type, half on a success (+1d6 per slot level above 2nd).

name: Dueling Ground
components: V, S, M (a silk flag worth 100+ GP)
description: Ritual. A 15-foot-radius ring holds two willing duelists for 1 hour; anyone else entering ends it. A duelist dropped to 0 HP, or hit by an instant-death effect, is Stable and teleported outside instead of dying. One extra duelist per slot level above 2.

name: Earthbind
description: You attempt to bind a flying creature to the ground. On a failed Strength save its flying speed is reduced to 0 for the duration and it descends safely.

name: Elminster's Elusion
description: For the duration you have Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, and a successful save against one that deals half damage on a success means you take none.

name: Healing Spirit
description: An intangible spirit fills a 5-foot cube. When you or a creature you can see enters its space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, you can heal it 1d6 (no action). It can heal 1 + your spellcasting modifier times; a bonus action moves it 30 feet. No effect on constructs or undead.

name: Maximilian's Earthen Grasp
components: V, S, M (a miniature hand sculpted from clay)
description: A Medium hand of earth rises in a 5-foot space and grabs a creature within 5 feet of it: Strength save or 2d6 bludgeoning and restrained. As an action you can crush a restrained target (Strength save, 2d6, half on success); breaking free is a Strength check against your DC.

name: Mind Spike
description: You reach into the mind of a creature you can see. On a failed Wisdom save it takes psychic damage and you know its location until the spell ends, even if it becomes hidden or invisible.

name: Nathair's Mischief
components: S, M (a piece of crust from an apple pie)
description: You fill a 20-foot cube with magical effects that randomly cause creatures to laugh uncontrollably, be outlined in faerie fire, or be affected by other mischievous illusions.

name: Nystul's Magic Aura
components: V, S, M (a small square of silk)
description: You place an illusion on a creature or object so that divination spells reveal false information about its magical properties or creature type.

name: Phantasmal Force
components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
description: You craft an illusion that takes root in the mind of a creature. On a failed Intelligence save it believes the illusion is real and can take psychic damage from it if the illusion is harmful.

name: Pyrotechnics
description: You cause an area of nonmagical flame to erupt in a dazzling display of fireworks or a thick cloud of smoke that heavily obscures the area.

name: Rime's Binding Ice
description: A cold wind freezes moisture into ice that covers creatures in a cone. On a failed Constitution save they take cold damage and their speed is reduced to 0 until they or another creature uses an action to break the ice.

name: Shadow Blade
description: You weave together threads of shadow to create a sword of solidified gloom in your hand. It deals psychic damage, has the finesse and light properties, and grants advantage in dim light or darkness.

name: Skywrite
description: You cause up to ten words to appear in a cloud formation in the sky. The words remain for the duration and can be seen from great distances.

name: Snilloc's Snowball Swarm
components: V, S, M (a piece of ice or a small white rock chip)
description: A flurry of magic snowballs erupts from a point you choose. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere must succeed on a Dexterity save or take cold damage.

name: Summon Beast
components: V, S, M (a feather, tuft of fur, and fish tail inside a gilded acorn worth 200+ GP)
description: You call forth a bestial spirit that takes the form of a land, air, or water beast of your choice. It obeys your commands and acts on your turn.

name: Tasha's Mind Whip
description: One creature makes an Intelligence save: 3d6 psychic, no reactions until the end of its next turn, and on that turn only one of a move, an action, or a bonus action. Half damage only on a success. One extra target per slot level above 2nd.

name: Uncertain Footing
description: Up to three creatures within 120 feet make an Intelligence save. On a failure a target's Speed is halved and it can't Dash. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Warding Wind
description: A strong wind (20 miles per hour) blows around you in a 10-foot radius. It extinguishes unprotected flames, disperses gases, and imposes disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks that pass through it.

name: Warp Sense
description: You gain the ability to sense the presence of portals and planar rifts within range, and can attempt to identify their destinations.

name: Wither and Bloom
components: V, S, M (a withered vine twisted into a loop)
description: 10-foot-radius Sphere within 60 feet. Creatures you choose make a Constitution save for 3d6 Necrotic (half on success), and ordinary plants wither. One creature in the area can spend a Hit Point Die to heal that roll plus your spellcasting modifier. Each slot level above 2 adds 1d6 damage and one more Hit Point Die.

name: Ashardalon's Stride
description: The billowing flames of a dragon cover your feet, granting you a bonus to speed and allowing you to deal fire damage to creatures you move near without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Aura of Vitality
description: For up to 1 minute a 30-foot aura moves with you; as a bonus action you heal one creature in it (including you) for 2d6.

name: Aura of Vitality
description: For up to 1 minute a 30-foot Emanation surrounds you; when you create it and at the start of each of your turns, you can heal one creature in it for 2d6.

name: Blinding Smite
description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends deals an extra 3d8 radiant, and the target makes a Constitution save or is blinded, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Blinding Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Bonus Action right after a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit: an extra 3d8 Radiant and the target is Blinded, making a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to end it (+1d8 per slot level above 3).

name: Cacophonic Shield
description: A 10-foot Emanation of thunder for the duration: creatures it reaches, or that enter or end a turn in it, make a Constitution save (once per turn) for 3d6 Thunder and Deafened until your next turn, half damage only on a success. You can exempt creatures. You also resist Thunder, and ranged attacks against you have Disadvantage. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Catnap
description: Up to three willing creatures within 30 feet fall Unconscious for 10 minutes. A target that sleeps undisturbed for the full duration gains a Short Rest's benefits, then can't be affected again until a Long Rest. One extra target per slot level above 3.

name: Conjure Barrage
components: V, S, M (a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP)
description: Throw a nonmagical weapon or fire a piece of ammunition to make a 60-foot cone of copies: Dexterity save, 3d8 damage of the weapon's type, half on a success.

name: Conjure Barrage
components: V, S, M (a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP)
description: Spectral copies of the weapon used in the casting fly out in a 60-foot Cone: chosen creatures make a Dexterity save for 5d8 Force, half on a success (+1d8 per slot level above 3).

name: Conjure Constructs
description: Intangible construct spirits fill a Medium space for the duration and move up to 30 feet when you move. On casting and as a Magic action later, they affect one target within 5 feet of them: Clockwork Force (Dexterity save, 3d6 Force, half on success) or Orderly Ward (1d6 + your spellcasting modifier Temporary Hit Points). +1d6 to both per slot level above 3.

name: Crusader's Mantle
description: Holy power radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Friendly creatures in the aura deal extra radiant damage with weapon attacks.

name: Elemental Weapon
description: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls, and it deals extra damage of an elemental type you choose.

name: Enemies Abound
description: One creature makes an Intelligence save (auto-success if immune to fear) or sees every creature as an enemy: it picks targets at random among creatures in range and must take any opportunity attack provoked. It repeats the save each time it takes damage.

name: Erupting Earth
components: V, S, M (a piece of obsidian)
description: Choose a point on the ground. A fountain of churned earth and stone erupts in a 20-foot cube. Creatures in the area take bludgeoning damage on a failed Dexterity save and the ground becomes difficult terrain.

name: Feign Death
components: V, S, M (a pinch of graveyard dirt)
description: You touch a willing creature and put it into a cataleptic state that is indistinguishable from death. The target appears dead to all casual inspection and to spells used to determine its status.

name: Flame Arrows
description: You touch a quiver containing arrows or bolts. When a target is hit by a ranged weapon attack using one of those pieces of ammunition, the target takes extra fire damage. The magic ends on a piece of ammunition when it hits or misses.

name: Hunger of Hadar
description: You open a gateway to the dark between the stars, a region of cold and darkness that fills a 20-foot radius sphere. Creatures in the area take cold and acid damage and the area is heavily obscured.

name: Inflict Doubt
description: One creature within 120 feet makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Intellect Fortress
description: You or one willing creature within range gains resistance to psychic damage and advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves for the duration. One extra target per slot level above 3rd (all within 30 feet of each other).

name: Laeral's Silver Lance
components: V, S, M (a silver pin worth 250+ GP)
description: A 120-foot by 5-foot Line of silver energy: chosen creatures in it make a Strength save for 3d10 Force and Prone, half damage only on a success. +1d10 per slot level above 3. Needs a 250 GP silver pin.

name: Life Transference
description: You sacrifice some of your own health to mend another creature. You take necrotic damage, and the target regains hit points equal to twice the necrotic damage you take.

name: Lightning Arrow
casting_time: 1 bonus action, which you can take immediately after hitting or missing a target with a ranged attack using a weapon
description: Your next ranged weapon attack before the spell ends becomes a lightning bolt: 4d8 lightning on a hit (half on a miss) instead of normal damage, and every creature within 10 feet of the target makes a Dexterity save for 2d8, half on a success.

name: Lightning Arrow
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you can take immediately after hitting or missing a target with a ranged attack using a weapon
description: Bonus Action right after a ranged weapon attack hits or misses: the target takes 4d8 Lightning on a hit (half on a miss) instead of the attack's effects, and creatures within 10 feet make a Dexterity save for 2d8, half on a success (+1d8 per slot level above 3).

name: Melf's Minute Meteors
components: V, S, M (niter, sulfur, and pine tar formed into a bead)
description: You create six tiny meteors in your space. As a bonus action you can send one or two streaking toward points you choose, where they explode in a 5-foot radius dealing fire and bludgeoning damage.

name: Spirit Shroud
description: You call forth spirits of the dead that flit around you. Your attacks deal extra necrotic, radiant, or cold damage, and creatures of your choice within 10 feet have their speed reduced.

name: Summon Fey
components: V, S, M (a gilded flower worth 300+ GP)
description: You call forth a fey spirit that takes the form of a loyal companion. It has different options for its nature (fuming, mirthful, or tricksy) that grant different abilities.

name: Summon Lesser Demons
components: V, S, M (a vial of blood from a humanoid killed within the past 24 hours)
description: You summon one or more demons of challenge rating 1 or lower. They appear in unoccupied spaces and act according to their chaotic nature, though you can try to command them.

name: Summon Shadowspawn
components: V, S, M (tears inside a gem worth at least 300 gp)
description: You call forth a shadowy spirit that takes a form of your choosing (fury, despair, or fear). It obeys your commands and has abilities matching its chosen emotion.

name: Summon Undead
components: V, S, M (a gilded skull worth 300+ GP)
description: You call forth an undead spirit that takes the form of a ghostly or putrid undead of your choice. It obeys your verbal commands and acts on your turn.

name: Sylune's Viper
description: You wreathe yourself in a spectral serpent for the duration. You gain 15 Temporary Hit Points, and the spell ends early when they are gone. You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. As a Magic action, the viper bites a creature within 50 feet: make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 1d6 Force damage and has the Poisoned condition and the Incapacitated condition until the start of your next turn. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Temporary Hit Points increase by 5 and the damage by 1d6 for each slot level above 3.

name: Thunder Step
description: You teleport yourself to an unoccupied space within range. A thunderous boom sounds, and each creature within 10 feet of the space you left must succeed on a Constitution save or take thunder damage.

name: Tidal Wave
components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
description: You create a wall of water that crashes down on an area. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Dexterity save or take bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone; the water then spreads and extinguishes flames.

name: Tiny Servant
description: You touch an object that is not attached or carried and it animates as a tiny construct under your control. It can perform simple tasks and has limited combat ability.

name: Wall of Sand
components: V, S, M (a handful of sand)
description: A wall of swirling sand up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 10 feet thick. It blocks sight but not movement; a creature inside is blinded and spends 3 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves there.

name: Wall of Water
components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
description: A 30-foot-long or 20-foot-ring wall of water, 1 foot thick. Its space is difficult terrain, ranged weapon attacks through it have disadvantage, and fire passing through it deals half damage. Cold damage freezes sections of it solid.

name: Aura of Life
description: Life-preserving energy radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Nonhostile living creatures in the aura have resistance to necrotic damage and their hit point maximum can't be reduced; a creature at 0 hit points that starts its turn there gains 1 hit point.

name: Aura of Purity
description: A 30-foot aura moves with you for up to 10 minutes. You and your allies in it have resistance to poison damage and advantage on saves against effects that blind, charm, deafen, frighten, paralyze, poison, or stun (the 2014 version also blocks disease).

name: Backlash
casting_time: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage
description: Reaction when you take damage: reduce it by 4d6 + your spellcasting modifier, and if a creature within range caused it, that creature makes a Constitution save for 4d6 Force, half on a success. +1d6 to both per slot level above 4.

name: Charm Monster
description: You attempt to charm a creature you can see. On a failed Wisdom save it is charmed by you until the spell ends or you or your companions do anything harmful to it.

name: Distorted Distance
description: 60-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet. For each creature in it you choose either a stretch (Intelligence save or 2d10 Psychic and Difficult Terrain until its turn ends) or a shortcut (+20 feet Speed until the end of its next turn). Repeats when a creature enters or ends its turn there, once per turn.

name: Doomtide
components: V, S, M (soot and a dried eel)
description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of magical Darkness fog that drifts 10 feet away from you each turn until a strong wind disperses it. Creatures it touches make a Wisdom save (once per turn): 5d6 Psychic and a 1d6 penalty on saves until the end of their next turn, half damage only on a success. Can be cast as a Circle spell for a 1-mile range and permanent duration.

name: Elemental Bane
description: One creature makes a Constitution save or, for the duration, loses resistance to your chosen damage type (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder) and takes an extra 2d6 of that type the first time each turn it takes such damage. One extra target per slot level above 4th.

name: Festering Blast
description: 60-foot by 10-foot Line from you. Constitution save: 4d10 Necrotic and Poisoned on a failure. A Poisoned target takes 2d10 Poison at the start of each of its turns and repeats the save at the end of each. +1d10 initial per slot level above 4.

name: Find Greater Steed
description: You summon a loyal steed of a more powerful type than the standard Find Steed, such as a griffon or pegasus. It serves you as a mount and companion.

name: Fount of Moonlight
description: For the duration you shed 20 feet of bright light, resist Radiant damage, and deal an extra 2d6 Radiant on melee hits. Reaction after a creature within 60 feet damages you: it makes a Constitution save or is Blinded until the end of your next turn.

name: Gate Seal
components: V, S, M (a broken portal key, which the spell consumes)
description: A stationary 30-foot cube: portals in it close and can't open, and planar travel into or out of it (Gate, Plane Shift and the like) fails. At 6th level or higher it lasts until dispelled. Consumes a broken portal key.

name: Grasping Vine
description: A vine sprouts within range. On casting and as a bonus action each turn, it lashes a creature within 30 feet of it: Dexterity save or pulled 20 feet toward the vine.

name: Grasping Vine
description: A vine sprouts within range and makes a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet of it: 4d8 Bludgeoning, pulled 30 feet toward it, and Grappled if Huge or smaller. A Bonus Action on later turns repeats the attack; one more grapple per slot level above 4.

name: Guardian of Nature
description: You transform into a powerful guardian form, either a primal beast or a great tree, gaining enhanced senses, attacks, or defensive abilities for the duration.

name: Raulothim's Psychic Lance
description: You unleash a shimmering lance of psychic energy at a creature you can see or name. On a failed Intelligence save it takes psychic damage and is incapacitated until the start of your next turn.

name: Shadow of Moil
components: V, S, M (an undead eyeball encased in a gem worth at least 150 gp)
description: Shadows wreathe you until the spell ends: you are heavily obscured, light within 10 feet dims a step, you resist radiant damage, and a creature within 10 feet that hits you with an attack takes 2d8 necrotic.

name: Sickening Radiance
description: Dim green light fills a 30-foot sphere. A creature entering it for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Constitution save or takes 4d10 radiant, gains a level of exhaustion, and glows so it can't benefit from invisibility. The glow and exhaustion end with the spell.

name: Spellfire Storm
description: A 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder of spellfire: creatures in it, entering it, or ending a turn there make a Constitution save (once per turn) for 4d10 Radiant, half on success. A creature casting a spell inside must pass a Constitution save or the spell fizzles (slot kept). You can exempt creatures. +1d10 per slot level above 4; has a Circle casting option.

name: Staggering Smite
description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends deals an extra 4d6 psychic, and the target makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks and can't take reactions until the end of its next turn.

name: Staggering Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Bonus Action right after a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit: an extra 4d6 Psychic, and the target makes a Wisdom save or is Stunned until the end of your next turn (+1d6 per slot level above 4).

name: Storm Sphere
description: A 20-foot sphere of whirling air: creatures in it when it appears or ending a turn there make a Strength save or take 2d6 bludgeoning, and it is difficult terrain. Each turn a bonus action sends a lightning bolt (ranged spell attack, advantage against targets inside) for 4d6 lightning at a creature within 60 feet of its center. +1d6 to each per slot level above 4th.

name: Summon Aberration
components: V, S, M (a pickled tentacle and an eyeball in a platinum-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP)
description: You call forth an aberrant spirit that takes the form of a beholder-like or tentacled creature of your choice. It obeys your commands and has unique abilities based on its form.

name: Summon Construct
components: V, S, M (a lockbox worth 400+ GP)
description: You summon a construct spirit that takes a metal or stone form. It follows your verbal commands and can be customized with different defensive or offensive traits.

name: Summon Elemental
components: V, S, M (air, a pebble, ash, and water inside a gold-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP)
description: You call forth an elemental spirit that takes the form of an air, earth, fire, or water elemental of your choice. It obeys your commands and acts on your initiative.

name: Summon Greater Demon
components: V, S, M (a vial of blood from a humanoid killed within the past 24 hours)
description: Summon a demon of CR 5 or lower that rolls its own initiative and follows your verbal commands. At the end of each of its turns it makes a Charisma save (disadvantage if you say its true name); on a success it breaks free and attacks the nearest non-demons. A blood circle can trap it.

name: Vitriolic Sphere
components: V, S, M (a drop of giant slug bile)
description: You point at a location and a 1-foot-diameter glowing green orb of acid streaks there and explodes. Creatures in a 20-foot radius take acid damage on a failed Dexterity save, and residual acid continues to burn on a failed save.

name: Watery Sphere
components: V, S, M (a droplet of water)
description: You create a sphere of water that can restrain creatures inside it. You can move the sphere and force it to dash, potentially carrying restrained creatures with it or slamming them into surfaces.

name: Zone of Amicability
description: For 10 minutes, a 60-foot Emanation around you: when you make an ability check to influence a creature inside it, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as a 10.

name: Alustriel's Mooncloak
components: V, S, M (a moonstone worth 50+ GP)
description: A 20-foot Emanation of moonlight: you and allies in it have Half Cover and resist Cold, Lightning, and Radiant. You can end the spell early for Liberation (a Reaction turns a failed save against Frightened, Grappled, or Restrained into a success) or Respite (a Magic action heals you or an ally inside 4d10 + your spellcasting modifier). Needs a 50 GP moonstone.

name: Banishing Smite
description: Your next weapon hit before the spell ends deals an extra 5d10 force; if that leaves the target at 50 hit points or fewer it is banished (to its home plane if extraplanar, otherwise to a harmless demiplane, incapacitated) until the spell ends.

name: Banishing Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Bonus Action right after a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit: an extra 5d10 Force, and if that leaves the target at 50 HP or fewer it makes a Charisma save or is sent to a harmless demiplane, Incapacitated, until the spell ends.

name: Circle of Power
description: Divine energy radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Creatures of your choice in the aura have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and resistance to damage from such effects if they succeed.

name: Conjure Volley
components: V, S, M (a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP)
description: Fire a nonmagical piece of ammunition or throw a nonmagical weapon: creatures in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder make a Dexterity save for 8d8 of the weapon's damage type, half on a success.

name: Conjure Volley
components: V, S, M (a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP)
description: Spectral copies of the weapon used in the casting rain on a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder: chosen creatures make a Dexterity save for 8d8 Force, half on a success.

name: Control Winds
description: You take control of the air in a 100-foot cube, choosing one of several effects: gusts that push creatures, a downdraft that forces flying creatures to the ground, or an updraft that lifts creatures upward.

name: Danse Macabre
description: Threads of dark power leap from your fingers to pierce up to five Small or Medium corpses. Each becomes an undead skeleton or zombie under your control for the duration.

name: Dawn
components: V, S, M (a sunburst pendant worth at least 100 gp)
description: A 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of sunlight: creatures in it when it appears or ending a turn there make a Constitution save for 4d10 radiant, half on a success. Within 60 feet of it, a bonus action moves it up to 60 feet.

name: Destructive Wave
description: Chosen creatures within 30 feet of you make a Constitution save: 5d6 thunder plus 5d6 radiant or necrotic (your choice) and knocked prone, or half damage only on a success.

name: Enervation
description: A creature within 60 feet makes a Dexterity save: 4d8 necrotic on a failure, and each turn you can spend your action to deal 4d8 necrotic automatically; 2d8 and the spell ends on a success. You heal half the necrotic damage dealt. Ends if you use your action otherwise or the target leaves range or gains total cover. +1d8 per slot level above 5th.

name: Enervation
description: Target within 60 feet makes a Dexterity save: 6d8 Necrotic on a failure, and on later turns a Bonus Action deals 2d8 Necrotic automatically. Half the initial damage on a success, and the spell ends. You heal half the Necrotic damage dealt. Ends if the target leaves range or gains Total Cover. +1d8 initial per slot level above 5.

name: Far Step
description: You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. On each of your turns before the spell ends you can use a bonus action to teleport in this way again.

name: Grave Ground
components: V, S, M (a handful of grave dirt)
description: Up to four contiguous 10-foot squares within 120 feet become Difficult Terrain for enemies. Enemies there, or entering or ending a turn there, make a Strength save (once per turn): 6d6 Necrotic and -1d6 on their damage rolls until the end of their next turn. +1d6 per slot level above 5.

name: Holy Weapon
description: You imbue a weapon you touch with holy power. It sheds bright light, deals extra radiant damage on hits, and can burst with radiant energy that blinds nearby enemies when the spell ends.

name: Immolation
description: One creature makes a Dexterity save: 8d6 fire (half on a success). On a failure it keeps burning, shedding light and taking 4d6 fire on each failed save at the end of its turns until it succeeds. Nonmagical means can't douse it, and a creature it kills turns to ash.

name: Infernal Calling
components: V, S, M (a ruby worth at least 999 gp)
description: You call forth a devil of challenge rating 6 or lower. It appears and may negotiate service; you must offer a suitable payment or risk it acting against your interests.

name: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance
components: V, S, M (a pinch of phosphorus)
description: A 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder of light and thunder: creatures inside are Blinded and Deafened and can't cast Verbal spells. Creatures in it, entering it, or ending a turn there make a Constitution save (once per turn) for 2d10 Radiant plus 2d10 Thunder, half on success. +1d10 to each per slot level above 5.

name: Maelstrom
components: V, S, M (paper or leaf in the shape of a funnel)
description: A swirling mass of water appears in a 30-foot radius. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Strength save or take bludgeoning damage and be pulled toward the center; the area is difficult terrain.

name: Mordenkainen's Lucubration
description: Recover up to two expended spell slots of level 2 or lower. Cast at level 6 or 7, the cap rises to level 3; at level 8 or higher, to level 4.

name: Negative Energy Flood
components: V, M (a broken bone and a square of black silk)
description: One non-undead creature makes a Constitution save for 5d12 necrotic, half on a success; anything it kills rises next turn as a zombie that attacks the nearest creature it sees. An undead target instead gains half of 5d12 as temporary hit points.

name: Negative Energy Flood
components: V, M (a broken bone and a square of black silk)
description: One creature within 60 feet. Non-Undead make a Constitution save for 3d10 + 25 Necrotic (half on success); a Humanoid it kills rises next turn as a Zombie that obeys you for 24 hours. An Undead target instead gains 3d10 Temporary Hit Points. +1d10 per slot level above 5.

name: Skill Empowerment
description: Your magic deepens a creature's understanding of its own talent. It gains expertise (double proficiency bonus) in one skill of your choice for the duration.

name: Songal's Elemental Suffusion
components: V, S, M (a pearl worth 100+ GP)
description: You gain Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder (your choice) and Fly 30 feet with hover. On casting and at the start of each of your turns, chosen creatures within 15 feet make a Dexterity save: 2d6 damage of a type you pick and Prone, half damage only on a success. As a Circle spell, it lasts longer and extends to more creatures.

name: Spirit Lantern
description: A floating lantern sheds 60 feet of Dim Light for 10 minutes and collects a soul fragment when an enemy dies in it, up to your spellcasting modifier. Bonus Action, spend a fragment: Drain Life (Constitution save, 4d8 + mod Necrotic, half on success), Repair Undead (heal 4d8 + mod), or Ward Ally (attacks against it have Disadvantage until your next turn).

name: Steel Wind Strike
components: S, M (a Melee weapon worth 1+ SP)
description: You flourish a weapon and vanish, teleporting to strike up to five creatures you can see within range with a single fluid motion. Make a melee spell attack against each; on a hit the target takes force damage.

name: Summon Celestial
components: V, S, M (a reliquary worth 500+ GP)
description: You call forth a celestial spirit that takes the form of an avenger or defender. It obeys your commands and has healing or radiant abilities based on its form.

name: Summon Draconic Spirit
components: V, S, M (an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it, worth at least 500 gp)
description: You summon a draconic spirit that takes the form of a chromatic, gem, or metallic dragon of your choice. It has a breath weapon and other traits matching its type.

name: Summon Plant
description: Summons a Large plant spirit (Fungus, Tree, or Vine) within 90 feet that acts right after you and obeys your commands. AC, HP, and attack count scale with slot level; the Fungus poisons at range, the Tree is armored and wrecks structures, the Vine climbs and can Dash or Disengage as a Bonus Action.

name: Swift Quiver
components: V, S, M (a Quiver worth 1+ GP)
description: You transmute your quiver so that it produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition. You can make two attacks with a weapon that uses ammunition as a bonus action on each of your turns.

name: Synaptic Static
description: You choose a point and cause psychic energy to explode there. Creatures in a 20-foot radius must succeed on an Intelligence save or take psychic damage and have their attack rolls, ability checks, and concentration saves penalized for a short time.

name: Transmute Rock
description: You choose an area of stone or mud and transmute it into the other substance. Stone becomes mud (difficult terrain that can restrain) or mud becomes stone (trapping creatures that fail a Dexterity save).

name: Wall of Light
description: You create a wall of brilliant light that can be shaped as a line or a ring. Creatures that pass through or start their turn in the wall take radiant damage and may be blinded; the wall also sheds bright light.

name: Waves of Exhaustion
components: V, S, M (a piece of dried meat)
description: Bonus Action to start. For up to 1 minute, a Magic action sends out a 60-foot Cone; each creature in it makes a Constitution save or gains 1 Exhaustion level (it can't push anyone past level 4). All Exhaustion from the spell ends when the spell does.

name: Wrath of Nature
description: You call on the spirits of nature to animate trees, vines, rocks, and weather in an area, creating multiple hazards that attack or hinder your enemies each turn.

name: Yolande's Regal Presence
description: A 10-foot Emanation of majesty for the duration: creatures it reaches, or that enter or end a turn in it, can be forced into a Wisdom save (once per turn) for 4d6 Psychic, Prone, and a 10-foot push, or half damage only on a success.

name: Arcane Gate
description: You create linked teleportation portals that remain open for the duration. Creatures can step through one to exit the other, and you can rotate the portals as a bonus action.

name: Bones of the Earth
description: You cause up to six pillars of stone to burst from places on the ground that you can see. Each pillar is a cylinder that can lift creatures or crush them against ceilings if they fail a Dexterity save.

name: Create Homunculus
components: V, S, M (clay, ash, and mandrake root, all of which the spell consumes, and a jewel-encrusted dagger worth at least 1,000 gp)
description: You create a homunculus by performing a special ritual with rare materials. The homunculus is permanently bound to you and serves as a loyal companion.

name: Dirge
description: A 60-foot Emanation of deathly power; you can exempt creatures. Others can't regain HP inside it, and when it reaches them or they enter or end a turn there they make a Constitution save (once per turn): 3d10 Necrotic and Prone, or half damage and halved Speed on a success. As a Circle spell it lasts longer and a failed save also adds Exhaustion that a Long Rest won't clear.

name: Druid Grove
components: V, S, M (mistletoe, which the spell consumes, that was harvested with a golden sickle under the light of a full moon)
description: You create a protected grove that lasts for an extended period. It provides benefits such as enhanced healing, alarm effects, and the ability to support additional plant or animal allies.

name: Elminster's Effulgent Spheres
components: V, S, M (an opal worth 1,000 GP+)
description: Six chromatic spheres orbit you. Reaction when you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage: spend one to resist that type until your next turn. Bonus Action: hurl one at a target within 120 feet (ranged spell attack, 3d6 of a type you choose). The spell ends when the last sphere is gone. One more sphere per slot level above 6.

name: Fizban's Platinum Shield
components: V, S, M (a platinum-plated dragon scale, worth at least 500 gp)
description: A field of silvery light around a creature (you included) grants half cover, resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison, and evasion on Dexterity saves. A bonus action on later turns moves the field to another creature within 60 feet.

name: Heroes' Feast
components: V, S, M (a gem-encrusted bowl worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: A feast for up to twelve creatures takes 1 hour to eat. For 24 hours afterward each diner resists Poison damage, is immune to the Frightened and Poisoned conditions, and has its HP maximum (and current HP) raised by 2d10. Consumes a 1,000 GP bowl.

name: Investiture of Flame
description: Flames race across your body, shedding bright light and granting immunity to fire damage. You can use an action to create a line of fire or cause fire damage to creatures that touch or hit you.

name: Investiture of Ice
description: Ice rimes your body, granting immunity to cold damage and the ability to create a cone of cold or make the ground icy around you.

name: Investiture of Stone
description: You gain a rocky hide that grants resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and you can cause the earth to tremble or move through stone.

name: Investiture of Wind
description: Wind whirls around you: ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage and you gain a 60-foot flying speed. As an action, a 15-foot cube of wind within 60 feet forces a Constitution save for 2d10 bludgeoning (half on success), pushing Large or smaller creatures that fail 10 feet.

name: Mental Prison
description: You attempt to bind a creature within an illusory cell that only it can perceive. On a failed Intelligence save it is trapped, taking psychic damage if it attempts to leave or if the illusion is interacted with in certain ways.

name: Primordial Ward
description: You resist acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage. When you take one of those types, a reaction swaps the resistances for immunity to that type (including the triggering damage) until the end of your next turn, when the spell ends.

name: Scatter
description: Up to five creatures you can see within range are teleported to unoccupied ground you can see within 120 feet of you; unwilling creatures can resist with a Wisdom save.

name: Soul Cage
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a humanoid you can see within 60 feet of you dies
components: V, S, M (a tiny silver cage worth 100 gp)
description: You snatch the soul of a humanoid that dies within range and trap it in a tiny cage. While trapped you can use the soul to ask questions, view its memories, or exploit it for other benefits a limited number of times.

name: Summon Dinosaur
components: V, S, M (polished scale worth 600+ GP)
description: Summons a Huge dinosaur spirit (Ankylosaur, Triceratops, or Tyrannosaur) within 90 feet that acts right after you and obeys your commands. AC, HP, and attack count scale with slot level; the Tyrannosaur bites and grapples, the Triceratops charges to knock Prone, the Ankylosaur is armored and wrecks structures.

name: Summon Fiend
components: V, S, M (a bloody vial worth 600+ GP)
description: Summon a fiendish spirit (Demon, Devil, or Yugoloth form) that uses the Fiendish Spirit stat block, acts right after you, and obeys your verbal commands; it Dodges if given none.

name: Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron
components: V, S, M (a gilded ladle worth 500+ GP)
description: A fixed cauldron appears beside you, brewing copies of one Common or Uncommon potion of your choice. You or an ally can take one as a Bonus Action, up to your spellcasting modifier in total (minimum 1); the spell ends when the last is taken. Unused potions vanish if you cast it again.

name: Tasha's Otherworldly Guise
components: V, S, M (an object engraved with a symbol of the Outer Planes, worth at least 500 gp)
description: Draw on the Lower or Upper Planes: immunity to fire and poison damage and the poisoned condition (Lower) or radiant and necrotic damage and the charmed condition (Upper), a 40-foot flying speed, +2 AC, magical weapon attacks that can use your spellcasting modifier, and two attacks per Attack action.

name: Tenser's Transformation
components: V, S, M (a few hairs from a bull)
description: You endow yourself with endurance and martial prowess. You gain temporary hit points, proficiency with martial weapons and armor, extra attacks, and other combat benefits, but cannot cast spells while transformed.

name: Aura of Evasion
description: 30-foot Emanation around you. You and allies inside have Advantage on Dexterity saves, take no damage on a successful save against half-damage effects, and only half on a failed one. Incapacitated creatures get no benefit.

name: Crown of Stars
description: Seven star-like motes of light appear and orbit your head. You can use a bonus action to send one mote streaking toward a creature, making a ranged spell attack that deals radiant damage.

name: Draconic Transformation
components: V, S, M (a statuette of a dragon, worth at least 500 gp)
description: You channel draconic power, growing spectral wings, gaining a breath weapon, blindsight, and other dragon-like traits for the duration.

name: Dream of the Blue Veil
components: V, S, M (a magic item or a willing creature from the destination world)
description: You and up to eight willing creatures project your minds into a shared dream that allows travel to another world or plane connected by the blue veil, with risks if the dream is disrupted.

name: Fractured Awareness
description: One creature within 120 feet makes an Intelligence save: 12d10 Psychic and Disadvantage on D20 Tests on a failure. Half damage on a success, and the spell ends. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Power Word Fortify
description: Divide 120 Temporary Hit Points among up to six creatures you can see within range.

name: Power Word Pain
description: One creature with 100 hit points or fewer (not immune to being charmed) is wracked with pain: Speed capped at 10 feet, disadvantage on attacks, checks, and saves other than Constitution, and it must pass a Constitution save to cast a spell. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. No damage.

name: Power Word Pain
description: One creature within 60 feet takes 6d8 Force. If it has 100 HP or fewer it is also Charmed for up to 1 minute: Speed capped at 10 feet, Disadvantage on D20 Tests except Constitution saves, and it must pass a Constitution save to cast a spell (a failed cast keeps its slot). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Reweave Fate
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you fails a D20 Test
description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet fails a D20 Test: it rerolls with Advantage and must use the new roll. On a success it gains 6d10 Temporary Hit Points.

name: Simbul's Synostodweomer
description: Imbue a creature you touch for the duration: whenever it casts a spell with a slot, it can spend Hit Point Dice equal to the slot level and regain HP equal to the roll plus your spellcasting modifier.

name: Temple of the Gods
components: V, S, M (a holy symbol worth at least 5 gp)
description: You create a temple that is protected against certain creature types and provides benefits to worshippers of your deity, including enhanced healing and warding effects that last for an extended period.

name: Transfix
description: One creature within 60 feet makes a Charisma save or is Charmed and Incapacitated, walking straight toward you and taking 4d8 Psychic if it ends a turn within 5 feet of you. It rerolls before entering harmful terrain. Each later turn, a Magic action targets a new creature. +1d8 per slot level above 7.

name: Abi-Dalzim's Horrid Wilting
components: V, S, M (a bit of sponge)
description: Creatures in a 30-foot cube make a Constitution save for 12d8 necrotic, half on a success; constructs and undead are unaffected, and plants and water elementals save with disadvantage. Ordinary plants there wither and die.

name: Entrancing Mirrors
description: Up to three creatures within 90 feet make an Intelligence save: 7d6 Psychic and Stunned with halved Speed on a failure, half damage on a success. A Stunned target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Holy Star of Mystra
description: A glowing mote hovers over you, giving you Three-Quarters Cover. On casting and as a Bonus Action later, it fires a bolt at a creature within 120 feet (ranged spell attack, 4d10 + your spellcasting modifier Force or Radiant). When you succeed on a save against a single-target spell of level 7 or lower, a Reaction turns it back on its caster.

name: Illusory Dragon
description: A Huge shadow dragon appears within 120 feet, immune to damage and conditions. Enemies who see it make a Wisdom save or are frightened for 1 minute. As a bonus action you move it 60 feet and can breathe a 60-foot cone: Intelligence save for 7d6 of a damage type chosen at casting, half on a success. An Investigation check reveals the illusion.

name: Illusory Dragon
description: A tangible Huge shadow dragon appears within 120 feet, immune to damage and conditions. Enemies who see it make a Wisdom save or drop what they hold and are Frightened. Bonus Action: move it 60 feet and breathe a 60-foot Cone, Intelligence save for 6d6 of a damage type you chose (half on success). A Study action and Investigation check can reveal it.

name: Lightning Ring
components: V, S, M (a bit of fur and a glass ring)
description: Bonus Action. A 10-foot Emanation crackles around you; creatures it reaches, or that enter or end a turn in it, can be forced into a Constitution save for 3d6 Lightning plus 3d6 Thunder and Deafened for 1 minute (half damage only on a success). Magic action: a 60-foot Line, Dexterity save for 6d6 Lightning (half on success).

name: Maddening Darkness
components: V, M (a drop of pitch mixed with a drop of mercury)
description: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose, filling a 60-foot-radius sphere. Creatures in the darkness take psychic damage at the start of their turns on a failed Wisdom save, and the darkness can't be illuminated by nonmagical means.

name: Mighty Fortress
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: You conjure a fortress of stone that fills a square area. It has multiple floors, defensive features, and remains for seven days or until you dismiss it. Creatures inside are protected from weather and some magical detection.

name: Moment of Prescience
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when you fail a D20 Test or when a creature hits you with an attack roll
description: Reaction when you fail a D20 Test or are hit by an attack: your roll becomes a 20, or the attacker's roll becomes a 1.

name: Telepathy
components: V, S, M (a pair of linked silver rings)
description: You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature. You can communicate telepathically across any distance as long as you are on the same plane, and the link lasts until you dismiss it or one of you dies.

name: Tsunami
description: A wall of water 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick appears and surges forward. Creatures caught in it must succeed on a Strength save or take bludgeoning damage and be swept away; the water continues moving for several turns.

name: Blade of Disaster
description: A 3-foot planar rift makes two melee spell attacks on casting (4d12 force each, crits on 18 or higher for an extra 8d12) and, as a bonus action each turn, moves 30 feet and attacks twice again. It passes through any barrier, including a wall of force.

name: Blade of Disaster
description: A 3-foot planar rift makes two melee spell attacks on casting (10d6 Force each, Critical Hit on 18 or higher) and, as a Bonus Action on later turns, moves 60 feet and attacks twice again. It passes through any barrier, including Wall of Force.

name: Detonate
components: V, S, M (a piece of tinder)
description: Target within 500 feet makes a Constitution save, taking 10d10 Fire (half on success). Then everything else in a 60-foot Emanation around it makes a Dexterity save for 10d10 Fire (half on success), with Disadvantage if the first target dropped to 0 HP. Unattended flammable objects ignite.

name: Hindsight
components: V, S, M (a tiny hourglass worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: 10-minute cast; consumes a 500 GP hourglass. Watch past events within 500 feet over the last 10 years at about a day per second, pausing, rewinding, or skipping as you like.

name: Invulnerability
components: V, S, M (a piece of adamantine worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You have Immunity to all damage for up to 10 minutes. Consumes a 500 GP piece of adamantine.

name: Iron Body
components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth 250+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: A willing creature you touch becomes living metal for up to 1 hour: its Exhaustion can't increase, it resists Bludgeoning, Fire, Piercing, and Slashing, and it is immune to Poison damage and the Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned conditions, ending any of those it has. Consumes 250 GP of diamond dust.

name: Mass Polymorph
description: You transform up to ten creatures of your choice within range into new forms of challenge rating equal to or less than their own. Unwilling creatures must succeed on a Wisdom save to resist.

name: Power Word Heal
description: A wave of healing energy washes over a creature you can see. It regains all its hit points and is cured of certain conditions such as charmed, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned.

name: Psychic Scream
description: You unleash the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see. On a failed Intelligence save a target takes psychic damage and is stunned.

name: Vision of Elapsing Eons
description: One creature within 120 feet makes an Intelligence save or takes 10d12 Psychic and is Paralyzed for up to 1 minute. Each failed repeat save at the end of its turns adds an Exhaustion level; a success ends it. Someone within 5 feet can use an action to shake it free.

name: Wail of the Banshee
description: Up to ten creatures within 60 feet that can hear you. Any with 50 HP or fewer die. The rest make a Constitution save: 12d10 Psychic and Deafened for 1 hour on a failure, half damage only on a success.

name: Dragon's Breath
description: A willing creature you touch can, until the spell ends, take a Magic action to exhale a 15-foot Cone of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison (chosen at casting): Dexterity save for 3d6, half on a success. +1d6 per slot level above 2.

name: Homunculus Servant
components: V, S, M (a gem worth 100+ GP)
description: Summon a Tiny homunculus (Homunculus Servant stat block) that replaces any earlier one. It acts right after you, obeys you, Dodges if given no orders, and can deliver your touch spells within 120 feet as a Reaction. A higher slot raises its Hit Points and Force Strike.

name: Chaos Bolt
description: Ranged spell attack against one creature: 2d8 + 1d6 damage. Pick one of the d8s; its number sets the type (1 Acid, 2 Cold, 3 Fire, 4 Force, 5 Lightning, 6 Poison, 7 Psychic, 8 Thunder). If both d8s match, the bolt leaps to a different creature of your choice within 30 feet of the target: new attack, new damage, and it can leap again. Each creature can be targeted only once per casting. +1d6 per slot level above 1st, to each target.

name: Dust Devil
components: V, S, M (a pinch of dust)
description: A dust devil fills an unoccupied 5-foot cube of air in range. A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of it makes a Strength save: 1d8 bludgeoning and pushed 10 feet on a failure, half damage and no push on a success. As a bonus action you move it up to 30 feet; passing over sand, dust, loose dirt or small gravel, it raises a 10-foot-radius cloud of debris that heavily obscures the area until the start of your next turn. +1d8 per slot level above 2nd.

name: Whirlwind
description: A 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder of wind on the ground in range; your action moves it up to 30 feet along the ground, and it picks up unsecured Medium or smaller objects. A creature makes a Dexterity save the first time on a turn it enters the whirlwind or the whirlwind enters its space: 10d6 bludgeoning, half on a success. A Large or smaller creature that fails also makes a Strength save or is restrained inside, rising 5 feet at the start of each of its turns, moving with it and falling when the spell ends. As an action it can make a Strength or Dexterity check against your spell save DC to break free, then is flung 3d6 x 10 feet in a random direction.

name: Sword Burst
description: Spectral blades sweep around you: every other creature within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 force. The damage rises to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th and 4d6 at 17th.

name: Antagonize
components: V, S, M (a playing card depicting a rogue)
description: One creature in range makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 4d4 psychic damage and must at once use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature you choose and can see; if it can't, it instead has disadvantage on its next attack roll before your next turn starts. On a success it takes half damage only. +1d4 per slot level above 3rd.

name: Spirit of Death
components: V, S, M (a gilded playing card worth 400+ gp depicting an avatar of death)
description: A reaper spirit appears in an unoccupied space you can see in range, using the reaper spirit stat block, until it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends. It is your ally, acts right after you on your initiative, and follows your verbal commands (no action); without commands it Dodges and avoids danger. Cast with a higher slot, use that level wherever the stat block refers to the spell's level.

name: Spray of Cards
components: V, S, M (a deck of cards)
description: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 2d10 force damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn; on a success it takes half damage only. +1d10 per slot level above 2nd.

name: Borrowed Knowledge
components: V, S, M (a book worth at least 25 gp)
description: Gain proficiency in one skill you lack for the duration; casting it again ends the previous casting.

name: Kinetic Jaunt
description: +10 feet walking speed, no opportunity attacks against you, and you move through creatures' spaces without it counting as difficult terrain; ending your turn in one shunts you back to your last free space and deals you 1d8 force.

name: Vortex Warp
description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save (it can choose to fail) or you teleport it to an unoccupied space you can see within range that can support it. +30 feet range per slot level above 2nd.

name: Wither and Bloom
components: V, S, M (a withered vine twisted into a loop)
description: Creatures of your choice in a 10-foot-radius sphere make a Constitution save, 2d6 necrotic (half on success); nonmagical plants wither. One creature there can spend and roll a Hit Die, healing that plus your spellcasting modifier. Per slot level above 2nd: +1d6 damage and one more Hit Die.

name: Air Bubble
description: A willing creature you can see gets a globe of fresh air around its head (one head, if it has several) for the duration, preventing suffocation. Two more globes per slot level above 2nd.

name: Create Spelljamming Helm
components: V, S, M (a crystal rod worth at least 5,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: Holding the rod, you touch an unoccupied Large or smaller chair; the rod vanishes and the chair becomes a spelljamming helm.

name: Sapping Sting
description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save or takes 1d4 necrotic and falls prone. Damage rises to 2d4 at 5th level, 3d4 at 11th and 4d4 at 17th.

name: Gift of Alacrity
description: A willing creature you touch adds 1d8 to its initiative rolls for the duration.

name: Magnify Gravity
description: Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere make a Constitution save: 2d8 force and half speed until the end of their next turn, or half damage only. Until your next turn, unattended objects there need a Strength check against your spell save DC to move. +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Fortune's Favor
components: V, S, M (a white pearl worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: You or a willing creature can end the spell to roll an extra d20 on an attack roll, check or save, or when attacked, choosing which die to use (rolled after advantage or disadvantage). One more target per slot level above 2nd.

name: Immovable Object
components: V, S, M (gold dust worth at least 25 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: An object of 10 pounds or less is fixed in place; you and creatures you name can move it, and a password spoken within 5 feet suppresses the spell for 1 minute. In the air it holds up to 4,000 pounds; otherwise an action and a Strength check against your spell save DC moves it 10 feet. At 4th or 5th level: DC +5, 8,000 pounds, 24 hours. At 6th or higher: DC +10, 20,000 pounds, permanent until dispelled.

name: Wristpocket
description: An object of 5 pounds or less in your hand vanishes into an extradimensional space; as an action you can summon it to your free hand or send it back. It appears at your feet when the spell ends.

name: Pulse Wave
description: Each creature in the cone makes a Constitution save, 6d6 force, half on success; those that fail are pulled 15 feet toward you or pushed 15 feet away (your choice), as are unsecured objects fully in the cone. +1d6 and +5 feet per slot level above 3rd.

name: Gravity Sinkhole
description: Creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere make a Constitution save: 5d10 force and pulled to the space nearest the center (even in the air), or half damage and no pull. +1d10 per slot level above 4th.

name: Temporal Shunt
casting_time: 1 reaction, when a creature you can see makes an attack roll or starts to cast a spell
description: The triggering creature makes a Wisdom save or vanishes into another moment, its attack missing or spell wasted; it reappears at the start of its next turn in its space or the nearest free one, remembering nothing of it. One more target per slot level above 5th, all within 30 feet of each other.

name: Gravity Fissure
components: V, S, M (a fistful of iron filings)
description: Creatures in a 100-foot by 5-foot line make a Constitution save, 8d8 force, half on success. Creatures within 10 feet of the line make a Constitution save or take 8d8 force and are pulled into it. +1d8 per slot level above 6th.

name: Tether Essence
components: V, S, M (a spool of platinum cord worth at least 250 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: Two creatures you can see make Constitution saves (disadvantage if within 30 feet of each other; either can fail willingly). If both fail, damage and healing to one apply equally to the other until either drops to 0 HP or the spell ends for both.

name: Dark Star
components: V, S, M (a shard of onyx and a drop of your blood, both consumed)
description: A sphere of radius up to 40 feet fills with magical darkness (darkvision can't pierce it, nonmagical light fails) and crushing gravity: difficult terrain, total silence (creatures inside are deafened and immune to thunder, and verbal spells are impossible). A creature entering for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Constitution save, 8d10 force, half on success; one reduced to 0 HP is disintegrated with its nonmagical gear.

name: Reality Break
description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or can't take reactions and rolls a d10 at the start of each of its turns: 1-2, 6d12 psychic and stunned until the end of the turn; 3-5, Dexterity save, 8d12 force, half on success; 6-8, teleported up to 30 feet to a space you choose, 10d12 force and prone; 9-10, 10d12 cold and blinded until the end of the turn. It repeats the save at the end of each turn to end the spell.

name: Ravenous Void
components: V, S, M (a small, nine-pointed iron star)
description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of gravity appears; it and everything within 100 feet of it is difficult terrain, and unattended nonmagical objects inside are destroyed. When it appears and at the start of each of your turns, unsecured objects within 100 feet are drawn to its center. A creature starting its turn within 100 feet makes a Strength save or is pulled to the center. A creature entering the sphere for the first time on a turn or starting there takes 5d10 force and is restrained while inside (an action and a Strength check against your spell save DC frees one in reach). A creature reduced to 0 HP is annihilated with its nonmagical gear.

name: Time Ravage
components: V, S, M (an hourglass of diamond dust worth at least 5,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save, 10d12 necrotic, half on success. On a failure it also ages until it has 30 days to live, with disadvantage on attack rolls, checks and saves and half walking speed; only wish or a 9th-level greater restoration reverses this.

name: Distort Value
description: An object up to 1 foot on a side seems worth double or half its value through illusory polish or wear; an Int (Investigation) check against your spell save DC reveals its true worth. +1 foot of size per slot level above 1st.

name: Jim's Magic Missile
description: Three darts each make a ranged spell attack against creatures you can see in range, dealing 2d4 force on a hit, or 5d4 force on a critical hit. If any attack roll is a 1, all darts miss and explode on you for 1 force each. One more dart and +1 gp royalty per slot level above 1st. Royalty component: the listed gold must be on your person and is magically sent to the spell's creator when cast; without it you can't cast the spell.

name: Gift of Gab
casting_time: 1 reaction, when you speak to another creature
description: Chosen creatures within 5 feet forget what you said in the last 6 seconds and instead remember the words you speak as this spell's verbal component. Royalty component: the listed gold must be on your person and is magically sent to the spell's creator when cast; without it you can't cast the spell.

name: Jim's Glowing Coin
description: The thrown coin glows like light; chosen creatures you can see within 30 feet of it make a Wisdom save or are distracted for the duration, with disadvantage on Wis (Perception) checks and initiative rolls. Royalty component: the listed gold must be on your person and is magically sent to the spell's creator when cast; without it you can't cast the spell.

name: Fast Friends
description: A Humanoid that can see, hear and understand you makes a Wisdom save or is charmed, cheerfully doing tasks you set. A task that would harm it or go against its nature allows a new save (with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it), and a task meaning certain death ends the spell. It knows it was charmed afterward. One more target per slot level above 3rd.

name: Incite Greed
components: V, S, M (a gem worth at least 50 gp)
description: Any number of creatures in range that can see you make a Wisdom save or are charmed until the spell ends or you or your allies harm them, able only to approach you safely and then stand staring at the gem once within 5 feet. Each repeats the save at the end of its turns.

name: Motivational Speech
description: Up to five creatures that can hear you gain 5 temporary HP and advantage on Wisdom saves, and when hit by an attack have advantage on their next attack roll; the spell ends for a creature when those temporary HP are gone. +5 temporary HP per slot level above 3rd.

name: Conjure Tools
description: A set of Artisan's Tools of your choice appears, and you are proficient with them. They vanish when the spell ends (anything made with them stays), and the spell ends early if you recast it or move more than 10 feet from them. With a level 3 slot, you craft nonmagical items as fast as two characters.

name: Conjure Tools
