description: A set of Artisan's Tools of your choice appears, and you are proficient with them. They vanish when the spell ends (anything made with them stays), and the spell ends early if you recast it or move more than 10 feet from them. With a level 3 slot, you craft nonmagical items as fast as two characters.

name: Feign Interest
description: You look fully focused and attentive for the duration, whatever you are really doing, even napping. A creature that uses a Search action to read your state of mind sees through it with a Wisdom (Insight) check against your spell save DC.

name: Feign Interest
description: You look fully focused and attentive for the duration, whatever you are really doing, even napping. A creature that uses a Search action to read your state of mind sees through it with a Wisdom (Insight) check against your spell save DC.

name: Pinky Swear
description: You touch a creature and make a promise of up to 25 words. If you knowingly break it during the spell, the target learns of it if within 1 mile, and you catch fire, taking 1 Fire damage at the start of each of your turns.

name: Pinky Swear
description: You touch a creature and make a promise of up to 25 words. If you knowingly break it during the spell, the target learns of it if within 1 mile, and you catch fire, taking 1 Fire damage at the start of each of your turns.

name: Quick Clothier
components: V, S, M (a set of clothing)
description: You restyle a set of nonmagical clothing no one else is wearing: color, cut, decoration and form, worth up to 15 GP (rags to fine clothes, or the reverse). It reverts when the spell ends.

name: Quick Clothier
components: V, S, M (a set of clothing)
description: You restyle a set of nonmagical clothing no one else is wearing: color, cut, decoration and form, worth up to 15 GP (rags to fine clothes, or the reverse). It reverts when the spell ends.

name: Searing Orb
components: S, M (metallic flakes and a pinch of phosphorus)
description: Ranged spell attack against one creature: 3d4 Radiant on a hit. Hit or miss, the orb bursts; the target and each creature within 10 feet of it make a Constitution save or have the Blinded condition until the end of their next turn. +1d4 per slot level above 2.

name: Searing Orb
components: S, M (metallic flakes and a pinch of phosphorus)
description: Ranged spell attack against one creature: 3d4 Radiant on a hit. Hit or miss, the orb bursts; the target and each creature within 10 feet of it make a Constitution save or have the Blinded condition until the end of their next turn. +1d4 per slot level above 2.

name: Tortoise Shell
description: A willing creature you touch grows a hard shell and gains +3 AC. If it moves or uses its action, bonus action, or reaction, the bonus drops to +1 until the start of its next turn.

name: Tortoise Shell
description: A willing creature you touch grows a hard shell and gains +3 AC. If it moves or uses its action, Bonus Action, or Reaction, the bonus drops to +1 until the start of its next turn.

name: Void Star
components: V, S, M (a fragment of a meteorite)
description: Ranged spell attack against one creature you can see: 6d12 Necrotic on a hit. Hit or miss, it takes 3d12 Necrotic at the end of its next turn and you regain that many Hit Points. Both amounts +1d12 per slot level above 7.

name: Void Star
components: V, S, M (a fragment of a meteorite)
description: Ranged spell attack against one creature you can see: 6d12 Necrotic on a hit. Hit or miss, it takes 3d12 Necrotic at the end of its next turn and you regain that many Hit Points. Both amounts +1d12 per slot level above 7.

name: Astral Flood
components: V, S, M (a mixture of water and powdered silver)
description: Pick Cold or Radiant. Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save: 4d10 of that type on a failure (half on a success). A failed save against Cold also gives Disadvantage on its next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw before the end of your next turn; against Radiant, the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn. +1d10 per slot level above 3.

name: Astral Flood
components: V, S, M (a mixture of water and powdered silver)
description: Pick Cold or Radiant. Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save: 4d10 of that type on a failure (half on a success). A failed save against Cold also gives Disadvantage on its next D20 Test before the end of your next turn; against Radiant, the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn. +1d10 per slot level above 3.

name: Buzzing Bee
components: V, S, M (a dab of honey)
description: A loud spectral bee hovers around a creature you can see. It has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks, Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and Concentration saves, and gains no benefit from the Invisible condition. The bee ends if the target goes more than 120 feet from you.

name: Buzzing Bee
components: V, S, M (a dab of honey)
description: A loud spectral bee hovers around a creature you can see. It has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks, Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and Concentration saves, and gains no benefit from the Invisible condition. The bee ends if the target goes more than 120 feet from you.

name: Insidious Rhythm
description: A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on Intelligence checks and Concentration saves as a tune loops in its head. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. One extra target per slot level above 1.

name: Insidious Rhythm
description: A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on Intelligence checks and Concentration saves as a tune loops in its head. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. One extra target per slot level above 1.

name: Leomund's Lamentable Belaborment
description: You make a provocative statement. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere within range makes an Intelligence save or is Charmed for the duration (no shared language or Intelligence under 3 means automatic success). A Charmed target spends its turns arguing the point, has Speed 0, and is Blinded and Deafened to everyone but you and other targets. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Leomund's Lamentable Belaborment
description: You make a provocative statement. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere within range makes an Intelligence save or is Charmed for the duration (no shared language or Intelligence under 3 means automatic success). A Charmed target spends its turns arguing the point, has Speed 0, and is Blinded and Deafened to everyone but you and other targets. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Sticks to Snakes
components: V, S, M (a small piece of bark and several snake scales)
description: Up to four nonmagical sticks (quarterstaff size or smaller wood such as torches or spears) you can see become Venomous Snakes; a creature holding one can make a Charisma save to stop it. The snakes are Friendly to you, act right after you, and obey your bonus action commands within 500 feet, otherwise Dodging. At 0 HP a snake reverts, extra damage carrying to the object. Two more objects per slot level above 4.

name: Sticks to Snakes
components: V, S, M (a small piece of bark and several snake scales)
description: Up to four nonmagical sticks (quarterstaff size or smaller wood such as torches or spears) you can see become Venomous Snakes; a creature holding one can make a Charisma save to stop it. The snakes are Friendly to you, act right after you, and obey your Bonus Action commands within 500 feet, otherwise Dodging. At 0 HP a snake reverts, extra damage carrying to the object. Two more objects per slot level above 4.

name: Arboreal Curse
components: V, S, M (a cup of sap)
description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save. Failure: it is Restrained as its flesh turns to bark; success: Speed 0 until the start of your next turn. While Restrained it saves at the end of each turn: three successes end it, three failures turn it into a tree (Petrified). Destroying the tree kills it. Greater Restoration or Wish reverses it within a year; after a year and a day it is permanent.

name: Arcane Aegis
components: S, M (a statuette of a hedgehog)
description: Gain 2d10 Temporary Hit Points. A creature that hits you with a melee attack takes Force damage equal to the temp HP the hit removed. The spell ends when the temp HP are gone. +2d10 temp HP per slot level above 1.

name: Assisted Aim
description: Up to three creatures gain +1 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons, and those weapons' normal and long ranges double. One extra creature per slot level above 1.

name: Binding Pledge
components: V, S, M (a book of religious or legal importance)
description: A willing creature makes a promise, oath, or contract. If it breaks it during the spell you know at once and thereafter know its distance and direction; you also know if the spell is dispelled. Duration becomes 30 days with a level 3-4 slot, 1 year with level 5-6, and until dispelled with level 7+.

name: Bloat
description: A creature makes a Constitution save: 3d10 Necrotic, half on success. If the damage equals or exceeds its Constitution score, it floats 5 feet up until the start of your next turn, moving only by pulling along surfaces, then drifts down.

name: Bloodbane Rune
description: Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die as part of casting or it fails. A weapon you touch weeps red near Undead within 30 feet, and once per turn your hit with it on an Undead adds Radiant damage equal to a roll of the spent Hit Dice. One extra Hit Die per slot level above 1; Concentration lasts up to 10 minutes at level 2 and 1 hour at level 3+.

name: Bloodletter
description: A nonmagical weapon you touch festers the first creature it hits: Constitution save or it takes 2d6 Necrotic at the start of each of its turns for the duration (one wound at a time). Any healing ends it. +1d6 per slot level above 2.

name: Blood Bond
components: V, S, M (a rag soaked in your own blood)
description: Sangromancy. Spend three Hit Dice or it fails; the touched creature gains temp HP equal to their roll. For the duration you know its direction and distance, talk telepathically, and can target it with your Self or Touch spells at any range on the same plane. If it ends the spell early it loses the temp HP and takes that much Necrotic. Duration 8 hours with a level 5-6 slot, 24 hours at 7-8, 7 days at 9.

name: Blood Rush
description: Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. Roll it twice and regain the total plus your spellcasting modifier. One extra Hit Die per slot level above 1.

name: Blood Tide
description: Sangromancy. Spend six Hit Dice or it fails. A 100-foot by 10-foot Line of blood: Dexterity save or pushed 100 feet along it, Prone, and Bludgeoning equal to the Hit Dice roll + spellcasting modifier; half damage only on success. One extra Hit Die per slot level above 6.

name: Blood Wisp
components: V, S, M (a ruby worth 10 GP)
description: Sangromancy. Spend two Hit Dice or it fails. A red wisp circles you with HP equal to their roll + your spellcasting modifier, AC 10 + that modifier, and your saves. When you roll spell damage you can reroll one die; the wisp takes damage equal to the new roll, and the spell ends at 0 HP. One extra Hit Die per slot level above 2.

name: Boil Blood
description: Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. A willing creature takes Fire damage equal to the Hit Die's roll and stops being Poisoned.

name: Burst Forth
description: Sangromancy. Spend seven Hit Dice or it fails. Teleport inside a creature you can see and burst out to the nearest open space. It makes a Constitution save, taking Necrotic equal to the Hit Dice roll + spellcasting modifier, half on success. One extra Hit Die per slot level above 7.

name: Calling Card
components: S, M (a stamp carved like the mark left by your calling card)
description: Leave a visible or Invisible magical mark on a corpse you touch. Anyone who uses a Study action to examine the corpse finds it.

name: Call the Rabid Beast
components: V, S, M (a fang from a rabid animal)
description: A touched creature becomes a rabid beast and gains 20 temp HP. It has AC 17 if lower, +5 to Strength-based damage, a Bonus Action Bite (1d6 + Str mod Slashing), immunity to Frightened, and can't cast spells or concentrate. At the start of each turn it makes a DC 10 Wisdom save or loses control for the rest of the spell, attacking the nearest creature each turn.

name: Chains of Beleth
description: Hooked chains fill a 20-foot-radius Sphere within range. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save: 8d6 Piercing and Restrained while there on a failure. A creature entering or starting its turn there saves or is Restrained. A Restrained creature can use an action for an Athletics check against your DC to escape, and takes 3d6 Bludgeoning at the end of each of its turns. +1d6 to both per slot level above 6.

name: Circle of Scarlet
components: V, S, M (a piece of parchment with a circle drawn in humanoid blood)
description: Sangromancy. Spend four Hit Dice or it fails. A 20-foot-radius, 100-foot-high Cylinder of blood erupts; each creature in it makes a Constitution save, taking Necrotic equal to the Hit Dice roll + spellcasting modifier, half on success. Gain 10 temp HP for each creature that fails.

name: Conjure Plants
description: A Large mass of animated plants appears within range. You are Lightly Obscured within 5 feet of it, others can't enter its space, and it moves up to 30 feet when you move. When it comes within 5 feet of a creature, or a creature enters or ends its turn within 5 feet of it, you can force a Dexterity save (once per turn) for 3d6 Slashing. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Consume Mind
components: V, S, M (a 1-ounce fresh or magically preserved portion of another creature's brain)
description: Eat part of a dead, non-Undead creature's brain (dead under 3 days unless preserved). For the hour, as a Magic action make a spellcasting ability check against its Intelligence score to recall one memory; you get one try per piece of information.

name: Consumption
description: Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. A creature within range takes Necrotic equal to the Hit Die roll, and takes it again at the end of each of its turns until it succeeds on a Constitution save. One extra target per slot level above 1.

name: Creeping Death
description: Sangromancy. Spend eight Hit Dice or it fails. Their roll sets the target's Creeping Death threshold: if its HP drop to that number or lower, it dies. As a Bonus Action force a Constitution save; add 2d6 to the threshold on a failure or half on a success. Three successful saves end the spell.

name: Creeping Touch
description: Your hand detaches and becomes a Spider you can talk to telepathically within 100 feet; as a Magic action you see and hear through it until your next turn, unaware of your own surroundings. Call it back with a Bonus Action. If it dies or doesn't return before the spell ends, your hand regrows and you take 1d6 Psychic.

name: Crimson Lash
description: Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. A blood whip forms: a proficient Simple weapon with Light, Finesse, and Reach that uses your spellcasting modifier, deals Necrotic with a die equal to the Hit Die spent, and reduces the target's HP maximum by the damage dealt. With a level 3-4 slot you attack twice with it per Attack action; level 5+ three times.

name: Crown of Radiance
description: A crown of holy fire sheds Bright Light 30 feet and Dim Light 30 more. Any Fiend, Fey, or Undead that moves within 30 feet of you or starts its turn there takes 2d8 Radiant.

name: Dark Sacrament
components: V, S, M (a dagger encrusted in jewels worth 100+ GP)
description: Sangromancy. Spend four Hit Dice or it fails. Make a melee spell attack with the dagger: on a hit, Necrotic equal to the Hit Dice roll + 4d8. If it kills the target, gain a dark blessing for 10 minutes (or until you drop to 0 HP): Unassailable (Advantage on all saves), Unbreakable (grow one size, temp HP equal to Con mod each turn, +1d4 weapon damage), or Unerring (+2 Proficiency Bonus). While blessed, Radiant damage hurts you for an extra 1d4. +1d8 per slot level above 4.

name: Dazing Blast
description: A creature makes a Constitution save: 2d6 Force and Stunned until the end of its next turn on a failure, damage only on success. One extra target per slot level above 2.

name: Earth Worm
description: An earthen maw rises within range. As a Bonus Action make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it: 3d8 + spellcasting modifier Piercing, and a Large or smaller target makes a Dexterity save or is swallowed (Blinded, Restrained, Total Cover, 6d6 Bludgeoning at the start of each of your turns). A swallowed creature escapes with an action and an Athletics check against your DC, landing Prone within 10 feet. Move the worm 30 feet as a Bonus Action.

name: Elemental Exhalation
description: Pick an element; each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d6 of its type (half and no extra effect on success). Air (Thunder): pushed 10 feet. Coldfire (Cold): Frightened until the start of your next turn. Earth (Bludgeoning): Speed 0 until the end of its next turn. Fire: burns for 2d6 Fire at the end of its next turn unless put out (an action dropping Prone, or dousing). Water (Acid): Prone. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Emmeline's Essence Infusion
components: V, S, M (a diamond vial holding at least an ounce of blood, worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: A nonmagical weapon becomes a magic weapon that requires Attunement (you attune on casting), with a benefit set by the blood used. Aberration: +1d6 Psychic and telepathy with anything it hurt in the last 24 hours. Celestial: +1d6 Radiant and Bonus Action light (30 feet bright, 30 dim). Dragon: crit on 19-20 and Advantage on saves against Frightened. Fey: +1d4 Force and, once per turn on a hit within 30 feet, teleport next to the target. Fiend: +1d6 Necrotic, switchable to Cold or Fire as a Bonus Action. Lasts while you stay attuned (Dispel Magic can end it) and becomes permanent after a year.

name: Enspelled Armament
components: M (a vial of oil and water)
description: An energy copy of a Simple or Martial weapon appears in your hand. You are proficient with it, use your spellcasting modifier for attack and damage, deal Force damage, need no ammunition, and it returns after being thrown. +1d4 damage per slot level above 2; 8-hour duration with a level 5+ slot.

name: Extract Iron
description: Sangromancy. Spend three Hit Dice or it fails. Pull pounds of iron equal to their roll from your blood and shape it into crude but working nonmagical metal objects of that total weight. One more Hit Die per slot level above 3.

name: Fiend Flesh
components: V, S, M (a handful of sulfur)
description: A willing creature you touch grows red scales: Resistance to Cold, Fire, and Lightning, and Immunity to Poison damage.

name: Flash Fever
description: A creature makes a Constitution save; on a failure it takes 4d6 Fire, on a success the spell ends. While it lasts the target takes 2d6 Fire at the start of each turn and repeats the save each turn: three successes end it, three failures deal 8d6 Fire and end it. Initial damage +1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Flense
description: Ranged spell attack: 8d6 Necrotic on a hit. On each later turn, as a Magic action force the same creature to make a Constitution save for 8d6 Necrotic (half on success), even if the first attack missed. Ends if it leaves range, drops to 0 HP, or you can't see it.

name: Fleshcrawl
description: A creature makes a Constitution save: 8d10 Necrotic, and its flayed skin rises as your Fleshling Construct (AC 11 + spell level, HP 70 + 10 per level above 7; Strangle grapples, silences, and suffocates for 2d8 + spell level Bludgeoning; Constrict repeats that damage). Half damage and no construct on success. It acts after you, obeys spoken commands, and vanishes at 0 HP or when the spell ends.

name: Frightful Start
description: A creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened until the start of your next turn.

name: Ghost Light
description: An object up to 10 feet across sheds silvery Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light 20 more, visible only to creatures you chose within 10 feet when casting.

name: Greater Animate Dead
components: V, S, M (a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, a pinch of bone dust, and a black onyx worth 75+ GP per CR animated)
description: Raise up to five Undead of CR 2 or lower from corpses in range. Command any or all within 120 feet with a Bonus Action; uncommanded they only defend themselves. Control lasts 24 hours; recasting on up to four of them renews it without costly components. One more creature per slot level above 5.

name: Heartseeker
components: V, S, M (a ruby worth 100+ GP)
description: Sangromancy. Spend six Hit Dice or it fails. Ranged spell attack with a blood arrow: Piercing equal to the Hit Dice roll on a hit. While it burrows, the first hit against the target after each of its turns is a crit. It makes a Constitution save at the end of each turn; on a success it takes 3d8 Necrotic and the spell ends.

name: Holy Word
description: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 Radiant. A Fey, Fiend, or Undead hit also loses 10 feet of Speed and can't take Reactions until the end of its next turn. Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, and 4d8 at 17.

name: Hunter Sense
description: A willing creature you touch treats d20 rolls of 9 or lower on Wisdom (Perception) checks as 10.

name: Illusory Instrument
description: An illusory copy of a mundane instrument, tangible only to you, that works as a Spellcasting Focus and ends if you move 10 feet from it. As a Bonus Action it can mimic everyday sounds, keep a beat, or record and loop what it plays or hears within 15 feet.

name: Incite Riot
description: Any number of creatures in range that can see you make a Wisdom save (with Advantage if your side is fighting them) or are Charmed and Friendly to you until the spell ends or your side damages them. Charmed creatures must attack or move toward the nearest creature other than you and your allies, repeating the save each turn.

name: Intaglio
components: V, S, M (a quill or a vial of ink)
description: While the spell lasts, each Magic action copies one page of nonmagical text or image you touch onto a medium you supply. Copying a spellbook this way takes half the usual time and gold.

name: Investiture of Venom
description: Immunity to Poison damage and Poisoned; you can tell whether creatures within 30 feet resist or are immune to poison. Bonus Action: a creature within 30 feet makes a Constitution save or loses its Poison Resistance or Immunity until your next turn ends. Magic action: a 15-foot by 5-foot Line of venom, Constitution save for 4d6 Poison and Poisoned until your next turn ends, half on success.

name: Lifesink
description: A 15-foot Emanation: other creatures that enter or start their turn in it take 4d6 Necrotic. At the start of your turn you regain 4d6 HP plus 1 per creature in it.

name: Life Tether
description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or is tethered to you: whenever you take damage it takes half as much (round down) as Necrotic. If it drops to 0 HP, a Bonus Action moves the tether to a new creature (Wisdom save). Two tethers with a level 4 slot, three at 6, four at 8.

name: Little Death
components: S, M (an item of personal sentimental value worth 1+ SP)
description: You die and next turn rise as a Ghost (keeping your HP, Hit Dice, mental scores, and languages, adding PB to its attacks and DCs). After a secret 1d8 hours, at 0 HP as a Ghost, or when you end it, you return to life at half HP if the keepsake is still on your corpse, otherwise you die. If your body is destroyed meanwhile you stay a Ghost until raised.

name: Maelfa's Quickened Class
description: A short lecture gives up to 10 willing creatures one spell you know or have prepared (prepared for free), one skill you are proficient in, or one language you know, for the duration. A new casting on a creature ends the old one. Duration 3 days with level 3-4 slots, 10 days at 5-6, 30 days at 7-8, 1 year at 9.

name: Magic Mirror
casting_time: Reaction, when you are targeted by a spell
components: V, S, M (a polished silver marble)
description: Redirect a spell targeting you to a creature of your choice within 60 feet. Level 5 or lower spells redirect automatically; higher ones need a spellcasting check against DC 10 + the spell's level.

name: Melting Curse
components: V, S, M (a vial of quicksilver)
description: A creature and a metal object it holds or wears: Dexterity save (Advantage if the item is magical) or 5d8 Fire and the item melts to the ground. Touching it during the spell melts it again and deals 5d8 Fire. +1d8 per slot level above 6.

name: Mirror Spell
casting_time: Reaction, when you see a creature within 60 feet casting a spell
description: Copy and cast a spell of level 3 or lower being cast within 60 feet (not your own): automatic for level 2 or lower, otherwise a spellcasting check against DC 10 + its level. You use no slot or components and cast it at its lowest level with your own modifier and DC. A higher slot raises the maximum level you can copy.

name: Mortality
components: V, S, M (a gem-encrusted humanoid skull worth 200+ GP)
description: Sangromancy. Spend five Hit Dice or it fails. An Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend in range makes a Charisma save or loses current and maximum HP equal to the roll; for the duration it loses all damage Resistances and Immunities, becomes a Humanoid, and takes +1d4 Necrotic whenever it is damaged. If it drops to 0 HP it dies and the change is permanent unless revived and then cured with Remove Curse.

name: Neutralize Aura
components: V, S, M (a sprig of sage)
description: A willing creature you touch can't be perceived by Fey, Fiends, Celestials, or Undead. It ends when the target attacks, deals damage, casts a spell, or comes within 5 feet of one. One extra target per slot level above 1.

name: Overgrow
description: Vines grip a Huge or smaller creature or loose object. A creature makes a Strength save or is Restrained (repeat each turn). An object can't be moved (Athletics against your DC to free it) and is easy to climb. One extra target per slot level above 2.

name: Perfection
description: A creature you can see ends Poisoned, has curses suppressed, heals to full, and has any ability score under 18 raised to 18 for 1 minute, plus a blessing. Aphaelon: immune to Charmed and Reaction to reroll a failed save. Empyreus: immune to Frightened and +4d6 Force on its first hit each turn. Miklas: immune to Poison and regains 4d6 HP each turn. Morael: 30 temp HP and Reaction to take damage for an ally within 60 feet. Solyma: immune to Thunder and Reaction to return Fire damage equal to damage taken. Zabriel: Truesight 60 feet and grants Heroic Inspiration to an ally each turn.

name: Phoenix Flames
description: You die in holy fire: each creature in a 30-foot Emanation makes a Constitution save, taking 30d6 Radiant and 1 Exhaustion level, half damage only on success. Creatures it kills are incinerated and need True Resurrection or Wish. Ten minutes later you rise as if by True Resurrection.

name: Power Word Maim
description: A creature with 125 HP or fewer takes 8d10 Necrotic and is Prone; a healthier one has Speed 0 until the start of your next turn. It makes a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition.

name: Preserve
components: V, S, M (a sack containing a pinch of salt)
description: Up to 5 pounds of food or other perishables in a sack don't age or rot for 12 hours.

name: Primordial Power
components: V, S, M (a handful of clay)
description: A creature you touch speaks Primordial and gains an element's gift. Air: Resistance to Lightning and Thunder, fly 30 feet. Coldfire: Resistance to Cold, and a Bonus Action to spend and roll a Hit Die to heal it + Con mod (not on the turn after taking Fire damage). Earth: Advantage on saves against being moved or knocked Prone, Tremorsense 30 feet. Fire: Resistance to Fire, and a Reaction melee attack against an adjacent creature that damages it. Water: Resistance to Acid, water breathing, swim 60 feet.

name: Reanimate
components: V, S, M (wilted daisies and herbal powders worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: Sangromancy. Spend three Hit Dice or it fails. A creature dead under 10 minutes (not of old age) returns at 1 HP plus temp HP equal to their roll, losing 1 of those temp HP each turn. While it has them it gets +2 to D20 Tests; when they run out it gains 1 Exhaustion level. Missing parts aren't restored.

name: Red Rain
components: V, S, M (a sponge soaked in blood)
description: Sangromancy. Spend eight Hit Dice or it fails. Within 1d6 x 5 minutes blood rains within 5 miles. Beasts and Plants there make a Wisdom save or are Frightened until a minute outside it; ordinary plants wither. Every 10 minutes in the rain a creature gains 1 Exhaustion and takes 2d10 Necrotic that also lowers its HP maximum until that Exhaustion is gone, and it auto-fails saves to end Poisoned meanwhile. Afterward wildlife shuns the area for days equal to the Hit Dice roll.

name: Ride the Lightning
components: V, S, M (a length of copper wire)
description: You become lightning and travel to a space within 60 feet; each creature in the 5-foot-wide Line makes a Dexterity save, 4d6 Lightning or half. +1d6 and +10 feet of length per slot level above 4.

name: Sanguine Fusillade
components: V, S, M (a needle dipped in your blood)
description: Sangromancy. Spend seven Hit Dice or it fails. A creature you can see takes Piercing equal to their roll, and seven blood darts burst from it toward creatures within 60 feet of it (any mix, including the target). Each dart is a ranged spell attack dealing one Hit Die roll of Piercing. One more Hit Die and dart per slot level above 7.

name: Sanguine Poppet
components: V, S, M (an object shaped like a creature worth 1+ CP)
description: Sangromancy. Spend three Hit Dice or it fails. A figurine becomes your poppet (AC 10 + PB + spellcasting mod, 30 HP), ending if destroyed or over a mile away. Bonus Action: move it 30 feet and see and hear through it until your next turn. Magic action: detonate it; each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere makes a Dexterity save for Necrotic equal to the Hit Dice roll, half on success. One more Hit Die and 1 more hour per slot level above 3.

name: Sanguine Shield
description: Sangromancy. Spend two Hit Dice or it fails. Gain 5 temp HP for each creature within 30 feet (you included) below its HP maximum, up to 15, and Half Cover while you have them; they vanish when the spell ends. Cap +5 per two slot levels above 2.

name: Seal Spellcasting
components: V, S, M (wax mixed with lead and a stamp)
description: Mark a creature you can see. The next time it casts a spell it makes a Charisma save: on a failure the slot is spent for no effect, on a success it casts normally but takes 3d8 Force. The spell then ends. +1d8 per slot level above 2.

name: Sense Lifeblood
description: Sangromancy. Spend two Hit Dice or it fails (creatures immune to Exhaustion are immune). You see whether creatures are blood relatives and whether they are at full, below full, at half, or under half HP. Once per turn when you hit a Bloodied creature, add Necrotic equal to a roll of the spent Hit Dice. Concentration up to 1 hour with a level 3-4 slot, 8 hours at 5+.

name: Serpent Tongue
description: Your tongue becomes a snake. As a Bonus Action make a melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet: 1d12 Piercing and Poisoned for the rest of the spell. +1d12 per slot level above 3.

name: Shared Judgement
description: Once per turn while it lasts, when you drop an Undead to 0 HP, deal 5d6 Radiant to a creature you can see within 60 feet. +1d6 per slot level above 4.

name: Shroud Blood
description: Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. You or a willing creature within 30 feet gains Advantage on Stealth checks. When it stops being Invisible, it can take a Reaction to become Invisible again for rounds equal to Hit Dice spent, ending if it attacks, deals damage, or casts a spell. One extra target per slot level above 1.

name: Somnolence
components: V, S, M (sand mixed with the caster's blood)
description: Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. Roll it plus 2d12: if the total equals or exceeds a creature's current HP it sleeps for 1 minute, or 24 hours if it equals or exceeds its HP maximum. Damage or a shake wakes it, and an early wake costs 1 Exhaustion level. Creatures that don't sleep or are immune to Exhaustion are unaffected. +1d12 and two more Hit Dice per slot level above 1.

name: Spirit Swarm
description: A creature with Charisma 3 or higher makes a Charisma save: 8d8 Psychic and Frightened for the duration, or half damage only on success.

name: Splattering Smite
casting_time: Reaction, when you hit a creature with a Melee weapon
description: Sangromancy. Spend five Hit Dice or it fails. For the duration, once per turn when you hit with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, heal by a roll of the spent Hit Dice.

name: Steal Immortality
casting_time: Reaction, when a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead you can see in range drops to 0 HP
components: V, S, M (a gem-encrusted humanoid skull worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: Sangromancy. Spend nine Hit Dice or it fails. Gain temp HP equal to twice their roll and add the dying creature's type to your own until you recast or drop to 0 HP: immune to Poisoned, no need to eat, drink, or breathe, B/P/S Resistance, plus a type benefit. Celestial: Resistance to Radiant and Necrotic, fly 60. Elemental: Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder. Fey: Bonus Action Invisible until your next turn or teleport 60 feet. Fiend: Resistance to Cold and Fire, fly 60. Undead: immune to Necrotic, Charmed, and Frightened.

name: Suffocate
description: Ranged spell attack with invisible hands: on a hit the creature is Restrained and can't breathe. It holds its breath for 1 + Con mod rounds, then gains 1 Exhaustion each turn until it can breathe (that Exhaustion then clears). An action and an Athletics check against your DC frees it.

name: Supernal Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, right after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike
description: The creature you just hit takes +4d6 Force, loses Concentration, and has its ongoing level 3 or lower spells end; for each level 4+ spell on it, make a spellcasting check against DC 10 + its level to end it.

name: Theft of Vitae
casting_time: Reaction, when a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage
description: Sangromancy. Spend two Hit Dice or it fails. The creature that just took damage takes extra Necrotic equal to their roll, and you gain temp HP equal to that roll plus the triggering damage, up to 15. The cap rises by 10 per slot level above 2.

name: Thorn Armor
description: A willing creature gains 3d6 temp HP in a thorny shell; a melee attacker that hits it takes Piercing equal to the temp HP the hit removed. Ends when the temp HP are gone. +2d6 temp HP per slot level above 1.

name: Tremor
description: A 15-foot Emanation around you shakes (you are unaffected) and is Difficult Terrain. When it reaches a creature, or a creature enters or ends its turn in it, the creature makes a Dexterity save (once per turn) or takes 1d6 Bludgeoning and falls Prone. +1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Undead Enthrallment
components: V, S, M (a pot of brackish water, a pot of grave dirt, and a black onyx worth 500+ GP per corpse)
description: Raise one Undead of CR 3 or lower from enough corpses. Command it within 60 feet with a Bonus Action; otherwise it Dodges. Control lasts 24 hours and recasting renews it; after 30 days of renewal it stays under your control permanently. You can hold at most four.

name: Vampiric Claws
description: Your Unarmed Strikes become claws dealing 1d6 Slashing using your spellcasting modifier, and each time they deal damage you gain temp HP equal to that modifier (lost when the spell ends).

name: Vibrating Humors
description: Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. A creature within 30 feet makes a Constitution save or takes Thunder equal to the Hit Die roll and has Disadvantage on Stealth; it repeats the save each turn to end the spell. One more Hit Die of damage per slot level above 1.

name: Viscous Sheath
components: V, S, M (a bloody funerary shroud)
description: Sangromancy. Spend seven Hit Dice (as printed) or it fails. Melee attackers within 5 feet that hit you take Necrotic equal to a roll of those Hit Dice + your spellcasting modifier. When a Melee weapon hits you, take a Reaction: the attacker makes a Strength save or the weapon sticks to you, leaving it Grappled while it holds on (an action and Athletics check against your DC frees it). You can trap as many weapons as Hit Dice spent, plus one per slot level above 4.

name: Wall of Gloom
components: V, S, M (a vial of tears)
description: A gray wall of grief up to 60 by 10 by 5 feet, or a ring 20 feet across and up to 20 feet high, appears on solid ground, blocks sight, and sheds Dim Light 100 feet. You and chosen creatures are unaffected. A creature that moves within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there makes a Charisma save or is Incapacitated until its next turn; one that first enters it on a turn or ends its turn inside makes a Charisma save or gains 1 Exhaustion level.

name: Weave Numen
components: V, S, M (a mithral sewing needle worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You sense magic within 120 feet (auras and schools) and gain thirteen threads (two more per slot level above 6); the spell ends when they run out. Spend 1 when casting to upcast by one level and gain 1 + spell level temp HP. Spend 1 as a Reaction to stop a spell cast within 120 feet (automatic for level 3 or lower, otherwise a spellcasting check against DC 10 + its level). Spend up to six on a damaging or healing spell to add 4 per thread to one creature.

name: Wilting Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, right after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike
description: Sangromancy. Spend two Hit Dice or it fails. The creature you just hit loses all damage Resistances until the start of your next turn and takes extra Necrotic equal to a roll of the spent Hit Dice.

name: Wipe Face
description: A creature you can see loses its face: Blinded, Incapacitated, and suffocating. It makes a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to end the spell. Dealing it 15 or more Slashing damage opens an airway until the start of your next turn.

name: Wrack
components: V, S, M (a frayed piece of cord)
description: A creature makes a Constitution save or its Speed is halved and it has Disadvantage on attack rolls, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Summon Sea Spirit
components: V, S, M (a jeweled sea serpent statuette worth 300+ GP)
description: Summon a Sea Serpent Spirit (Large; AC 11 + spell level; HP 30 + 10 per level above 3; swim 60; Cold Resistance) with Enormous Mouth, Glowing Lantern, or Scaled Wings. It makes half the spell level (round down) attacks: Bite (1d6 + 3 + level Piercing and Grappled) or Thrash (reach 10, 1d10 + 3 + level Bludgeoning and push 5 feet). Mouth adds Inhale (15-foot Cone Strength save, Psychic damage and a pull); Lantern adds Allure (30-foot Wisdom save or Charmed); Wings add fly 40 and Flyby. It acts after you and obeys spoken commands, otherwise Dodging.

name: Bloodletter
description: A nonmagical weapon you touch festers the next creature it hits: Constitution save or it takes 2d6 necrotic at the start of each of its turns for the duration (one wound at a time). Any magical healing ends it. +1d6 per slot level above 2nd.

name: Creeping Touch
description: Your hand detaches and becomes a spider you can talk to telepathically within 100 feet; as an action you see and hear through it until your next turn, blind and deaf to your own surroundings. Call it back to end the spell. If it dies or can't return, your hand regrows and you take 1d6 psychic.

name: Crown of Radiance
description: A crown of holy fire sheds bright light 30 feet and dim light 30 more. Any fiend, fey, or undead that moves within 20 feet of you or starts its turn there takes 2d8 radiant.

name: Flense
description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save, taking 8d6 necrotic or half on success. Each turn you can use your action to repeat it. Ends if the target leaves range, drops to 0 hit points, or gains total cover.

name: Holy Word
description: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 radiant. An undead, fiend, or fey hit also loses 10 feet of speed and can't take reactions until the end of its next turn. Damage rises to 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th, and 4d8 at 17th.

name: Life Tether
description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or is tethered to you; whenever you take damage it takes half as much (after resistances) as necrotic. When a tethered creature drops to 0, a bonus action moves the tether to a new target (Wisdom save). One more tether per two slot levels above 2nd.

name: Phoenix Flames
description: You burn away in holy fire: creatures within 20 feet make a Constitution save, taking 30d6 radiant and a level of exhaustion, or half damage only on success. Creatures killed are incinerated. Ten minutes later you rise as if by true resurrection.

name: Ride the Lightning
components: V, S, M (a length of copper wire)
description: Teleport up to 60 feet as a lightning bolt; creatures within 5 feet of the path make a Dexterity save, 4d6 lightning or half. +1d6 damage and +10 feet of distance per slot level above 4th.

name: Spirit Swarm
description: A creature with Charisma 3 or higher makes a Charisma save: 8d8 psychic and frightened of you for the duration, or half damage only on success.

name: Supernal Smite
description: Your next melee weapon hit during the spell deals +4d6 force, breaks the target's concentration, and ends its spells of 3rd level or lower; for each higher spell on it, make a spellcasting check against DC 10 + its level to end it.

name: Accelerate/Decelerate
casting_time: Reaction, when you see an attack roll hit a creature within 60 feet
components: V, S, M (a drop of oil or molasses)
description: Chronomancy. Either the hit deals +2d6 of its damage type, or its damage is reduced by 2d6 (min 0). +1d6 per slot level above 1.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Clue
components: V, S, M (a magnifying glass and pipe)
description: Footprints and fingerprints within a 30-foot Emanation left since a moment you pick (up to 10 days back) glow, one color per creature without naming anyone. Anything that moves or touches things in the area during the spell leaves colored prints too, which can reveal invisible creatures.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Delay
description: Chronomancy. A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or moves to last in the Initiative order from the next round on.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Dire Warning
description: Chronomancy. Your future self sends you a warning or tip of up to six words, chosen by the GM. Later, once you understand it, you must perform a 10-minute ritual (doable during a rest) to send it back; no message means you never will. You can't cast it again for 7 days or until you perform the ritual.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Defenestration
description: A creature you can see makes a Strength save. Failure: it is pushed up to 20 feet through a window of your choice (or a conjured window of force if none is near), taking 4d6 Slashing and landing Prone. Success: pushed 10 feet, no damage. +1d6 and +5 feet per slot level above 2.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Mandy's Feral Follower
components: V, S, M (a small servant's bell)
description: A Medium or smaller Beast you touch becomes a finely dressed Humanoid Commoner (keeping its HP and Hit Dice, with a skill you choose) with 10 temp HP, acting on its own Initiative as your dutiful servant. The spell ends when the temp HP run out, or at the next midnight's twelfth stroke (24 hours where time runs strangely). One more Beast per slot level above 4.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Finger Guns
description: Your hand becomes a Simple Ranged weapon (range 60/240, Slow mastery) using your spellcasting ability to hit and dealing 2d6 Force with no modifier. Range grows to 90/360 at level 5, 120/480 at 11, and 150/600 at 17.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Game of Fate
description: A creature in range that understands you (Wisdom save if unwilling) must play a nonmagical game with you. The loser takes 6d6 Psychic, or both of you do if it's unfinished after an hour; harming the other side forfeits. You can agree on bigger stakes (up to 12d6 Psychic, money, property, or deeds such as titles), sealed with a handshake; the spell exposes bets that can't be paid, delivers wagered goods, and compels wagered deeds. Nothing else can influence the game.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Hangover
components: V, S, M (a vial of strong liquor)
description: A creature makes a Constitution save: 3d8 Psychic and Poisoned until the end of your next turn, or half damage only on success. It has Disadvantage on the Concentration save this damage causes. +1d8 per slot level above 2.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Memorize
components: V, S, M (a knotted silver string worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You perfectly remember one page of text for a year, and afterward have Advantage on Intelligence checks to recall it.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Moment to Think
description: Chronomancy. Time stops for everyone else while you take one Search, Study, or Utilize action and move within your space. You can't affect other creatures or objects you aren't carrying, and anything you let go freezes in time.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Paradox
description: Chronomancy. Undo one action taken within range in the last round: its direct effects (such as damage) are reversed, but indirect ones (like where people moved) remain. The creature that took it takes 10d8 Psychic.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Polybrachia
components: V, S, M (a pair of armbands)
description: A willing creature grows two working arcane arms that can hold weapons or Shields (up to two two-handed or four one-handed weapons) and do Somatic components. It has Advantage on Athletics checks and can make a Bonus Action melee attack with a weapon in the new arms.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Recall
description: Chronomancy. Mark your location. Until the end of your next turn, take a Reaction when attacked, when a creature casts a spell, or when a creature moves within 5 feet of you to teleport back there (or the nearest open space) before the trigger resolves.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Rumor
description: Spread a rumor of up to 10 words through a 100-foot Emanation: every creature there that can hear at least three others believes it overheard someone nearby repeat it, so the source can't be traced. It shifts attitudes but rarely makes anyone Hostile.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Arc Blade
components: S, M (a proficient Melee weapon worth 1+ CP)
description: Make one attack with the weapon, either a melee attack or a ranged spell attack out to 15 feet, using your spellcasting ability. Ranged, it deals Lightning; melee, Lightning or the weapon's type. Extra Lightning damage: 1d6 at level 5, 2d6 at 11, 3d6 at 17.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Blunder
casting_time: Reaction, when a creature you can see in range hits with an attack roll
description: The attacker makes a Wisdom save or you pick: Fumble (it drops a held object of your choice up to 10 feet away; if that was its weapon it can make an Unarmed Strike instead) or Prat Fall (it falls Prone, and Prone's Disadvantage applies to the triggering attack).
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Burning Blade
components: S, M (a proficient Melee weapon worth 1+ CP)
description: Make one melee attack with the weapon using your spellcasting ability, dealing Fire or its normal type. Any damage die that rolls its maximum explodes (roll again and add), up to your spellcasting modifier in extra dice. Extra Fire damage: 1d6 at level 5, 2d6 at 11, 3d6 at 17.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Candy Blast
description: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 Force, and a 5-foot square in the target's space becomes Difficult Terrain of candy for 1 minute. 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Cheat
description: Until the end of your next turn, you can reroll ability checks for nonmagical games of skill, using the new roll.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Cosmic Horror
description: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere makes a Wisdom save: 6d6 Psychic and Frightened for the duration (repeat save each turn), or half damage only. +1d6 per slot level above 3.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Flashback
description: Chronomancy. Retroactively declare a preparation you made in the last 24 hours (packing gear, arranging a distraction); the GM may require a check. It can add elements but can't remove or harm creatures or move things you aren't carrying; the GM decides its limits.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Flawed Reconstruction
components: V, S, M (a needle and thread)
description: A creature you touch heals 3d6 but its HP maximum drops by 1d6 (min 1). +2d6 healing and +1d6 reduction per slot level above 1.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Frenzy
components: V, S, M (a drop of fresh blood)
description: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere makes a Wisdom save or is Frenzied: it treats everyone as an enemy, picks the targets of its attacks, spells, and abilities at random among creatures it can see, and must take every Opportunity Attack offered. It repeats the save at the end of each turn.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Frigid Blade
components: S, M (a proficient Melee weapon worth 1+ CP)
description: Make one melee attack with the weapon using your spellcasting ability; a single damage die steps up one size (d12 or 2d6 at the top), and it deals Cold or its normal type. Extra Cold damage: 1d6 at level 5, 2d6 at 11, 3d6 at 17.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Mandy's Marvelous Dress
components: V, S, M (a glass slipper worth 100+ GP)
description: A willing creature is dressed in an unremovable ball gown and jewels. It can treat any Charisma D20 Test roll as a 10, and a creature that attacks it while seeing it makes a Wisdom save or misses (success makes that attacker immune for the spell). It lasts until the next midnight's twelfth stroke, or 24 hours where time runs strangely.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Protect Threshold
components: V, S, M (an ounce of salt per foot of the portal's perimeter)
description: An invisible eldritch guardian wards a door, window, or similar opening: anything passing through makes a Wisdom save, 4d6 Psychic or half. +1d6 per slot level above 2.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Rocks Fall
description: Boulders rain on a 60-foot-radius, 120-foot-high Cylinder: Dexterity save for 10d8 Bludgeoning and buried (Prone and Restrained until an action and an Athletics check against your DC frees it), or half damage only.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Rusting Grasp
description: Melee spell attack: 6d4 Acid and -3 AC (min 10) for 1 hour. Against an unattended nonmagical metal object it eats away a 1-foot cube. +2d4 and one more cubic foot per slot level above 3.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Seance
components: V, S, M (a crystal ball, tarot deck, or spirit board, and incense worth 50+ GP)
description: With three or more willing creatures holding hands, call a named or described soul you know of; if free and willing it appears and answers up to three questions with what it knew in life, briefly and not necessarily truthfully if hostile. Fails on the same spirit within 10 days; 5% chance of reaching a deceptive wrong spirit.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Soul Effigy
components: V, S, M (a straw doll worth 1+ CP)
description: A Humanoid makes a Constitution save or part of its soul is bound to the doll (ends if the doll is destroyed or it changes planes). As a Magic action: Control (dictate its next turn's movement and Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Utilize), Harm (2d8 damage of a fitting type, ignoring Resistance and Immunity), or Restrain (dunk the doll; Restrained until the end of your next turn).
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Stone Bones
description: A creature you can see has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing until the end of your next turn.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Swift Flight
components: V, S, M (a bird's wing feather)
description: A creature you touch gains a 60-foot Fly Speed with hover until the end of its next turn, then falls if unsupported.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Sword of Judgment
components: V, S, M (a strand of horse hair)
description: A spectral sword hangs over each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. When one there attacks or casts a spell, you can drop its sword first: Dexterity save for 4d8 Force or half, once per turn per creature. +1d8 per slot level above 5.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Transient Bulwark
components: V, S, M (a pearl worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: The next attack roll against you has a -10 penalty, then the spell ends.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Zephyr's Feather
description: Four razor feathers orbit you. On casting and as a Bonus Action later, fire one: a ranged spell attack within 120 feet for 1d8 Force. +1d8 per slot level above 1.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Ancestral Communion
description: Gain Heroic Inspiration on casting and at the start of each of your turns if you lack it.

name: Blood Bolt
description: Ranged spell attack: 1d6 Necrotic and you gain temp HP equal to your PB. 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

name: Blood Sacrifice
components: V, S, M (a drop of your own blood)
description: Take 1d6 Necrotic that can't be reduced; for the duration one target of each damaging spell you cast takes +1d6 of the spell's type. Both +1d6 per slot level above 2.

name: Buried Alive
components: V, S, M (a pinch of grave dirt)
description: A grounded creature makes a Str save or is swallowed 10 feet deep: Total Cover, Restrained, Blinded, and unable to breathe; each action and DC 15 Athletics check digs 5 feet up (all the way on a 5+ margin), emerging Prone. On a success it is Prone with Speed 0 until its next turn ends. Creatures on stone, metal, or 2+ inches of wood auto-succeed.

name: Call of the Wild
components: V, S, M (a bit of animal fur or hide)
description: Each Beast in a 100-foot Emanation makes a Wis save or is Charmed and obeys your commands (renewed with a Magic action each turn); on a success it is only Charmed until your next turn. The howl carries 300 feet.

name: Captivate Undead
components: V, S, M (a pinch of bone dust)
description: An Undead you can see makes a Cha save or is Charmed (even if immune) and Friendly to you; on a success it has Disadvantage on its next attack against you before your next turn. Harming it or forcing it to save ends the spell. One more target per slot level above 1.

name: Chain of Conviction
description: A creature makes a Str save or takes 2d6 Force, is pulled up to 30 feet toward you, and is chained: it can't get more than 30 feet from you and you have Advantage on attacks against it (repeat save each turn; ends if you get over 30 feet apart). Half damage only on success. +1d6 per slot level above 2.

name: Chorus of the Lost
components: V, S, M (a silver bell worth 10+ GP)
description: Each creature in a 15-foot-radius Sphere makes a Wis save: 2d6 Psychic and Frightened for the duration (repeat save each turn), or half damage and Frightened until its next turn ends. +1d6 per slot level above 2.

name: Consuming Pyre
description: A creature makes a Dex save: 2d8 Fire plus 2d8 Necrotic or Radiant (chosen on casting) and it keeps burning, repeating the damage each turn until it or an adjacent creature spends an action for a new save; half damage once on a success. Anything it kills turns to ash with its nonmagical gear.

name: Creeping Rot
description: Rot strikes a target and leaps to up to three more within 30 feet of it (creatures or ordinary plants). Creatures make a Con save: 3d8 Necrotic and Poisoned, taking 1d8 Necrotic each turn until a save ends it; half damage only on success. Plant creatures fail automatically and plants wither. One more leap per slot level above 3.

name: Crimson Harvest
components: V, S, M (a vial of blood)
description: Chosen creatures in a 15-foot Emanation make a Dex save for 3d10 Necrotic, half on success. If it hurts a Small or larger creature, one creature you choose in the area heals half the damage roll. +1d10 per slot level above 3.

name: Crooked Ward
components: V, S, M (a five-pointed wicker star)
description: A mark on a fixed surface makes an invisible 30-foot-radius Sphere where Aberrations, Fey, Fiends, Monstrosities, and Undead have Disadvantage on checks and attacks, and must pass a Wis save or be Frightened when first entering on a turn or starting a turn there. Longer with higher slots: 1 hour at level 4, 8 hours at 5, and 24 hours without Concentration at 6+.

name: Culling Sickle
description: A ghostly sickle hovers with you. On casting and as a Bonus Action each turn, make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 30 feet: 2d8 Necrotic and you gain temp HP equal to half. +1d8 per slot level above 3.

name: Cursed Cacophony
description: A creature you know on your plane makes a Wis save or hears discordant music and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests; the first time each turn it fails one, it repeats the save. A creature that fails can't be targeted by a ritual casting again for 24 hours.

name: Devil's Due
casting_time: Reaction, when another creature within range takes damage
description: Spend and roll a Hit Die and heal it + your spellcasting modifier, doubled if the trigger was a Critical Hit. One more Hit Die per slot level above 1.

name: Dissolution
description: Melee spell attack against a creature or nonmagical object: 1d8 Force and -1 AC against the next attack before the end of your next turn. 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

name: Eye Burn
casting_time: Reaction, when a creature you can see in range targets you with an attack
components: V, S, M (a smear of camphor)
description: The attacker makes a Con save (Blindsight or immunity to Blinded auto-succeeds): Blinded until the end of the turn, or on a success it subtracts 1d4 from that attack. It then auto-succeeds against your Eye Burn for 24 hours.

name: Field of Reaping
components: V, S, M (a dried corn husk or wheat hull)
description: A 30-foot Cube of shadow curses hostile creatures in it when it appears, when they first enter on a turn, or end a turn there, until the end of their next turn: the first damage they take each turn adds 1d6 Necrotic, and a creature you choose in the field heals that much. +1d6 per slot level above 5.

name: Ghastly Charge
components: V, S, M (a scrap of a banner)
description: Ghost knights charge a 90-foot by 20-foot Line: chosen creatures make a Wis save or take 5d12 Necrotic, are Frightened until your next turn, and use their Reaction to flee; half damage only on success. +1d12 per slot level above 6.

name: Harvest Moonglow
components: V, S, M (a piece of moonstone)
description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of silvery Dim Light reveals Invisible things as shimmering shapes, and allies in it can use a Bonus Action to gain 2d6 temp HP. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Harrowing Ballad
description: A creature with Intelligence 4+ makes an Int save or is Charmed by a looping song: 1d6 Psychic at the start of its turns and Disadvantage on Perception and Concentration saves, repeating the save each turn. +1d6 per slot level above 2.

name: Hungering Blade
description: Your held weapon or Unarmed Strikes hunger: your first hit on a creature each turn adds Necrotic equal to your spellcasting modifier and grants that much temp HP.

name: Intrusive Despair
components: V, S, M (a devil's trumpet blossom)
description: Whenever the cursed creature takes the Attack or Magic action, it makes a Wis save or wastes the action. The spell ends after its third successful save.

name: Isolation
components: V, S, M (a small metal cube)
description: A creature makes a Wis save or perceives no other creatures by any sense or magic, rationalizes their spaces as blocked, and can't tell what hurts it; it repeats the save each turn.

name: Lucky Charm
components: V, S, M (a four-leaf clover and a shard of broken mirror)
description: Another creature carrying the touched trinket has Advantage on D20 Tests while you have Disadvantage on them.

name: Martyr
components: V, S, M (a Dagger worth 1+ CP)
description: A creature dead less than a minute returns to life with HP equal to your current HP; you drop to 0 HP with two failed Death Saves and must immediately make another, unable to heal or stabilize before it.

name: Mirrored Agony
casting_time: Reaction, when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages your ally
components: V, S, M (a pin or needle)
description: The attacker makes a Wis save, taking Psychic damage equal to the damage it dealt, or half on success.

name: Mist of Mourning
components: V, S, M (a vial of tears)
description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of mist: creatures in it when it appears, entering on a turn, or ending a turn there make a Cha save or until their next turn ends have half Speed, Disadvantage on attacks, and -1d8 on damage rolls.

name: Murder of Crows
description: Chosen creatures in a 30-foot Cone make a Dex save: 5d6 Force and Blinded until a save at the end of a turn or any healing ends it; half damage only on success. +1d6 per slot level above 4.

name: Mysterious Presence
description: Insight and Perception checks against the willing creature you touch take a -1d4 penalty.

name: Puppet Master
description: A creature makes a Wis save or is Charmed and must use its action to move to and melee attack a creature you mentally pick (acting normally if you pick none or it can't reach); it repeats the save each turn, and you must spend a Bonus Action each later turn to keep control.

name: Sacrificial Siphon
description: A creature makes a Cha save or is cursed: -1d4 on attacks and checks, and when it takes damage you can use a Reaction for 10 temp HP. On a success you gain 5 temp HP and it subtracts 1d4 from checks until your next turn.

name: Sanctum of the Shepherd
components: V, S, M (adamantine or diamond powder worth 200+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of light: you and up to your spellcasting modifier (min 1) other creatures who finish a Long Rest in it gain +1 AC for the rest of the duration.

name: Sanctum of the Flock
components: V, S, M (powdered silver worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of light: you and up to your spellcasting modifier (min 1) other creatures who finish a Long Rest in it gain 2d10 temp HP and Advantage on Charisma checks with their proficient skills for the rest of the duration.

name: Sanguine Secrets
components: V, S, M (a drop of blood, which the spell consumes)
description: Learn a creature's species and type, current HP, conditions, and its damage and condition Vulnerabilities, Resistances, and Immunities; your next check or attack against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

name: Scarlet Dawn
description: A 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder of red light: living creatures make a Con save for 4d10 Necrotic (half on success) while Constructs and Undead heal 4d10. It dispels magical Darkness of level 3 or lower it overlaps. +1d10 and +1 dispel level per slot level above 3.

name: Shadow Drain
description: A 15-foot Emanation: non-designated creatures entering, starting a turn in it, or that it reaches make a Cha save (once per turn) for 2d6 Necrotic and Disadvantage on attacks and checks until their next turn ends, or half damage only. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Summer Winds
description: A 15-foot Cone of light and wind heals allies in it 2d6; hostile Undead there make a Con save for 2d6 Radiant, half on success. +2d6 each per slot level above 2.

name: Unraveling Whisper
description: A creature makes a Wis save: 2d6 Psychic and Frightened until your next turn, with Vulnerability to Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing (your pick) meanwhile; half damage only on success. One more target per slot level above 2.

name: Veil of the Reaper
components: V, S, M (a dried corn husk or wheat straw)
description: At the end of any turn in which you hit a creature with an attack roll, you become Invisible until the start of your next turn.

name: Bitter Wind
components: V, S, M (a birch wood fan)
description: A freezing wind 120 feet long and 20 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose. A creature starting its turn in the line makes a Strength save or is pushed 30 feet along the line, takes 1d12 cold, and is knocked prone; the save has disadvantage in cold weather or dark or shadowy conditions. Moving toward you inside the line costs 2 feet per foot. A bonus action each turn changes the direction. The wind disperses gas and puts out unprotected flames. At 4th level or higher the save always has disadvantage and damage rises 1d12 per slot level above 3rd.

name: Blade of Blood and Bone
components: V, S, M (a dagger or shortsword, not consumed)
description: You cut yourself with the material component; your hit point maximum drops by 3 and the component vanishes. For the duration, a bonus action draws a magic blade of bone and blood from your body (or sheathes it back). You are proficient with it, attack with your spell attack bonus, and deal 1d6 slashing on a hit. When the spell ends your maximum and the component are restored. With a higher slot, damage rises 1d6 per two slot levels above 2nd and your maximum drops by an extra amount equal to the slot level.

name: Bright Sparks
description: Blue sparks fly from your fingers, lighting the area within 60 feet until the start of your next turn. Wisdom (Perception) checks to spot creatures hidden in shadows have advantage.

name: Charnel Banquet
description: You turn a field of carrion into an empowering feast. Creatures of your choice that eat of it during the duration regain 10d6 hit points, recover half their spent Hit Dice (minimum 1), remove half their exhaustion levels (minimum 1), and gain the benefits of a short rest. At the end of the duration each makes a Constitution save or is poisoned for 1 hour. With a 9th-level slot they instead remove all exhaustion and recover all Hit Dice.

name: Child of Light and Darkness
components: V, S, M (a sun-warmed pebble from the Shadow Realm)
description: At the end of each of your turns roll a d20: on 1 to 10 you become a humanoid of searing light, on 11 to 20 one of chilling darkness. In either form you are immune to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and attacks against you have disadvantage. Light form: bright light 60 feet and dim 60 more, immunity to fire, resistance to radiant, and once per turn a bonus action teleports you to a space you can see within your light. Darkness form: immunity to cold, resistance to necrotic, and once per turn a bonus action forces up to three Large or smaller creatures within 30 feet to make a Strength save or be pulled or pushed up to 20 feet.

name: Conjure Ferryman
components: V, S, M (a couple of copper coins)
description: Standing at a riverbank or other shore, you summon a friendly ferry spirit and its boat in an unoccupied space within range. It rolls initiative, carries you and up to one companion per your level across the water or along it, and otherwise only defends itself. It vanishes at 0 hit points or when the spell ends. If your concentration breaks it turns hostile and lingers for 1 hour. The GM has its statistics (a lesser lunar devil or bearded devil). At 3rd level or higher the boat can cross into the Ethereal Plane and out onto another body of water; at 5th level or higher it can travel the River Styx between planes.

name: Conjure Giant
description: You summon a giant of challenge rating 7 or lower in an unoccupied space within range. It is friendly, rolls initiative, obeys your verbal commands (no action required) that don't violate its alignment, and otherwise only defends itself. It vanishes at 0 hit points or when the spell ends. If your concentration breaks it becomes hostile and can't be dismissed, vanishing 1 hour after it was summoned. The GM has its statistics. The challenge rating rises by 1 per slot level above 6th.

name: Deep Roots of the Moon
components: V, M (moonstones worth 50 gp per mile within the Shadow Realm, or opals worth 500 gp per mile crossing planes)
description: You bind shadow material into an enchanted fey road (a shadow road) fixed between two points, resistant to weather and mundane change but subject to wear, deliberate destruction, and dispel magic. You can attach a keyword prayer or offering; those who know it can add one or two effects, such as doubled overland travel speed on the road or locking and unlocking its portals outside the Shadow Realm. Without it, no one can enter the road from outside the Shadow Realm.

name: Doom of False Friends
components: V, S, M (a pink rose petal)
description: Two creatures within range that can see and hear you each make a Charisma save. On a failure a target must use its movement and action to move toward and attack the other target, seeking it out if it leaves range. At the end of each turn a target can't see the other, it repeats the save, ending the compulsion on a success. Once every target has succeeded, you are stunned until the end of your next turn. With a 9th-level slot you can target two more creatures, and each chooses on its turn which other target to attack.

name: Doom of Poor Fortune
description: You turn luck against a creature within range. Whenever it makes an ability check, it first makes a Charisma save or the check fails; the spell persists if it leaves range. Each time it still succeeds on an affected roll you take 1 psychic damage, and losing concentration deals you 1d4 psychic. At 2nd level or higher, its other saving throws are replaced by a Charisma save unless the original is harder. At 4th level or higher it must also pass a Charisma save before each attack roll or the attack fails. With an 8th-level slot the spell no longer requires concentration.

name: Doom of Stacked Stones
description: You and three creatures of your choice within range make a Constitution save when you cast it and at the start of each of your turns; a failure restrains the creature. When an initial target fails, up to two other creatures within 30 feet of it must save too. Each further failure worsens the condition one step: restrained, incapacitated, stunned, paralyzed, then petrified (conditions stack), and each success lowers it one step. A target other than you that succeeds while only restrained is freed. You must keep saving every round. Creatures recover when the spell ends except petrified ones, which stay stone until restored by dispel magic, greater restoration, or similar magic; shatter can kill a petrified creature that fails a Constitution save.

name: Doom of Summer Years
components: V, S, M (a pinch of sand from an hourglass)
description: A living creature within range makes a Constitution save when you cast it and at the start of each of your turns, growing 1d4 + 1 years younger on a success or 1 year younger on a failure, down to infancy. It keeps its memories, scores, and features but gains 1 level of exhaustion per 5 years lost. A Medium creature reduced to childhood can't use heavy weapons, and an infant can't wield weapons or tools. If the spell ends before 1 minute the target returns to its true age; otherwise the change is permanent until ended by remove curse or greater restoration. If you lose concentration unintentionally, you gain as many exhaustion levels as the target gained.

name: Drayfn's Bane of Excellence
description: A creature within range makes a Charisma save. On a failure, the next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes during the duration on which it rolls a natural 20 has no effect. The number of natural 20s negated rises to two at 5th level, three at 11th, and four at 17th.

name: Drayfn's Blunted Blade
components: V, S, M (a rusty shard of iron)
description: A creature within range holding a manufactured, nonmagical weapon makes a Strength save. On a failure the weapon corrodes: the target rolls all weapon damage dice twice and uses the lower result. If the spell lasts the full minute the weapon crumbles to rust or wood chips; otherwise it returns to normal.

name: Drayfn's Curse of Incompetence
description: A creature within range with Intelligence 3 or higher makes an Intelligence save or can't add its proficiency bonus to ability checks, attack rolls, or saving throws. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Duration becomes concentration up to 10 minutes with a 5th-level slot, concentration up to 1 hour with a 6th-level slot, and 1 hour without concentration with a 7th-level slot.

name: Drizzle
description: A very light rain falls on a 20-foot square, too little to drink or to douse anything larger than a candle. After 1 minute the ground is wet; after 10 minutes it is slightly muddy or slippery without impeding movement. In freezing weather it may leave a thin coat of ice.

name: Ebon Tide
components: V, S, M (a bottle of shadows)
description: A wave of shadow matter whips a 100-foot-radius circle centered on a point you can see within range. The area is difficult terrain, and each creature touching the ground makes a Constitution save or gains a level of exhaustion. When you cast it and at the end of each turn you concentrate, creatures on the ground in the area make a Dexterity save or fall prone. Structures in contact with the ground take 30 bludgeoning when you cast it and at the start of each of your turns; a structure reduced to 0 sinks into the Shadow Realm, and creatures inside make a Constitution save, taking 2d12 necrotic, falling prone, and being blinded for 1 round on a failure (half damage only on a success). The GM may add up to two terrain effects: rising hills, slip faults, and hollows; rerouted rivers or shores; or turning the area to shadow mire.

name: Elf Shot
description: You mime shooting a tiny bow. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit it stumbles 5 feet in a random direction (d8) and its speed is 0 until the end of its next turn. You can repeat the attack as an action on each of your turns until the spell ends.

name: Emerald Goblet
components: V, S, M (a powdered acorn, which the spell consumes, and a drinking vessel)
description: You sprinkle acorn dust into a drinking vessel, creating a shining green goblet of green potion. A creature that drinks from it is protected against shadow corruption for 1 day, has advantage on checks to gather food in the Shadow Realm, and gains darkvision to 30 feet (or extends its darkvision by 30 feet).

name: Faerie Toast
components: V, S, M (wine worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes, and a cup for each participant)
description: You and up to five creatures within 10 feet drink a toast to the fey courts; choose one toast. Commiseration: spellcasting participants form a hag coven, sharing spell slots and all known spells for the duration. Friendship: participants become fey and their status rises by 2d6 in the Shadow Realm or the Bright Lands. Husbandry: participants can communicate with beasts as if sharing a language. Nightmares: the first time a creature comes within 30 feet of a participant it makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of all participants for 1 minute. Playfulness: participants grow gossamer wings and gain a fly speed equal to their walking speed for 10 rounds within the duration, falling if not on a surface at the end of their turn. Restfulness: participants have advantage on saves against being charmed and can't be magically put to sleep.

name: Feast of Flesh
components: V, M (an animal tooth and a drop of your blood)
description: A creature within range makes a Charisma save. On a failure its teeth turn needlelike, it can pinpoint creatures of its own type within 150 feet by scent, and on its turn it must move toward the nearest one by the fastest means and, if within 5 feet, use its bonus action to bite it (proficient, 1d6 + its Strength modifier). With none of its type within 150 feet, it attacks the closest living creature instead. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage (with advantage when triggered by damage); on a success the spell ends and it is poisoned for 1 hour unless it is a cannibal or from a cannibalistic culture.

name: Fire Dance
components: S, M (a burning mass of rags, a pair of torches, or similar fire in both hands)
description: You twirl two sources of fire in glowing patterns. Creatures of your choice in range that see the dance make a Wisdom save; creatures that can't be charmed succeed automatically, and a creature you or your companions are fighting has advantage. On a failure a creature is charmed, incapacitated, and has speed 0 for the duration. The effect ends for a creature that takes damage or is shaken out of it with an action, and the spell ends if you are incapacitated.

name: Fireflies
description: A swarm of fireflies lights a 15-foot-radius sphere within range for the duration. Some settle on hidden or invisible creatures: attack rolls against invisible creatures in the area don't have disadvantage (their own attacks still have advantage), and Hide actions in the area have disadvantage.

name: Flowering
description: Fragrant flowers sprout from an inanimate object within range. If an unwilling creature holds it, that creature can make a Dexterity save to negate the effect. If sustained for 1 minute, the flowers give a pleasing scent and may draw bees, hummingbirds, and other pollinators.

name: Gloaming
components: V, M (a piece of smoked glass)
description: Magical gloom fills a 50-foot-radius sphere around a point within range, spreading around corners. Darkvision sees through it and normal light illuminates it, but ranged attacks made through it have disadvantage. Cast on a worn or carried object, it moves with the object, and covering the object with something opaque blocks it. Light from a spell of 2nd level or higher that overlaps the area dispels it.

name: Grim Harvest
components: V, S, M (a pinch of gray sand and a bone chip)
