description: Target a creature at 0 hit points that is dying or died within the last round; if dying, it makes a Constitution save or dies. The next spell you cast within 1 minute grants you 1d10 + your spellcasting ability modifier temporary hit points and adds one effect of your choice. Clumsiness: target's speed is halved and it has disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saves for 1 minute (Constitution save at the end of each of its turns ends it). Fatiguing: target makes a Constitution save, gaining 1d4 levels of exhaustion on a failure or 1 on a success. Vampiric: you regain hit points equal to half the damage you dealt to one target. Weakness: target's melee hits deal minimum damage for 1 minute (Constitution save at the end of each of its turns ends it). Withering: the spell deals 4 extra damage dice and all its damage becomes necrotic.

name: Grim Shadows
description: Spear-like shadows fill a 15-foot square within range, giving creatures inside half cover. A creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 piercing and is blinded until the spell ends; an already blinded creature starting its turn there takes 1d8 piercing. A blinded creature can use its action to make a Dexterity or Wisdom save against your spell save DC, regaining sight on a success.

name: Hero of Fable
components: V, M (a crown of laurel leaves)
description: A creature within range gains advantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws for the duration, but creatures that attack it or save against its spells and effects also have advantage. An unwilling target can resist with a Charisma save. You can target one additional creature per slot level above 6th.

name: Hibernation
components: V, M (a tuft of bear fur)
description: The next creature you touch regains 1d6 hit points and falls asleep for 10 minutes per hit point regained. An unwilling creature makes a Constitution save to resist and repeats it at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success. A sleeper stays unconscious until the spell ends, it takes damage, or someone uses an action to wake it. Undead and creatures immune to being charmed are unaffected. At 3rd level or higher you can touch one willing creature per slot level.

name: Knife of Fate
description: You point your dagger at a creature you can see within 60 feet, which makes a Wisdom save. On a failure its fate is bound to a random ally of its own: any damage or condition either suffers is instead inflicted on the other. A creature can be bound to only one other at a time. The binding lasts until either creature gains a level, is targeted by heal, or partakes of heroes' feast.

name: Krail's Maggot
description: A 6-inch maggot forms inside a creature within range. Make a melee spell attack; on a hit the target takes necrotic damage equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier, and you can repeat the attack as a bonus action on each later turn. As an action the target can attack the maggot (AC equal to your spell save DC, 8 hit points per slot level) with a piercing or slashing weapon; half the damage hits the maggot and half the target. Killing the maggot ends the spell. Damage rises 1d8 per slot level above 2nd.

name: Krail's Rot
components: S, M (a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust)
description: A creature within range makes a Constitution save or takes 3d8 necrotic at the start of each of its turns for the duration; if reduced to 0 hit points it has disadvantage on death saves. If it dies, a bonus action raises it as a zombie under your control for 24 hours, commanded with a bonus action within 60 feet like animate dead; expend a 5th-level or higher slot before the 24 hours end to keep control. With a 7th-level slot the damage is 6d8 and it rises as a ghoul; with a 9th-level slot, 9d8 and a ghast.

name: Krail's Rupture
casting_time: 1 reaction, when you are grappled or swallowed whole
description: When grappled or swallowed, you slice into the creature holding you and pass through its body, breaking the grapple. It makes a Constitution save, taking 3d12 necrotic or half on a success. If swallowed, you exit regardless of damage and fall prone within 10 feet of it. Damage rises 1d12 per slot level above 2nd.

name: Leiloch's Arduous Shuffle
description: Creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you with fewer hit points than you when you cast it are compelled into a swaying shuffle; creatures that can't be charmed are immune. An affected creature's movement is halved, it can't take reactions, and it can make only one weapon or spell attack on its turn. At the start of its turn it can take 1d4 levels of exhaustion to end the effect on itself; exhaustion from this spell is removed by a short rest.

name: Leiloch's Interminable Yarn
components: V, M (a scroll containing a prepared speech)
description: You tell a rambling story. Creatures of your choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you stop to listen (deafened creatures and those that can't be charmed are immune). While enraptured they automatically fail Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Insight and Perception) checks and their passive scores in those skills are 0. A creature can try to pull away but must succeed on a Wisdom save or fall unconscious for 1 minute. The spell ends if you are incapacitated or can't speak.

name: Leiloch's Irritating Kazoo
description: You play a droning kazoo note. Each creature within 10 feet that can hear you makes a Constitution save. On a failure it takes 1d6 thunder at the start of each of your turns and can't cast spells with verbal components for the duration, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns to end it. On a success it takes 1d6 thunder and can't cast verbal spells until the end of its next turn.

name: Lost
description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or forgets all known locations, landmarks, and routes for the duration, even familiar ones. Remove curse or greater restoration ends it. One extra target per slot level above 3rd (all within 30 feet of each other); duration 8 hours with a 5th-level slot, 24 hours with 7th, and until dispelled with 9th.

name: Lost and Wandering
description: As lost, and the target is also compelled to wander off at a walk, attacking only in self-defense. After 16 hours it makes another Wisdom save; on a failure it falls into an exhausted long rest. Remove curse or greater restoration ends it. One extra target per slot level above 5th (within 30 feet of each other); with a 7th-level slot the effect continues a second day (Wisdom save on waking), and with 9th it recurs every day for a week.

name: Lunar Transfer
components: V, S, M (an opal worth 500 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: A moonbeam transports one sleeping creature or an object (fitting in a 10-foot cube, not held by an unwilling creature) that you can see within range to a known destination on your plane; the creature wakes on arrival. An unwilling creature makes a Wisdom save; on a success the spell fails and you arrive at the destination instead. Accuracy works like teleport: the GM rolls a d20 against your familiarity (grove or magic circle, memento, very familiar, seen casually, viewed once, description, or false destination) for on target, off target (5 x d20 miles, never more than half the distance traveled), similar area, or mishap (2d12 force and reroll). You can't target yourself.

name: Moonlight Sending
components: V, S, M (gemstones, incense, and oils worth 400+ gp burned in an alabaster bowl, which the spell consumes)
description: You make an offering to summon a fiend against a distant foe; make a spell attack roll to see what comes: 1 to 4 fails; 5 to 8 a wind demon or quasit; 9 to 12 a rattok demon or bearded devil; 13 to 16 a lesser lunar devil or vrock; 17 to 20 a lunar devil or hezrou; 21 or more an alnaar or horned devil. A DC 10 Charisma (Persuasion) check compels it to seek a creature you name on your plane; on a failure it refuses and the offering is lost. If the target is warded or can't be found, a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check has it report back and vanish; on a failure it demands another offering and attacks you if you don't provide one.

name: Obfuscate Object
description: While you are in dim light, an object within range no larger than a shortsword (on your person, in hand, or unattended) becomes unobtrusive, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks to hide it. You can affect two objects at 5th level, three at 11th, and four at 17th.

name: Ominous Winds
description: Up to three creatures you can see within range make Charisma saves. Until the spell ends, each that fails subtracts 1d12 from every attack roll and saving throw it makes. One extra target per slot level above 2nd.

name: Orros Mark of Fate
casting_time: 1 reaction, when you fail a saving throw
components: V, S, M (a small iron shield)
description: When you fail a saving throw, you succeed instead and choose a creature you can see within 30 feet to suffer the effects of your failure. You still suffer any effects of a successful save. The new target makes its own saving throw against the original effect, with disadvantage.

name: Polychromatic Bubble
components: V, S, M (a chip of soap and a drop of oil)
description: A shimmering 5-foot-radius bubble (10 hit points, AC equal to your spell save DC) encloses a Large or smaller creature or object within range and rises 10 feet at the start of each of your turns, up to 30 feet. A creature inside can't see or hear outside and at the start of its turn makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you until the start of its next turn. A creature outside that attacks the bubble makes a Wisdom save or is charmed until the start of its next turn. One extra bubble per slot level above 4th.

name: Portho's Portal
components: V, S, M (a silver latch or key worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: You open a semicircular portal 5 to 20 feet across in a space within range, linked to a precise place in the mortal or fey realms where you have stood. Only travel through its front works, delivering travelers to the nearest unoccupied space on the other side. Deities and planar rulers can block it in their domains. With a 5th-level slot it lasts 1 week; with 6th or higher it is permanent until dispelled by radiant beacon or wish.

name: Pratfall
description: A creature within range suffers one humiliating mishap of your choice (only one at a time per creature): an oily puddle (Dexterity save or no bonus actions on its next turn); a sneeze (Constitution save or disadvantage on its first attack next turn); strobing lights (Constitution save or passive Perception halved until the end of its next turn); a clap on the ears (Constitution save to maintain concentration); or a tug on its trousers (Dexterity save or disadvantage on its next two-handed weapon attack, or loss of its shield bonus to AC until the end of its next turn).

name: Radiant Beacon
components: V, S, M (a piece of amber)
description: A pillar of light fills your space and the area within 5 feet. Each other creature there makes a Constitution save, taking 4d8 radiant and being blinded until the start of your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success; undead and oozes have disadvantage. For the duration the pillar moves with you, shedding bright sunlight in a 10-foot radius and dim light 20 feet more, visible up to 10 miles away at night.

name: Shadow Adaptation
components: V, S, M (a scrap of black cloth)
description: Your body takes on a fragment of the Shadow Realm. For the duration you are immune to shadow corruption, have resistance to necrotic damage, and have advantage on saves against effects that reduce your Strength score or hit point maximum.

name: Shadow Portal
components: V, M (a silver door latch worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: You create a door in a wall, cliff, tree, or similar surface within 10 feet, bound to a matching door up to 200 feet away that you can see, visualize, or describe by distance and direction. Opening and passing through the near door teleports a creature to the far one. The spell ends when the duration expires or when someone closes the far door as a bonus action. Cast at 5th level, it can open onto a shadow road, possibly requiring that road's own components.

name: Spider Song
components: V, M (a song spider's leg or a tiny lute strung with spider silk)
description: You sing and conjure shadowy webs filling a 20-foot cube within range: lightly obscured, with half cover for creatures inside. Every other round while concentrating you can create a new cube, and the old one fades 1 round later. A creature entering or starting its turn in the area makes a Dexterity save or is incapacitated while it remains in the shadows; it can make a Strength check against your spell save DC each round to break free. Daylight clears the shadows from one cube.

name: Storm Door
description: You teleport in crackling lightning up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Each creature within 5 feet of both where you left and where you arrive makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d12 lightning or half on a success. As a bonus action on each of your turns you can do it again. Outdoors, a storm gathers within 1 minute and follows you, raising the damage to 2d12 and the range to 240 feet. At 5th level or higher one creature of your choice within 5 feet can travel with you, unharmed by the lightning.

name: Ugly Duckling
components: V, S, M (a shard of mirror)
description: A creature within range makes a Charisma save. On a failure it has disadvantage on Charisma checks and anyone it speaks to is indifferent to it for the duration. If it succeeds on a Charisma check while affected, it can repeat the save to end the effect. One extra target per slot level above 2nd.

name: Acid Rain
components: V, S, M (a drop of acid)
description: Acid rain fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-tall cylinder centered within range. Creatures in it make a Dexterity save, 4d6 acid or half on a success, and again when they first enter it on a turn or end their turn there. +1d6 per slot level above 3rd.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Arcanomagnetic Repulsion
description: Attacks against you with ferrous weapons or ammunition have disadvantage, and the area within 20 feet of you is difficult terrain for creatures made of or wearing ferrous metal. When you cast it and as a bonus action on later turns, one Huge or smaller creature in that difficult terrain makes a Strength save or takes 1d6 force and falls prone. +5 feet radius and +1d6 per slot level above 2nd.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Arcanomagnetic Storm
components: V, S, M (a piece of bismuth)
description: A storm fills up to ten connected 10-foot cubes within range; as a bonus action at the start of each turn you can move one cube. A creature starting its turn in it or entering it for the first time on a turn makes a Dexterity save, 4d8 lightning or half. A creature ending its turn there makes a Strength save, 4d8 force and prone or half and not prone (disadvantage if made of or wearing ferrous metal). The area is difficult terrain for ferrous creatures. Both damages +1d8 per slot level above 7th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Aura of Impurity
description: A 30-foot aura moves with you. Creatures of your choice that enter it for the first time on a turn or start their turn there make a Charisma save or are drained until the end of their next turn: subtract 1d4 from ability checks, attack rolls, and saves, and halve hit points regained.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Blinding Radiance
components: V, S, M (a strip of magnesium)
description: You shed bright light 50 feet and dim light 50 more. A creature that first moves within 10 feet of you on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save: 3d10 radiant and blinded until the start of its next turn, or half and not blinded. +1d10 per slot level above 4th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Bone Cage
components: V, S, M (the bones of at least one non-animated corpse, which the spell consumes)
description: Bones from corpses within range form armor, granting temporary hit points per Small or larger corpse: Small 1d6+1, Medium 1d8+2, Large 1d10+5, Huge 1d12+12, Gargantuan 1d20+25. As an action later, erupt the armor, spending all remaining temporary hit points: other creatures in range make a Dexterity save, taking piercing damage equal to the amount spent or half on a success. +10 feet radius per slot level above 5th. Biomancy school in the source; necromancy is the book's alternative.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Can'trip
description: Until the start of your next turn, a creature you can see within range must succeed on a spellcasting ability check against your spell save DC each time it casts a cantrip, or its action is wasted (not a slot). Ends if it leaves range. Also affects 1st-level spells at 5th level, 2nd at 11th, and 3rd at 17th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Chameleon Skin
components: V, S, M (red, yellow, and blue pigment)
description: A creature you touch can Hide as a bonus action even when only lightly obscured. If it didn't move on its last turn, sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks to see it have disadvantage. One extra target per slot level above 1st. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Concussion
description: A creature you can see within range makes a Constitution save or takes 1d8 thunder and is deafened until the start of your next turn. 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Conjure Anomaly
description: An aberration of CR 5 or lower (GM's choice) appears within range, friendly, with its own initiative, obeying your verbal commands and otherwise defending itself. It vanishes at 0 hit points or when the spell ends. If your concentration breaks it turns hostile and stays 1 hour. CR +1 per slot level above 5th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Corrupting Ichor
description: Ranged spell attack: 2d8 necrotic, and until the target uses an action to wipe off the phlegm it takes 1d4 necrotic at the start of each of its turns and halves hit points it regains. The ongoing damage rises 1d4 per slot level above 1st.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Daydream
components: V, S, M (a tiny, four-panelled window)
description: A humanoid you can see makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks (-5 passive) for the duration; charm-immune creatures are unaffected. It only notices the magic if it succeeds by 5 or more. Per slot level above 1st, one extra target or +30 feet of range.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Depth Charge
description: A thunderous pulse in a 20-foot-radius sphere: Constitution save, 7d6 thunder (9d6 if submerged) or half. Heard 300 feet away, 1,000 in liquid. +1d6 per slot level above 3rd.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Dreamwalk
description: Up to ten willing creatures can dream lucidly when they sleep and always know if dream targets them. Each can choose to fall asleep instantly when you cast it, even if normally immune to magical sleep.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Endoleech
components: V, S, M (a toenail lost to frostbite)
description: Melee spell attack: 5d6 cold, the target can't take reactions until the end of its next turn, and until then its speed drops 15 feet while yours rises 15 feet. +1d6 per slot level above 2nd. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Feverskin
components: V, S, M (a red hot chilli pepper, which the spell consumes)
description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature in reach: 6d6 fire. You can repeat the attack as an action each turn. For the duration your walking speed is +15 feet and you gain 2d6 temporary hit points at the start of each turn. +1d6 per slot level above 5th. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Frogskin
description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature in reach: 3d10 poison and poisoned until the end of your next turn; repeat as an action each turn. You have advantage to avoid being grappled or restrained and disadvantage to grapple. Creatures grappling you or grappled by you make a Constitution save at the start of their turns, 3d10 poison or half. Both damages +1d10 per slot level above 4th. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Gravity Smash
description: A 40-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn. When the spell ends, creatures inside make a Strength save: 8d10 force and prone if it lasted the full round (4d10 if it ended early), or half and not prone. +1d10 per slot level above 5th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Lungburst
description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save (disadvantage if holding its breath): 7d6 thunder plus 7d6 necrotic and it begins suffocating, or half and no suffocation. It repeats the save at the end of each turn to stop suffocating; greater restoration, heal, or wish also ends it. Creatures that don't breathe are immune. Both damages +1d6 per slot level above 6th. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Magnetite Shard
components: V, S, M (a piece of magnetite)
description: An icy, metallic explosion in a 20-foot-radius sphere: Dexterity save, 4d6 cold plus 3d6 piercing or half (disadvantage if made of or wearing ferrous metal). Cold +1d6 per slot level above 3rd.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Magnetobolt
description: Ranged spell attack: 1d6 force, and a Strength save or prone (disadvantage for ferrous creatures). 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th, 4d6 at 17th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Mortiferous Pulse
description: A 5-foot-wide, 50-foot line: Dexterity save, 3d8 necrotic or half. +1d8 per slot level above 2nd. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Pins and Needles
description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save or takes 1d8 psychic; failing by 5 or more gives it disadvantage on its next attack before the end of its next turn. 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Preserve
description: Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere within range make a Charisma save or are soulbound for the duration; one that dies while soulbound can be harvested for 24 hours. Creatures of robust essence (about CR 7+) automatically succeed; the threshold rises to potent (CR 12+) at 4th level, mythic (CR 18+) at 6th, and deific (CR 25+) at 8th. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Riptide
description: A creature you can see in water at least 2 feet deep makes a Strength save at the start of each of its turns or is dragged 30 feet in a direction you choose and has swim speed 0 until the start of its next turn. A bonus action changes the direction. Ends if it leaves range or the water.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Stench
description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of fumes. A creature that enters it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save: 3d6 poison and poisoned until the end of its next turn (with disadvantage on concentration saves), or half and not poisoned. +1d6 per slot level above 3rd.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Swarm
description: A creature within range makes a Dexterity save or is poisoned until the end of its next turn. From 5th level a failure also deals 1d10 poison, 2d10 at 11th, 3d10 at 17th. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Switcheroo
description: A Large or smaller creature you can see makes a Charisma save (automatic success if there isn't room; willing creatures can fail) or you swap places by teleportation. +30 feet range per slot level above 3rd; Huge targets at 6th level, Gargantuan at 9th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Water Whip
description: Choose at least 4 pints of water you can see within range and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet of it: 1d6 slashing, and a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or is pulled 10 feet toward the water. 2d6 and 15 feet at 5th level, 3d6 and 20 at 11th, 4d6 and 25 at 17th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Zippit!
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature within range vocalises
description: The creature makes a Constitution save or its mouth fuses shut, silencing it; a spell with verbal components it was casting is lost but the slot isn't spent. At the end of each of its turns it can make a Strength save to tear free (taking 1d8 slashing), or as an action cut its mouth open with a blade (1d8 slashing). +1d8 per slot level above 3rd. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Can't Trip
description: A willing creature you can see is immune to being prone until the end of your next turn; if it is already prone and not restrained, it stands up. Two creatures at 5th level, three at 11th, four at 17th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Cannotrip
description: Each time a creature you can see tries to cast a spell of this spell's level or lower, it must succeed on a spellcasting ability check against your spell save DC or waste its action (not its slot). Inhibits one spell level higher per slot level above 1st.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Eelskin
description: A willing creature's unarmed strikes and natural weapons become magical, and its first such hit each turn deals +1d8 lightning. It has advantage to avoid being grappled or restrained and disadvantage to grapple. +1d8 per two slot levels above 2nd. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Endure
components: V, S, M (a gem-encrusted cockroach worth 250 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: A willing creature needs no food or water, ignores exhaustion and poison, and can't be incapacitated, stunned, paralyzed, or knocked unconscious. Damage that would drop it to 0 makes it roll a death save instead; three failures kill it. Afterward it gains a level of exhaustion per failed save and falls unconscious (wakeable only by wish) for as long as the spell lasted. Duration 10 minutes at 6th level, 1 hour at 7th, 8 hours at 8th, 1 day at 9th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Enrage
description: Humanoids in a 20-foot-radius sphere make a Charisma save (may choose to fail) or become hostile to all creatures; a concentrating one makes a DC 10 Constitution save each turn or loses concentration. As an action, force one to use its reaction to attack a random creature in reach; if it was friendly to that creature, it can repeat the save after. A creature repeats the save when it takes damage. One extra forced attacker per slot level above 3rd.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Ferocious Strike
description: Make one weapon attack; on a hit it deals +1d4 of the weapon's damage type. 2d4 at 5th level, 3d4 at 11th, 4d4 at 17th. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Firther's Shadow
description: A creature you can see makes an Intelligence save: 4d10 psychic and you learn one random fact (name, a fear, a desire, condition immunities, damage defenses, or proficiencies), or half and nothing learned. Intelligence 4 or lower succeeds automatically. If it failed, each turn your action forces another save: 4d6 psychic and another fact, or half and the spell ends. +1d10 initial and +1d6 ongoing per slot level above 3rd.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Fixit
components: V, S, M (adhesive tape with ducks drawn on it)
description: A broken item no larger than 20 feet is whole for the duration, and if you knew its magical function and it was common, it regains its magic. Uncommon at 3rd level, rare at 5th, very rare at 7th, legendary at 9th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Flare
components: V, S, M (a strip of magnesium)
description: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 radiant, and on a critical hit attacks against the target have advantage until the end of your next turn. Or launch it into the air to shed bright light 20 feet and dim 20 more until the end of your next turn. 2d8 and 30 feet at 5th level, 3d8 and 40 at 11th, 4d8 and 50 at 17th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Flipperform
description: A willing creature grows webbed fingers and a swim speed equal to its walking speed. One extra creature and double duration per slot level above 1st. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Food Coma
components: V, S, M (a turkey drumstick and a cranberry-coloured ruby worth at least 50 gp, both of which the spell consumes)
description: A willing creature that eats the enchanted drumstick sleeps for 1 hour, waking early only from damage or greater restoration or wish. If it sleeps the full hour it wakes with all hit points restored; woken early, nothing happens. One extra drumstick per slot level above 3rd.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Fungal Infection
description: Creatures in a 15-foot-radius sphere make a Constitution save or are cursed with a fungus you choose, repeating the save at the end of each turn. Amanita Rotgut: 2d6 poison now, poisoned, and 2d6 at the end of each turn. Necrotising Zygomycosis: 2d8 necrotic now and at the start of each turn. Psilocybin: d4 each turn, on a 1 no move or actions. Paralysing Mucorales: stunned at the end of each turn until its next (paralyzed if it failed by 5+). Raging Henbane: charmed and attacks a random creature with its reaction. Veiled Lady: disadvantage on Dexterity saves and ranged attacks against it have advantage. Damage +1d6/+1d8 per slot level above 4th; two fungi at 6th level. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Gravity Repulsion
description: Ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage, and the area within 20 feet is difficult terrain for creatures you choose. When you cast it and as a bonus action later, a Huge or smaller creature within 20 feet makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet, falls prone, and takes 3d6 force. +5 feet radius, +1d6, and +5 feet pulse range per slot level above 4th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Howl
description: A magically carried animal call heard for 1,000 feet. One familiar creature you choose understands its meaning and can reply the same way; others need comprehend languages or the ability to understand beasts.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Humperdink's Halitosis
description: Acid fumes fill a 15-foot cone, spreading around corners: Constitution save, 3d4 acid or half. The fumes linger until the end of your next turn (or a moderate wind) and a creature ending its turn there saves again. +1d4 per slot level above 1st.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Incorporeality
description: A willing creature turns translucent. At the start of each of its turns it can become incorporeal until the end of the turn: advantage on Stealth, resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, and it moves through creatures and objects as difficult terrain (ending inside one shunts it out for 1d10 force per 5 feet). Per slot level above 5th, one extra target or longer duration (10 minutes, 1 hour, 8 hours, 24 hours).
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Inequality
components: V, S, M (a drop of blood and water, mixed)
description: Choose two creatures within range to favor and disfavor; the disfavored makes a Charisma save. On a failure the favored adds 1d4 to attacks and saves and gains half its speed, while the disfavored subtracts 1d4 and has its speed halved. Ends for the pair if either falls unconscious or dies; they can't benefit from bless or suffer bane meanwhile. One extra pair per two slot levels above 2nd.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Influenza
description: A 30-foot cone of sneeze: Dexterity save, 3d6 poison and poisoned for the duration, or half. Poisoned creatures repeat a Constitution save at the end of each turn and roll a d12 at the start of each turn; on 3 or lower they are incapacitated by coughing until their next turn, and creatures within 5 feet make a Constitution save or catch it. +1d6 and +1 to the coughing threshold per slot level above 3rd. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Initiative
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when initiative is rolled
description: A willing creature you can see is no longer surprised, or if not surprised has advantage on the initiative roll. One extra creature per slot level above 1st.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Mass Leech
components: V, S, M (a live leech that has fed on humanoid blood in the past 24 hours)
description: Creatures of your choice within 20 feet make a Constitution save, 2d8 necrotic or half. You regain hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt to Small or larger creatures. +1d8 per slot level above 3rd.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Mechamagic
components: V, S, M (adhesive tape with gorillas drawn on it)
description: An item gains a property for its wearer. Armor: 1d4 temporary hit points each turn. Belt: fly speed 30 feet. Boots: +10 feet speed and triple jump distance. Cloak: advantage on Stealth to hide and can hide when lightly obscured. Gloves: climb speed equal to walking speed, spider-climbing, and advantage on grapple checks. Headwear: no need to breathe, advantage against poison, and poison resistance. Ends if you touch the item or recast it. One extra item per slot level above 4th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Mireball
components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of guano and mud)
description: Mud explodes in a 15-foot-radius sphere: Strength save, 3d10 bludgeoning and prone, or half. For 1 minute the first time a creature moves through the mud on a turn it makes a Dexterity save or falls prone, unless moving at half speed. +1d10 per slot level above 3rd.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Peppermint Plate
components: V, S, M (well-chewed peppermint chewing gum)
description: +1 AC, and a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d4 fire (once per turn). +1d4 per slot level above 1st.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Power Word Shield
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see is the target of an attack or spell
description: Until the end of its next turn the creature is immune to all damage except psychic, has advantage on saves, and other power word spells have no effect on it. It stops being poisoned and any fire on it is extinguished.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Primal Scent
description: Advantage on your next smell-based ability check, treating a d20 roll of 4 or lower as 5. Thereafter, smell-based checks treat 7 or lower as 8 at 5th level, 10 or lower as 11 at 11th, and 13 or lower as 14 at 17th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Protection
components: V, S, M (a miniature silver shield worth 10 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: A ward circles a willing creature. Right before it next takes non-psychic damage, it gains resistance to all non-psychic damage (including that hit) until the end of its next turn, and the spell ends. One extra creature per slot level above 2nd.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Shackles of Pain
components: V, S, M (a pair of manacles)
description: Link a willing source to a target that fails a Charisma save. Whenever the source takes damage, the target takes psychic damage equal to half and can repeat the save to end it. If you are the source, the target takes it before your concentration save.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Shielding Word
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature within range that you can see is hit by an attack from an attacker you can see or fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw
description: The creature gains 15 temporary hit points just before the triggering damage, lasting until the start of its next turn. Per slot level above 2nd, +30 feet range or +5 temporary hit points.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Smokescreen
description: Dense smoke heavily obscures a 5-foot-diameter, 10-foot-high cylinder on you until the start of your next turn, staying put or moving with you. Maximum size 15 feet at 5th level, 25 at 11th, 40 at 17th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Spark
description: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 lightning, and a critical hit also blinds until the end of its next turn. Two sparks at 5th level, three at 11th, four at 17th, each a separate attack.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Spore Cloud
description: Each other creature within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d4 poison, and failing by 5 or more poisons it until the end of its next turn. 2d4 at 5th level, 3d4 at 11th, 4d4 at 17th. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Stalker's Eye
description: A willing creature's next attack has advantage, then the spell ends. That attack crits on 19 to 20 at 5th level, 18 to 20 at 11th, and 17 to 20 at 17th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Sugar Rush
description: A willing creature gains +15 feet speed, +1 AC, and can Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object as a bonus action. When the spell ends, or if it doesn't move its walking speed on a turn, it is poisoned until the end of its next turn. One extra creature per slot level above 2nd. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Tentacle Lash
description: Your arm becomes a tentacle. When you cast it and as an action each turn, make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet: 5d8 bludgeoning, and a Huge or smaller target makes a Strength save or you knock it prone, shove it 5 feet, or take an item it holds. It also works as a grappling hook or rope. +1d8 per slot level above 4th. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: The Bends
description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save: 5d8 poison (d10s if fully submerged) and poisoned for 1 minute, or half. It repeats the save each turn to end the poison. +1d8 per slot level above 3rd. Biomancy school in the source.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Totem Arrows
components: V, S, M (a quiver containing at least one piece of ammunition)
description: Ammunition in a quiver carries a spirit (change it as a bonus action). Cat: +1d6 slashing, 2d6 with advantage. Elk: +1d6 bludgeoning and Strength save or prone or shoved 5 feet. Hawk: ignores half and three-quarters cover. Hogweed: Constitution save or blinded until the end of its next turn. Psilocybin: Wisdom save or tripping (d4 each turn, on 1 incapacitated and the effect ends). Roc: Strength save or speed 0 and lifted 20 feet until the end of its next turn. Snake: +1d6 poison and Constitution save or poisoned. Spider: Dexterity save or restrained until the end of its next turn. Concentration up to 8 hours at 5th level or higher.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Weavebend
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you see a creature within range casting a spell
description: Redirect a spell of 3rd level or lower: retarget a ranged spell attack to a creature within 10 feet of the original target, or shift an area up to 10 feet. For 4th level or higher, succeed on a spellcasting ability check against DC 10 + its level. With a higher slot, spells below that slot's level are redirected automatically.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Weave Entanglement
components: V, S, M (a piece of felt)
description: A creature casting a 1st-level or higher spell in a 20-foot-radius sphere makes a spellcasting ability check against your DC; on a failure its spell works but a d10 side effect also targets it: gravity smash, phantasmal killer, confusion, fireball, zippit!, web, darkness, silence, 2d10 healing, or no slot spent. Side effects need no concentration and end on a d20 of 11+ rolled at initiative 20 each round. +10 feet radius per slot level above 6th.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2

name: Aegir's Breath
description: Ranged spell attack: 1d10 Cold, or 1d12 if the target is at least partly submerged. Cantrip Upgrade: two clouds at level 5, three at 11, four at 17, each a separate attack.

name: Angrboda's Fury
description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or gains Vulnerability to a damage type you choose (if Immune to it, it loses the Immunity instead). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Aspect of the Narwhal
description: A willing creature grows flippers and a tusk: Resistance to Cold while submerged, Speed 5 feet, Swim Speed 50 feet, and on a turn it moves 15 feet straight toward an enemy it can gore as a Bonus Action for 2d6 + Strength modifier Piercing.

name: Awaken Ship Guardian
description: A spirit guards a Large or larger ship: Immunity to Fire damage; a Large or larger creature that damages it makes a Wisdom save, 5d6 Psychic or half; and while aboard you can expend a spell slot as a Bonus Action to restore Hit Points equal to three times the slot level + your spellcasting modifier.

name: Bearstormer
components: V, S, M (a pinch of bear fur)
description: Three phantasmal bears fill a 20-foot Cube you can move 40 feet as a Bonus Action. Enemies in it when it appears, when it moves onto them, or when they enter or end their turn there make an Intelligence save (once per turn): 4d8 Psychic and Frightened until the end of their next turn, or half only. Per slot level above 5: +20 feet cube, two more bears, +2d8.

name: Beast of Ragnarok
components: V, S, M (a bezoar formed in a wolf's stomach)
description: A 1-mile Sphere around you darkens to Dim Light with heavy snow (Difficult Terrain, Heavily Obscured) that doesn't hinder you. You have Advantage on all d20 Tests and on saves to resist or end conditions, attacks against you have Disadvantage, and you have Immunity to all damage except one random type (d12), to which you are Vulnerable.

name: Bergelmir's Provocation
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when you see a creature make an attack or spell attack
description: The attacker makes a Wisdom save or attacks a different eligible target of your choice (not itself); with no other target, the attack is wasted.

name: Beseech the Norns
components: V, S, M (a silver spindle worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: Choose one. Change the Past: a creature you can see that died since the start of your last turn returns with 1 Hit Point (not old age, no missing parts). Guide the Present: your first attack roll or ability check before the end of your turn counts as a natural 20. Shape the Future: Advantage on ability checks and saves for 1 minute from the start of your next turn. Each extra casting before a Long Rest has a cumulative 25 percent chance to fail.

name: Billowing Sails
description: A wind-powered vehicle's sailing Speed increases by 10 feet (or 1 mph).

name: Bone-Chilling Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The target takes an extra 3d8 Necrotic and makes a Constitution save or gains an Exhaustion level until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns it saves again: success removes this spell's Exhaustion, failure adds a level. +1d8 per slot level above 3.

name: Bound Fortunes
components: V, S, M (two small spindles bound together with thread)
description: Bind your fate to a willing creature. While within 60 feet, either of you can use a Reaction to let the other reroll an ability check, attack roll, or save; each time, both your Hit Point maximums drop by 1d4 (dying at 0) until the spell ends.

name: Bragi's Theatrical Fall
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when an attack would reduce you to 0 Hit Points but not kill you outright
components: V, M (a drop of your blood)
description: Instead of dropping to 0, you drop to Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier, become Invisible, and leave an illusion of your corpse (Study and an Investigation check against your DC reveals it). Invisibility ends if you attack, cast a healing spell, or harm a creature.

name: Branch and Root of Yggdrasil
components: V, S, M (branch, leaf, or bark from a World Tree)
description: Touching a tree, you and up to eight willing creatures touching it travel to a random spot on Yggdrasil, or a chosen general destination if you touch a World Tree. Your Hit Point maximum drops by a roll of one of your Hit Dice until a Long Rest.

name: Call to Action
casting_time: Reaction, which you take in response to another creature's turn starting
description: The creature can immediately use its Reaction to Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help.

name: Claws of the Bear
components: V, S, M (a tuft of bear fur)
description: Your arms become bear paws; make a melee spell attack: 3d10 + spellcasting modifier Slashing, and a target no more than one size larger is knocked Prone. You can attack with the claws for the duration. 4d10 with level 5 or 6 slots, 5d10 with 7 or 8, and 6d8 at 9.

name: Coldheart
description: A Beast or Humanoid you can see makes a Constitution save or gains an Exhaustion level; at the end of its next turn it saves again or gains another. The Exhaustion remains after the spell.

name: Compel Avarice
description: Choose an object you can see. The target makes a Wisdom save (charm-immune creatures succeed) or must try to take it, stealing or fighting its holder, then fleeing to guard it until the spell ends.

name: Disrupt the Wyrd
casting_time: Reaction, which you take in response to a saving throw being rolled by a creature that you can see within 30 feet of yourself
components: V, S, M (a tangle of thread)
description: The creature rerolls the save, adding or subtracting your spellcasting modifier (your choice), and must use the new result.

name: Drummer's Cadence
description: Allied, adequately crewed ships within a 60-foot Emanation move 10 feet faster by oar.

name: Earthsail
components: V, S, M (a handful of mud and a handful of sea water)
description: A sailing vessel with a crew up to 10 treats soil, mud, and packed dirt as water, sweeping aside snow, ice, plants, and small stones (not boulders). Level 7: crew up to 30 for 24 hours. Level 9: any crew for 1 week.

name: Encase in Ice
components: V, S, M (a handful of water)
description: A wave freezes over a 20-foot square. Creatures there make a Dexterity save or are Restrained (action and Strength (Athletics) against your DC, or Help, to free). Others treat it as Difficult Terrain and make a Dexterity save or fall Prone on entering or ending a turn there. Level 3: trapped creatures can't Attack or cast somatic spells. Level 5: they are entombed with Total Cover, saving each turn and taking 2d6 Cold either way.

name: Ensnared Threads
components: V, S, M (a knotted string of wool)
description: A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or is linked to you; once per turn the first attack that hits you hits it instead, if it could be targeted. With a level 8 or 9 slot, every such attack is redirected.

name: Extinguish
description: Put out any magical or nonmagical flames you choose in a 60-foot Cube from you; creatures made of fire take 1d12 Force. Per slot level above 1: +10 feet and +1d12.

name: Eyes of the Raven
description: Advantage on Intelligence checks and saves. As a Magic action you can gain Truesight 30 feet until the start of your next turn, then the spell ends.

name: Fenris's Howl
description: Creatures you choose within 60 feet of a point that can hear you make a Wisdom save or are Frightened of you for the duration. While any remain Frightened, your Speed is doubled and your attacks deal an extra 3d6 Necrotic to Frightened enemies.

name: Fiery Siege
components: V, S, M (a bit of pitch)
description: A siege weapon you touch deals an extra 1d10 Fire on hits. A Bonus Action moves the effect to another siege engine you touch.

name: Fire Rune
description: A melee weapon you touch bears a fire rune and deals an extra 1d8 Fire on a hit.

name: Fist of the Frost Jarl
components: V, S, M (a drop of water melted from an icicle)
description: A 5-foot fist of ice flies along a 120-foot Line: Dexterity save, 4d8 Cold or half. One Huge or smaller creature that failed can be Grappled (escape DC your spell save DC), taking 2d8 Cold at the end of each of its turns until it escapes and the fist shatters. +1d8 per slot level above 4; at level 7+ it ignores Cold Resistance.

name: Freezing Fog
description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog is Heavily Obscured Difficult Terrain until a strong wind disperses it. A creature starting its turn there or entering makes a Constitution save or has its Speed halved until the end of its next turn, and takes 2d4 Cold per 5 feet it moves inside. You are immune.

name: Freyja's Allure
description: A creature makes a Charisma save or has Disadvantage on attacks and can't willingly move farther from you. It repeats the save at the end of each turn (with Disadvantage if it can see you within 30 feet). One extra target per slot level above 1.

name: Freyja's Grace
casting_time: Reaction, which you take after failing a saving throw
description: Reroll the failed save as a Charisma save, whatever its original type.

name: Ghostly Crew
description: Spirits crew a vessel you touch; while you are within 30 feet it can take a full complement of ship actions, including movement and siege weapons. They can't fight or repair.

name: Giantbane
description: Advantage on attacks against Large or larger creatures, and your attacks deal an extra 2d6 Force to them.

name: Giantdodge
description: +20 feet Speed, +2 AC against Large or larger attackers, and you don't provoke their Opportunity Attacks.

name: Giant's Teeth
components: V, S, M (a handful of molars)
description: Huge teeth clamp a creature within 90 feet: it is Grappled (escape DC your spell save DC) and takes 2d10 Bludgeoning at the start of each of its turns; escaping ends the spell. 3d10 at level 5, 5d8 at 7, 6d8 at 9.

name: Glimpse the Wyrd
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when a creature succeeds or fails on a d20 Test
description: Add or subtract 1d6 from the d20 Test.

name: Hearthfire
description: A Large or smaller unattended object sheds Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light 20 more; you and creatures you choose in its Bright Light are immune to Extreme Cold.

name: Hungry Jaws of Fenris
description: Your mouth becomes a wolf's maw (you can't speak or cast verbal spells). Bite attacks deal 4d10 + spellcasting modifier Piercing and Grapple (escape DC your spell save DC). Biting a creature you already grapple can swallow it into a pocket dimension: Blinded, Restrained, Total Cover, and 3d12 Force at the start of each of your turns; it saves at the end of its turns to be vomited out, as it is when the spell ends. One creature at a time. +1d12 bite per slot level above 6.

name: Ice Shape
description: Shape a section of ice no more than 5 feet in any dimension into a crude but functional form: a weapon, statue, coffer, a passage through 5 feet of ice, or a seal over a narrow opening.

name: Icewalker
components: V, S, M (a shard of ice)
description: In a 30-foot Emanation, you and creatures you choose treat slippery ice as normal terrain and count as one-tenth their weight for breaking thin ice.

name: Inbar's Giant-Friend
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when a Giant sees you
components: V, S, M (a hair or nail clipping from a goblinoid)
description: The Giant makes a Wisdom save or its attitude toward you improves one step. Charm-immune Giants are unaffected, and each Giant can be targeted only once.

name: Infectious Skal
description: A creature that hears your drinking song makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed and Friendly, doing nothing but singing along. Each Bonus Action spreads it to another creature within 30 feet of you or a singer (two per Bonus Action at level 3+), up to your spellcasting modifier in total. If any singer is attacked, the spell ends for all.

name: Jotun Form
components: V, S, M (a shard of a giant animal's bone)
description: Shape-shift into a Giant you have seen with CR up to your level, gaining Temporary Hit Points equal to its Hit Points. You use its stat block but keep your type, alignment, mental scores, Hit Points, Hit Dice, proficiencies, communication, and Spellcasting. A Magic action changes to another eligible form.

name: Loki's Escape
casting_time: Reaction, which you take after taking damage
description: You are Invisible until the end of your next turn and can use a Bonus Action to move your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Ends after you attack, deal damage, or cast a spell.

name: Luckfingers
description: A Medium or smaller creature has Advantage on ability checks; on a failed check it can end the spell for itself to succeed instead. One extra creature per slot level above 3.

name: Melody of Sheltered Rest
description: A 30-foot Emanation gives creatures in it Advantage on Perception checks and prevents them from being surprised. A creature in the aura that keeps singing can extend it by 2 hours, repeatedly.

name: Murmurs of Doom
description: A 30-foot Emanation of dirge. When you create it and at the start of each of your turns, one creature in it makes a Constitution save or takes 3d8 Necrotic.

name: Noble Sacrifice
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when a creature you can see drops to 0 Hit Points or fails its third Death Saving Throw
description: The creature is restored to 1 Hit Point, and you lose half your current Hit Points.

name: Ode to Wrath
description: In a 30-foot Emanation, you and your allies add your spellcasting ability modifier to melee weapon damage rolls.

name: Pawn of the Wyrd
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when another creature takes a Reaction
description: The creature's Reaction doesn't happen and it can't take another; any slot or resource it would have spent is not spent. You lose your next Reaction.

name: Protection Rune
description: A rune on a creature's skin gives it Resistance to one damage type of your choice.

name: Reaver's Rune
description: A rune on a melee weapon lets its wielder make one attack per turn with Advantage. Ends if the weapon leaves their possession.

name: Regenerative Hull
description: A vehicle with at least 1 Hit Point regains Hit Points equal to twice your spellcasting modifier at the start of each of your turns.

name: Reinforce Hull
description: A vehicle with a damage threshold has it increased by your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Repair Hull
description: A vehicle with at least 1 Hit Point regains 4d12 + spellcasting modifier Hit Points. +1d12 per slot level above 3.

name: Sailor's Shanty
description: A vehicle's crew has Advantage on d20 Tests to control or operate it.

name: Shared Expertise
components: V, S, M (a piece of boot leather)
description: Choose up to two skills you have Expertise in; allies in a 30-foot Emanation count as proficient in them.

name: Shield-Maiden's Favor
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when you or an ally takes damage
description: A spectral shield-maiden reduces the triggering damage by 1d10 + your spellcasting modifier. +1d10 per slot level above 1.

name: Sif's Grace
components: V, M (two silver beads of equal weight)
description: A creature's Speed doubles, Opportunity Attacks against it have Disadvantage, and it has Advantage on Acrobatics checks on turns it moves. It can end the spell for itself to automatically succeed on a Dexterity save. One extra creature per slot level above 3.

name: Skaldic Scolding
casting_time: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 30 feet of yourself
description: The creature makes a Charisma save: 4d10 Psychic and Incapacitated until the start of your next turn (Stunned if it fails by 5 or more), or half and no condition. +1d10 per slot level above 4.

name: Song of the Shield Wall
description: Spectral shields give up to your spellcasting modifier creatures within 30 feet +2 AC (+3 with a level 6 slot, +4 with level 8).

name: Speechmaster's Rune
description: A creature holding the runed stone has Advantage on Charisma checks.

name: Storm Maiden's Edge
description: A weapon deals an extra 2d8 Lightning on a hit, and the target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet (and knocked Prone if it fails by 5 or more). +1d8 per two slot levels above 3.

name: Summon Leviathan Avatar
components: V, S, M (a drop of seawater)
description: A Huge leviathan spirit appears in enough water to hold it, acting after you on your Initiative and obeying your commands (Dodge otherwise). AC 13 + spell level, 70 Hit Points (+10 per level above 7), Swim 50 feet; Multiattack of Rends equal to half the spell level (1d10 + 5 + spell level Piercing, reach 10 feet) and a 30-foot cone Roar (Constitution save or Frightened).

name: Sun Rune
description: Once, a creature holding the runed stone can throw it 60 feet as an action; it bursts in a 30-foot Sphere: Constitution save, 4d6 Fire plus 4d6 Radiant or half. Unattended flammables ignite, and snow or ice turns to Heavily Obscuring fog for 1 minute. Only one Sun Rune at a time; a creature can activate one per Long Rest.

name: Talons of the Eagle
description: Advantage on Dexterity checks and saves. As a Magic action, grow talons, move up to your Speed, and make a melee talon attack: 1d8 + spellcasting modifier Slashing. +1d8 per two slot levels above 1.

name: Thought Rune
description: A creature holding the runed stone has Advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and saves.

name: Trickster's Bluff
components: V, M (the petrified tongue of a serpent)
description: Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks. When you fail one, you can deal 1d4 Psychic to the creature you failed to fool and give it Disadvantage on attacks until the start of your next turn.

name: Trollblood Infusion
components: V, S, M (a drop of troll blood)
description: A creature regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns (if it has at least 1) and automatically succeeds on Death Saving Throws. Acid or Fire damage stops the regeneration on its next turn.

name: Truth's Blade
components: V, S, M (a silver pin, which is not consumed)
description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or takes 4d8 Psychic whenever it lies for the duration. +1d8 per slot level above 3.

name: Valhalla's Cohort
description: A Huge cohort of spectral warriors appears; move it 30 feet as a Bonus Action. When it ends its move within 5 feet of a creature or a creature moves within 5 feet of it, make a melee spell attack: 2d10 + spellcasting modifier Force (once per creature per turn). +1d10 per slot level above 4.

name: Valkyrie's Guidance
components: V, S, M (a polished blue stone)
description: Choose a creature you can see: Advantage on melee attacks against it and Intelligence checks to recall lore about it. Ends if you don't attack it on your turn.

name: Valkyrie's Vision
description: You know the current Hit Points and Exhaustion of creatures you can see within 30 feet. As a Bonus Action, stabilize a dying creature within 30 feet, ending the spell.

name: Wall of Snow
components: V, S, M (a freshly packed snowball)
description: Create a snow wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a 10-foot-radius dome. Each 10-foot section has AC 10 and 10 Hit Points, Immunity to Cold, Poison, and Psychic, and Vulnerability to Fire and Radiant. Creatures in an intact dome are immune to Extreme Cold. In snowy terrain it blends in (Investigation against your DC to spot).

name: Weave Detonation
components: V, S, M (a short piece of thread)
description: Creatures in a 20-foot-radius Sphere make a Wisdom save or have Disadvantage on all d20 Tests for 1 minute (save at the end of each turn). Per slot level above 3, exclude up to five creatures.

name: Whiteout
description: Outdoors only. A 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog and snow centered on you is Heavily Obscured Difficult Terrain. A creature starting its turn there or entering makes a Constitution save or gains an Exhaustion level (Cold-resistant creatures succeed; up to your spellcasting modifier creatures you designate are exempt). The Exhaustion ends when the spell does.

name: Wotan's Retribution
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when a creature scores a Critical Hit against you
description: Teleport behind the attacker and make a melee weapon attack with Advantage; on a hit it also takes damage equal to what its critical dealt you.

name: Wyrd Sight
description: Once per turn, roll 1d12 and add it to or subtract it from a d20 roll by a creature you can see.

name: Airbag
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage
description: An airbag reduces the triggering damage by 1d6. +1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Avian Courier
description: A magic bird carries an unattended object of up to 50 pounds within range to a surface within 200 feet along an unobstructed path, arriving at the start of your next turn. +50 pounds and +100 feet per slot level above 1.

name: Bait
description: A spectral flying-fish lure appears and moves 20 feet (again as a Bonus Action on later turns). Creatures that see it within 5 feet as it passes make a Wisdom save or are Baited (one fewer attack if they take the Attack action next turn) or Dragged (follow the lure, provoking Opportunity Attacks, and lose that much Speed next turn), your choice.

name: Borrow Magic
description: A willing creature lends you a level 1 spell slot, which you can use once before the start of your next turn or lose. A creature can lend three slots per Long Rest. Cantrip Upgrade: level 2 slots at level 5, level 3 at 11, level 4 at 17.

name: Charge
description: A working machine you touch is powered as if whelmed by a spirit or permanently enchanted. Duration 1 day with level 3 or 4 slots, 7 days with 5 or 6, 30 days with 7 or 8, and 1 year at 9.

name: Correspondence
components: S, M (a ball of wax worth 10+ GF, which the spell consumes; a blank piece of paper; and an envelope)
description: A creature's spoken message of up to 100 words is recorded and sealed. The designated recipient opens it as a Magic action (or Knock opens it) and it reads aloud in the speaker's voice. Anyone else forcing it open makes a Wisdom save: failure leaves the seal intact, success destroys the envelope.

name: Demon Lure
description: A totem becomes enticing to demons (Fiends) in a 150-foot Emanation. A demon starting its turn there without Total Cover makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed and must Dash toward the totem each turn, until it comes within 5 feet, leaves the plane, or saves again after taking damage or being shaken. Larger Emanation with higher slots (300 to 1,000 feet). Outside Obojima, it can target Aberrations, Fey, Fiends, or Undead.

name: Detect Curse
description: Sense curses within 30 feet; as a Magic action see auras on cursed creatures or objects and learn the item or spell that caused a curse and its rarity or level. Blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood, 1 inch of metal, or thin lead.

name: Fire Hydrant
components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
description: A Small hydrant (AC your spell save DC, 30 Hit Points) blasts a 20-foot by 5-foot Line of water; creatures in it, or entering or ending a turn there, make a Strength save or are pushed to the end of the Line. A Bonus Action redirects the stream.

name: Gotcha!
description: A capsule machine dispenses a random potion from the Combat, Utility, or Whimsy list of Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass (d20; +10 with a level 2+ slot). It vanishes if unused within 1 hour.

name: Graffiti Trap
components: V, S, M (a jar of paint worth 5+ GF, which the spell consumes)
description: Paint a mundane-seeming trap up to 5 feet across (Investigation against your DC reveals it). It triggers when a non-designated creature comes within 5 feet, or as your Magic action against a creature within 10 feet; you are alerted. Dexterity save or pulled to the surface and Restrained for 1 minute (Athletics to escape, or a gallon of water); on a success, Speed halved. Lasts 8 hours to 30 days with higher slots.

name: Identify Curse
components: V, S, M (a small Kyojin Candle worth 50+ GF, which the spell consumes)
description: Learn a curse's effects, source, and how to end it on a creature or object you touch, or the effects of a curse on a 30-foot Emanation (or whether a cursed creature or object passed through in the last 24 hours).

name: One-Way Street
components: V, S, M (crushed rocks or sand)
description: An illusory road up to 15 feet wide and 120 feet long; creatures moving along it in any direction but the one you chose spend 3 feet of movement per foot.

name: Soda Pop
description: Throw a summoned can; when the spell ends it bursts in a Sphere starting at 10 feet and growing 5 feet each of your turns: Dexterity save, accumulated Force damage or half. Base 8d4; moving it 20 feet or shaking it (Bonus Action) adds 1d4 once per round, up to 14d4. Ends early if a creature is carrying it at the end of a turn. +1d4 base and maximum per slot level above 3.

name: Stop Sign
description: A spectral stop sign appears within 5 feet of you until your next turn; a creature makes a Wisdom save or can't move toward it. Cantrip Upgrade: two targets at level 5, three at 11, four at 17.

name: Summon Ompo Swarm
components: V, S, M (a scrap of trash)
description: Mouselike spirits devour all unattended Small or smaller nonmagical objects in a 10-foot Cube, except those you designate. +5 feet per slot level above 1.

name: Taxi Service
description: A Huge spectral taxi travels a 120-foot Line, picking up willing Medium or smaller creatures within 5 feet of it and passing through objects (stopping at 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, or lead); passengers exit within 5 feet of where it stops.

name: Unearth Demon
components: V, S, M (cursed tuft of hair)
description: Choose 1,000 feet (number of demons), 500 feet (also direction and distance), or 250 feet (also kind and CR). Outside Obojima it can detect Aberrations, Fey, Fiends, or Undead.

name: Vine Ladder
components: S, M (a stem, leaf, or other piece of a plant)
description: A stationary vine ladder up to 15 feet tall appears on a solid surface; a new one replaces the last.

name: Warding Barrier
description: Ward a 15-foot-radius Sphere against one creature type of CR 2 or lower: entering requires a Charisma save or it falls Prone and stops; starting its turn inside, it saves or is shunted out, Prone, taking 2d8 Force. Maximum CR +1 per slot level above 2.

name: Armament
description: Up to five well-made nonmagical simple or martial weapons of your choice appear within range and vanish when the spell ends. Three more per slot level above 1st.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: At Your Side
description: You and up to three willing creatures form a bond: each gets +5 feet speed, and when one ends its turn, the others can use their reactions to move half their speed toward another bonded creature. One more creature per slot level above 2nd.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Beast Transmutation
description: A beast you can see becomes a humanoid commoner (Wisdom save if unwilling), keeping its mental scores, alignment, and personality. It uses the commoner's hit points and reverts at 0 with excess damage carrying over. +1 hour per slot level above 2nd.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Bubble Lift
description: A bubble lifts an object of up to 500 pounds 4 feet off the ground; it weighs 10 pounds, can be pushed with an action or by wind, falls 10 feet per round, and pops if pierced as an action. +500 pounds per slot level above 1st.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Butterfly Storm
description: Butterflies fill a 20-foot-radius sphere: heavily obscured, disperses fog, and difficult terrain. A creature trying to leave makes a Strength save or is pulled back to the space nearest the center. Creatures you choose ignore the effects.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Conjure Ocean
components: V, S, M (a piece of witch's eye coral)
description: A 20-foot cube of deep-ocean water holds its shape within range; creatures can swim in and out. When the spell ends it crashes down, carrying creatures inside 30 feet in a random direction.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Control Animal
components: V, S, M (a bit of matted fur)
description: A beast of CR 2 or lower makes a Wisdom save or you take full control of it, using its senses and actions while your body is unconscious. When it takes damage, make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check (DC 10 or half the damage) or the spell ends. +1 CR per slot level above 2nd.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Counterspy
components: V, S, M (a bag of sand and six candles)
description: A circle of candles and sand up to 10 feet in radius: if anyone outside it sees or hears you by any means, the flames change color, and if magic was used you learn the effect and its extent.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Create Spirit Train Stop
components: V, S, M (a blank ticket and high quality ink worth at least 50 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: Inscribe the code of a known permanent train stop and the Wandering Line arrives, carrying you and up to eight creatures there in 1 hour regardless of distance (with possible stops). Short rests aboard heal an extra 1d10 when Hit Dice are spent. You start knowing two codes.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Crustacean Form
components: V, S, M (a rust crab shell)
description: An ethereal crustacean shell gives you AC 20 (if higher), swim speed 40 feet, blindsight 30 feet, and a bonus action claw attack (spell attack, 1d10 bludgeoning). The shell has a damage threshold of 15.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Dara Blocks
components: V, S, M (a pinch of sand and a piece of pottery)
description: Five fixed, invisible 1-foot force cubes (visible to you and creatures you designate) appear within range, each holding up to 5,000 pounds; a Strength check against your DC moves one 10 feet. Two more per slot level above 3rd.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Divine Arrow
components: V, S, M (a pearl worth 100 gp)
description: Ranged spell attack: 4d10 force, and the target becomes vulnerable to acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, radiant, or thunder (your choice) for the duration; immunity becomes resistance and resistance is lost.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Duplicate
description: Create a functioning nonmagical replica of an object of up to 25 pounds you can see (Investigation against your DC to tell). 8 hours with 2nd- or 3rd-level slots, 24 hours with 4th or higher.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Ember Belly
components: S, M (a flask of oil, which the spell consumes)
description: Once before the spell ends, exhale the swallowed oil as a bonus action in a 5-by-30-foot line: Dexterity save, 2d10 fire or half.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Festival King
description: A creature becomes the Festival King. Creatures entering or starting their turn within 20 feet of it make a Charisma save (charm-immune succeed) or spend their action and bonus action adoring it; starting a turn outside the aura ends the effect for them.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Forest Guard
description: An immobile animated shrub makes a ranged leaf attack (your spell attack, 1d4 slashing) against hostile creatures that first come within 10 feet or start their turn there. A bonus action makes shrubs attack one creature within 10 feet, 1d4 per shrub. One more shrub per two slot levels above 1st.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Gift
description: You take 1d20 necrotic damage and a creature you can see within range regains that many hit points.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Jolt
description: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 lightning. Or power a working machine for 18 seconds as if whelmed by a spirit. 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Light Snare
description: Ranged spell attack: on a hit the target is restrained and fixed in place until the end of its next turn.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Mass Levitate
components: V, S, M (a small leather loop)
description: Up to six creatures or objects of up to 500 pounds each rise up to 20 feet (Constitution save if unwilling) and can only move by pushing off surfaces. You adjust their altitude by 20 feet on your turn; they float down when it ends.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Monkey's Grasp
description: An ethereal monkey paw tries to grapple a Huge or smaller creature on the ground (contest with your spellcasting modifier); a grappled target takes 1d8 necrotic at the start of each turn until it escapes. One more target per slot level above 2nd, within 60 feet of each other.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Mushroom Ballista
description: One to three pieces of ammunition sprout mushrooms: a hit deals +1d6 poison and the target makes a Dexterity save or is pushed back feet equal to the damage (rounded to 5, maximum 15). Recasting ends earlier ammunition.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Obscure Object
description: An unworn object no larger than a 5-foot cube becomes invisible.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Origami Bird Swarm
components: V, S, M (fine papers worth 10 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: Eight paper birds hit a target within 30 feet for 8d6 slashing. A farther target is pursued at 30 feet per round; the swarm (AC your spell save DC) loses a bird per hit, and deals 1d6 slashing per remaining bird on arrival. Two more birds (or +2d6 close up) per slot level above 5th.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Pacify Monster
description: A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or is pacified: it can't attack, cast spells affecting an enemy, or deal damage. It repeats the save at the end of each turn. One more creature per slot level above 4th, within 30 feet of each other.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Pacify Person
description: A humanoid you can see makes a Wisdom save or is pacified: it can't attack, cast spells affecting an enemy, or deal damage. It repeats the save at the end of each turn. One more humanoid per slot level above 1st, within 30 feet of each other.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Pillar of Force
description: Ranged spell attack: 2d12 bludgeoning and a Huge or smaller target is pushed 10 feet; the ground between you becomes difficult terrain. +1d12 per slot level above 2nd.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Plummet
description: A flying creature makes a Dexterity save or is pulled to the ground and takes falling damage; on a success it drops halfway and takes no damage.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Pogmo's Pot
description: A sealed, damage-immune 15-pound iron pot sucks in every unattended object of 10 pounds or less within 20 feet, releasing them when the spell ends.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Rageful Nimbus
components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
description: A cloud follows a creature; when a hostile creature you can see damages it, use your reaction for a ranged spell attack from the cloud against that creature within 60 feet: 2d8 lightning. +1d8 per two slot levels above 2nd.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Resilient Friendship
description: Give a creature the Help action's benefit; if it succeeds by the start of your next turn, you gain 1d4 temporary hit points for 1 hour (1d6 at 5th level, 1d8 at 11th, 1d10 at 17th).
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Retrieve
description: An unattended object of 10 pounds or less flies to your open hand.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Root Grab
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature provokes an opportunity attack from you
description: Roots grasp the provoking creature, reducing its speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Sand Structure
components: V, S, M (a small piece of seaglass)
description: A 5-by-5-foot, 1-foot-thick wall of stone-hard sand rises (AC 13, 10 hit points); dismiss it as an action. Cast as a ritual, it lasts until destroyed or dismissed.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Spell Signature
description: A magical effect within range releases its creator's scent; you recognize a creature you know. Otherwise a spellcasting ability check (with proficiency) reveals its creature type (DC 5), class (DC 10), organization (DC 15), and name (DC 20).
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Shared Vision
description: A familiar willing creature within a mile can see through your eyes with your special senses, swapping views as a bonus action, until it dismisses it as an action. One more creature per slot level above 2nd.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Sprout Foliage
description: Foliage covers you; while prone and motionless you pass for a bush (Investigation against your DC, Hide to re-disguise). As an action, hurl a pinecone or berry: ranged spell attack within 30 feet, 1d6 + spellcasting modifier bludgeoning.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Storm Stallion
components: V, S, M (the stem of a windbloom)
description: A wind stallion charges a 60-foot line, possibly carrying a Medium or smaller creature in its starting space (Dexterity save, may fail willingly). Creatures in its path make a Dexterity save, 6d8 bludgeoning or half. +1d8 per slot level above 4th.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Submerge
description: Link a body of water within range to one within 500 miles that you have seen or touched; creatures step in and out the other side for 5 feet of movement. If either is too small to submerge in, a 25 percent chance sends a creature to a random body of water.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Summon Jack-O'-Lantern
description: A giant jack-o'-lantern (AC 15, 100 hit points, 5,000 pounds) grows around up to four Medium or smaller creatures or one Large creature in a 5-foot radius (Dexterity save to leap out).
