Those inside see and attack with ranged or reach weapons only through its face; nothing passes through it.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Summon Vehicle
components: V, S, M (a small piece of rubber)
description: A bicycle or small machine for one Medium or smaller rider appears within 5 feet, with a 60-foot speed usable with a free hand. Dismiss it as an action.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Swallow Magic
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a spell cast by another creature fails to affect you
description: Swallow the leftover magic for one: regain 1d4 + spellcasting modifier hit points, +15 feet speed until the end of your next turn, or add 1d4 to one ability check before the end of your next turn.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Switched Form
description: Two humanoids you can see each look like the other, gear and all (within a foot of height). Physical inspection reveals it, and an Investigation check against your DC as an action sees through it. Dismiss as an action.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Tamh Gon's Fiery Festival Feast
components: V, S, M (an uncommon ingredient, which the spell consumes)
description: Up to twelve creatures share an hour-long feast; afterward each removes one exhaustion level and for 24 hours gains +10 feet speed, +2 to Dexterity saves, and one use of Ember Belly.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Task
description: Magically complete a small harmless task you could do by hand (turn a page, butter bread, heat tea) on a target without total cover. Up to three at once; dismiss one as a bonus action.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Transparency
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when your location would be revealed to a creature while you are hidden or unseen
description: You and your gear turn invisible and your steps are silent until the end of your next turn, or until you attack or cast a spell.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Vegetable Blade
components: V, S, M (a strip of grass)
description: Fronds sprout; as a bonus action a creature pulls up a root-vegetable blade (proficient, finesse, 1d12 slashing). On later turns the wielder or an ally can take a bite as a bonus action to heal the damage die + your spellcasting modifier, shrinking the die a size each time until it is gone after a d4.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Water Bullet
description: Ranged spell attack: bludgeoning 5d6 within 10 feet, 4d6 within 60, 3d6 within 90. +1d6 per slot level above 1st.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Whelm Weapon
components: V, S, M (a drop of seawater)
description: Up to three weapons you can see become water-wrapped; roll a d4, and their damage is reduced by that much (minimum 1) for the duration. Two more weapons per slot level above 1st.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Wind Sprint
description: Wind carries you to a creature you can see within range; your next melee weapon hit this turn deals an extra 2d6 slashing.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Brittle Bone Throw
description: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 Piercing. On a miss, redirect a shard at another creature within 15 feet of the target with a second attack for 1d4 Piercing. Both rise by a die at levels 5, 11, and 17. Osteomancy spell.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Gravity Spike
description: A creature on the ground makes a Dexterity save: 1d4 Piercing and Prone, or half damage only. 2d4 at level 5, 3d4 at 11, 4d4 at 17.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Fractured Shell
description: A willing creature takes 1 Piercing as bone spikes grow; the first creature each turn that hits it with a melee attack takes 2d4 Piercing. +1d4 per slot level above 1; no Concentration at level 5+. Osteomancy spell.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Phalangeal Shot
description: Finger bones fire along a 30-foot by 1-foot Line: Dexterity save or 2d8 Piercing. +1d8 per slot level above 1. Osteomancy spell.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Spectral Slash
components: V, S, M (a melee weapon worth 1 SP+)
description: A spectral copy makes a melee spell attack against a creature within 20 feet for 1d8 of your weapon's type. You can then use your action to dash 20 feet straight at it and take the Attack action with that weapon. +1d8 and +10 feet per slot level above 1.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Arm Cannon
description: Ranged spell attack: 4d8 Piercing and a Strength save (Large+ with Advantage) or pushed 15 feet; slammed into an obstacle it is Restrained until the end of its next turn. +1d8 and +5 feet per slot level above 2. Osteomancy spell.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Blind Ambush
components: S, M (a whistle made of bones)
description: The first time a creature moves 5 feet within a 10-foot Square you choose, a maw erupts: 2d10 Piercing to each creature there, knocking one Prone. +1d10 per slot level above 2; at level 5+ it can trigger twice.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Calcified Memories
description: Touching a non-Undead corpse's bones replays an illusion of its last 6 seconds, showing only outlines of what affected it. Once per corpse per 24 hours. Osteomancy spell.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Skeletal Tail
description: Grow a bone tail. When a creature moves within a 15-foot Emanation, take a Reaction for a melee spell attack: 2d4 + spellcasting modifier Piercing and pull it adjacent. +2d4 per slot level above 2. Osteomancy spell.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Displacing Maw
description: Your rib cage swallows a creature: Strength save or 4d8 Piercing and regurgitated at a point within 60 feet; half damage only on a success. +1d8 and +10 feet per slot level above 3. Osteomancy spell.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Osseous Impalement
components: V, S, M (a calcified bamboo stick)
description: Up to four creatures on the ground make a Dexterity save or take 3d10 Piercing and are impaled 5 feet up, Restrained, taking 1d10 each turn; Athletics against your DC as an action breaks free. +1d10 to both per slot level above 3. Osteomancy spell.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Spectral Fury
components: V, S, M (a melee weapon worth 1+ SP)
description: Three spectral duplicates each make a melee spell attack against creatures within 30 feet for 4d8 of your weapon's type. Then a Bonus Action dashes you 30 feet toward one without provoking for a weapon attack. +2d8 per duplicate per slot level above 3.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Dread Scarecrow
components: V, S, M (a flute made of a femur worth 50+ GP)
description: Creatures you choose in a 30-foot Sphere make a Wisdom save or are Frightened, Prone, and Speed 0 for the duration; one that takes damage repeats the save at the end of its next turn. Osteomancy spell.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Maiden of Bones
components: V, S, M (a virgin's carpal bone)
description: A creature makes a Strength save or is sealed in a bone iron maiden: Restrained, Incapacitated, Total Cover, and 3d6 Piercing each turn, saving at the end of each turn. The maiden has AC 10 + spellcasting modifier, 80 Hit Points, Immunity to Psychic and Poison, Vulnerability to Bludgeoning. +1d6 and +20 Hit Points per slot level above 4. Osteomancy spell.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Marrow Transplant
components: V, S, M (a piece of spinal bone and a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: Ranged spell attack: 4d6 Necrotic, and another creature within range regains that many Hit Points, or returns to life with them if dead less than a minute (not old age). Fails if either lacks bones. +1d6 per slot level above 4. Osteomancy spell.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Forest of Dread
description: Bone trees fill a 30-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder: chosen creatures make a Dexterity save, 4d8 Piercing or half. The area is Difficult Terrain giving Half Cover, and moving in it costs 2d8 Piercing per 5 feet (not you). Osteomancy spell.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Body Warping of Gorgoroth
description: You become an exact physical duplicate of a Humanoid of your size that you can see, undetectable by physical examination; your voice and equipment don't change.

name: Breath of the Deep
description: Crushing deep-sea water surrounds a creature you can see: 3d6 Bludgeoning, and it can't speak or use Verbal components for the duration.

name: Call Deity
description: During your Contact Deity, make the contacted deity manifest nearby for 1 hour. It acts as it wishes and treats you as an ally unless you act against it, but not your allies; protecting others counts as acting against it.

name: Cat's Spring
description: Leap up to 10 feet and make a melee spell attack with a spectral claw: 1d8 Slashing or Force, and your next attack against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage. 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

name: Chant of Thoth
description: The first time you fail an Intelligence check, succeed automatically if its DC is below your spell save DC, otherwise add +2. Once per Short Rest.

name: Confounding Shadows
description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d6 Psychic and can't see you until the end of your next turn. 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

name: Clutch of Darkness
description: Roll 2d6 for a creature you can see and add 2d6 at the start of each of your turns. Above its Strength: Disadvantage on Strength attacks. Above its Dexterity: Speed halved and attacks against it have Advantage. Above its current Hit Points: it implodes and dies.

name: Contact Deity
description: Ask a Mythos deity 1d6 yes-or-no questions and receive correct answers (or unclear). On a d20 roll of 1 when you cast it, the deity appears and attacks everyone, including you, for the duration.

name: Create Mist of R'lyeh
description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of lightly obscuring fog with fleeting shapes; creatures ending their turn in it take 1d4 Psychic, and Beasts of Intelligence 3 or less won't enter willingly.

name: Curse of the Putrid Husk
description: A creature believes it is rotting. Choose: it Dashes away from allies whenever it starts a turn within 30 feet of one, or it Dashes at its nearest enemy each turn and makes an Unarmed Strike against an enemy within 5 feet.

name: Dismiss Deity
description: A Bloodied Mythos or Deity creature you can see is sent to a random location on a plane tied to its type.

name: Doom
description: A creature makes a Charisma save. On a failure, when it takes damage from an attack you can use your Reaction to make the damage dice deal their maximum. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Dust of Suleiman
description: A 30-foot-radius Sphere of dust: creatures of a chosen type (not Beast or Humanoid) take 20 Force when it appears or moves onto them, or when they enter or end their turn in it (once per turn).

name: Dread Curse of Azathoth
description: A creature gains a curse point at the end of each of its turns and dies on the third, unless the spell ends first.

name: Evil Eye
description: A creature you can see takes 1d4 + 2 Psychic, and attacks and Unarmed Strikes against it crit on 19 or 20 until your next turn. Scales to 2d4 + 4 at level 5, 3d4 + 6 at 11, 4d4 + 8 at 17.

name: Feline Chaos
description: Targets make a Dexterity save or are swarmed by spectral cats: 4d6 Slashing at the start of each turn, Disadvantage on checks and attacks, and moving requires a Constitution save or they fall Prone and take 2d6 more. They repeat the Dexterity save at the end of each turn. +2d6 per slot level above 5.

name: Feline Grace
description: You can't be knocked Prone while not Incapacitated, can use a Reaction to reduce falling damage by five times your level, have Advantage on Dexterity checks and saves, and jump twice as far.

name: Fist of Yog-Sothoth
description: A creature takes 8d6 Necrotic; on a failed Strength save it is also knocked Prone and moved up to 40 feet within range.

name: Phantom Panther
description: A spectral panther pounces: Strength save or 8d6 Force and Restrained (2d6 Force each turn; Athletics against your DC as an action ends it), or half and the spell ends. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Red Sign
description: At the end of each of your turns, every creature within 30 feet that can see you, including you, takes 5d8 Necrotic (it can't break your Concentration). Creatures it kills collapse into slime, revivable only by True Resurrection or Wish.

name: Shadowy Eruption
description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of gloom. The Darkness Hides Terrors: chosen creatures make a Dexterity save, 4d8 Psychic and a Reaction move away, or half. Tomb of Shadows: Constitution save, 4d8 Necrotic and -20 feet Speed, or half. +1d8 per slot level above 3.

name: Summon Shadow
description: A Shadow Spirit (Infiltrator or Assassin) acts after you and obeys your commands. AC 11 + spell level, 50 (Assassin) or 40 (Infiltrator) Hit Points +10 per level above 5, Resistance to Necrotic, Immunity to Cold, moves through objects, and Hides as a Bonus Action in dim light. Attacks equal to half the spell level: Chill Touch (1d8 + 3 + level Cold) or Deathly Bolt (150 feet, 2d4 + 3 + level Cold, +2d4 if hidden).

name: Tide of Darkness
description: A 10-foot Cube of Darkness from you: Wisdom save, 2d8 Psychic and Blinded while in it, or half. It lasts until the end of your next turn. +5 feet per slot level above 1.

name: Umbral Tendril
description: Ranged spell attack: 2d8 Necrotic, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the damage. +1d8 per slot level above 1.

name: Voorish Sign
description: Your spell damage dice against a chosen creature are maximized, and as part of this casting you can also cast a level 5 or lower one-action spell, expending both slots.

name: Wave of Oblivion
description: Each Bloodied creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Constitution save or dies and turns to dust with its nonmagical gear, revivable only by True Resurrection or Wish.

name: Ambush Prey
description: You become invisible with advantage on Stealth until you move 5 feet or more from where you cast it. Your first attack against an unaware target deals +1d6 and ends the spell. +1d6 per slot level above 2nd.

name: Elevated Sight
description: Project your sight to an invisible sensor up to 120 feet above you that moves with you (bonus action to adjust its height), giving a 360-degree aerial view. You are blind while using it but can switch views on your turn.

name: Feathered Reach
description: Your arms become wings: bonus action flight up to double your speed (landing afterward, no fall damage), once per turn propel yourself up half your speed, glide with your reaction when falling, and advantage on jump checks with triple jump distance and no run-up. Hands must be free of shields and heavy weapons.

name: Globe of Twilight
components: V, S, M (a dab of pitch and a bag of glittering sand)
description: A lightly obscured starry sphere where only 3rd-level or higher magical light works normally. Creatures you designate can hide at any time with advantage on Stealth. Others have disadvantage on Perception inside and make a Wisdom save on entering or starting a turn there or are blinded until the end of their turn.

name: Gust Barrier
description: Until the end of your next turn, ranged attacks against you have disadvantage, and melee attackers that hit you make a Constitution save or are flung 10 feet and knocked prone.

name: Invoke the Amaranthine
components: V, S, M (a holy symbol of the Amaranthines)
description: Roll two d20s and assign each to attack rolls, skill checks, or saving throws. For 24 hours, use your reaction to replace a matching roll by a creature you can see within 60 feet with a recorded number before the outcome is known. Ends when both are used.

name: Shape Plants
description: Reshape plant life in a 5-foot cube for 1 hour, adjusting flowers, vines, thorns, or fruit; brambles can become difficult terrain dealing 2d4 piercing per 5 feet. A plant persuaded by speech may keep its form. +5 feet per slot level above 4th.

name: Spiny Shield
description: Until your next turn, melee hits against you deal 2d4 less damage and the attacker takes that much piercing; against ranged attacks you have +2 AC. +1d4 per slot level above 1st.

name: Stellar Bodies
description: Two stars orbit you, shedding dim light 10 feet; a creature within 5 feet that hits you in melee makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d8 radiant per star. Once per round as an action, hurl a star with a ranged spell attack within 120 feet: 4d8 radiant and a Constitution save or blinded until your next turn. One more star per two slot levels above 4th.

name: Veil of Dusk
components: V, S, M (a pinch of soot)
description: A creature gains +1 AC and advantage on Stealth checks.

name: Mend Plants
components: V, S, M (a small twig and a loop of twine)
description: Choose one: mend a break or tear up to 1 foot in a living plant; regrow foliage, sprout a seed, or revive a dead seed pod; make a 5-foot cube of plants flourish enough to conceal a Medium creature or become difficult terrain; or give a plant or plant creature 1d4 temporary hit points.

name: Freedom of the Waves
components: V, S, M (a strand of wet hair)
description: Seawater crashes through a 15-foot-radius, 10-foot-tall cylinder: Strength save or 2d8 bludgeoning and prone; up to your spellcasting modifier creatures automatically succeed. If you are in the area, you can vanish into the deluge and teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within it.

name: Freedom of the Winds
components: V, S, M (a scrap of sailcloth)
description: You gain a 60-foot flying speed and advantage on checks to avoid grapples and saves against being restrained or paralyzed. When targeted by a spell or attack, use your reaction to teleport up to 60 feet to a space you can see; if that takes you out of range you are unaffected, and the spell ends.

name: Aundair's Silent Sanctum
description: A soundproof 5-foot Emanation: Perception checks to hear across its edge have Disadvantage in both directions, and creatures have Advantage on saves against effects that need them to hear a sound from the other side.

name: Concussive Burst
description: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere makes a Constitution save: 2d4 Force and Deafened until the end of your next turn on a failure, half damage only on a success. +2d4 per slot level above 1.

name: Force Blast
description: Ranged spell attack against a creature or object for 1d8 Force. Increases to 2d8, 3d8, and 4d8 at levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Magecraft
components: V, S, M (Artisan's Tools or a Herbalism Kit)
description: Choose an Artisan's Tool or Herbalism Kit; add 1d6 to ability checks when you take the Utilize action with it.

name: Absorb Elements
casting_time: Reaction, when you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage
description: Resistance to the triggering type until the start of your next turn, and your first melee hit next turn deals +1d6 of that type. +1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Earthbind
description: One creature makes a Strength save or its Fly Speed becomes 0; an airborne target descends safely 60 feet per round.

name: Earth Tremor
description: Each other creature in a 10-foot Emanation makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 Bludgeoning and falls Prone; loose earth or stone there becomes Difficult Terrain until cleared. +1d6 per slot level above 1.

name: Gray Gaze
components: V, S, M (a pebble with a hole in it)
description: A creature you can see that can see your eyes makes a Constitution save or takes Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and has Disadvantage on its next Dexterity save before the end of its next turn.

name: Mold Earth
description: Shape dirt or stone in a 5-foot Cube: excavate loose earth and move it 5 feet, draw shapes or colors for 1 hour, or make the ground Difficult Terrain (or normal) for 1 hour. Two lasting effects at most.

name: Orien Step
description: Mark of Passage spell. Teleport up to 5 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, not through solid objects or out of restraints.

name: Evolution/Devolution
components: V, S, M (a pinch of dirt)
description: A touched creature (Wisdom save if unwilling) gains or loses one ancestral trait: attack damage +/- 1d4, Speed +/- 20, climb or fly gained or reduced, one attack's damage type changed, Darkvision gained or reduced, or HP max +/- 1d4 + 4. One more trait per slot level above 2.
